notes.title: Giant Throne and Liberty update unleashes its impressive new player housing
notes.content:
The Throne and Liberty Solisium's Awakening update is here, and it feels almost like a fresh starting point for the vast world built by Amazon Games and NCSoft. This starts with a comprehensive and immersive new player housing system that looks set to rival the likes of Final Fantasy 14 and World of Warcraft, but it runs much deeper. On the battle side, there's another support weapon, improved progression and the option for a 'hyperboost' feature to catch up to where you want to be, more endgame build options, better beginner assistance, and the addition of the most highly requested PvP mode. Whatever you're after, Throne and Liberty 3.0 is looking to deliver.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Solisium’s Awakening Update (3.00.0)
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="d1Uyzfs6f10;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Solisium’s Awakening Update (3.00.0) downtime will begin at 6:00 p.m. PT (1:00 a.m. UTC) on September 17 and last approximately 13 hours. Servers will not open before 7:00 a.m. PT on September 18.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Note from Tico:[/h3][p]What's up Gamers, I am absolutely bursting with excitement as we prepare to unlock the biggest chapter yet in Throne and Liberty's journey![/p][p][/p][quote][p]This massive update isn't just about new content—it's about building a home together, literally and figuratively, as we introduce Housing where you can finally put down roots in Solisium. We're orb-solutely thrilled to put a new weapon in your hands, while Battlegrounds will let you prove your worth against fellow players, and our revamped Dimensional Trials will challenge even the most seasoned warriors. With Hyperboost welcoming both familiar faces and fresh blood into our growing community, plus Tier 3 gear to chase and new dungeons to conquer, I can honestly say we're just getting started on this incredible adventure.[/p][p]Thank you for being the heart and soul of this community—together, we're not just playing a game, we're building a world, and the best is yet to come![/p][/quote][p][/p][p]Read on for the full list of new content, events, store offerings, and other changes [url="https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/game/releases/solisiums-awakening"]here[/url]. Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium![/p]

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.26.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5ynZVYPchSjfjFohFGqqgB/a6ee676b39a3272b017623e0700b762d/Bercant_Mansion_02_580.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.26.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on September 3 and last approximately 6 hours. Find the full list of changes below.[/p][p]
[/p][h3]GUILD ALLIANCE SIZE REDUCED[/h3][list][*][p]The maximum number of guilds that can be joined in an Alliance is now 2 instead of 4.[/p][/*][*][p]We will be monitoring the ongoing impact of this change and feedback from the community as we understand there are a range of opinions on Alliance limits, and will consider additional modifications if necessary.[/p][/*][*][p]To support this change, existing Alliances will be disbanded to allow guild leaders to re-form alliances with the second guild of their choice.[/p][/*][/list][h3]AVAILABLE NAME REFRESH - Deleted Characters and Guilds[/h3][list][*][p]Names previously used by characters or guilds that have been [b][i][u]deleted[/u][/i][/b] will be available again for use after this maintenance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]SERVER TRANSFER COOLDOWN RESET[/h3][list][*][p]The 30-day cooldown period after performing a Server Transfer has been reset in preparation for upcoming content releases.[/p][/*][/list][h3]OREMONG HIDE AND SEEK[/h3][list][*][p]Coming soon: Mischievous citrus have been spotted popping up in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre regions.[/p][/*][*][p]Roll out and find the hiding Oremong to ponder their prize list![/p][/*][*][p]Rumor has it, these friendly citrus are selling Rainbewe morphs, titles, portrait frames, fishing rods, and more.[/p][/*][/list][h3]GENERAL[/h3][list][*][p]Arena: Season 3 is now Vanguard.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand: Players who are tethered with Ray of Disaster now properly take damage when moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand: The Ray of Disaster's "Concentration Effect Time" specialization now matching it's functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to display in the Heroic Accessory Trait Info page.[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetics: Fixed an issue with the Azure notes.title: Update 2.24.0
notes.content: [p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.24.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on August 20 and last approximately 4 hours. Prepare for your fiercest adversary yet in Altar of Calanthia Nightmare Difficulty, plus the introduction of customizable Headstones. How will you be remembered? Special rewards will also be available through the Solisium Grand Morph Festival, Mystic Portal: Lucky Pouch, and Call to Arms Archboss Guild Raid events. Here are the full list of changes.[/p][p][/p][h3]Altar of Calanthia: Nightmare Difficulty Unlocked[/h3][list][*][p]The increased difficulty "Nightmare" mode for the Altar of Calanthia raid is now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Featuring increased boss stats and new mechanics, Nightmare mode also offers new and unique rewards for overcoming its challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Players must have 7,000 combat power or higher to enter Nightmare mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Defeating Nightmare mode Calanthia guarantees a Heroic accessory drop and a chance to acquire a Nightmare-specific Morph.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who defeat Calanthia in Nightmare mode will receive a specially-colored title, 'Calanthia's Nightmare'.[/p][/*][*][p]For raid groups who defeat all three phases of the raid with no single player death, they will also receive a specially-colored title, "Total Nightmare".[/p][/*][*][p]Five new Heroic grade accessories have been added to the Raid currency shop.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Altar of Calanthia: Difficult Mode Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Resolve of the Star Fragment: When a team is fully defeated on any boss in Difficult Mode, all players will receive a damage and HP buffs for additional attempts. This buff stacks up to 5 times and can only be applied once every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Dragar'yle: In phase 2, the number of lightning summoning devices required to be placed on the statue has been changed from 2 to 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Dragar'yle: Added an effect that pulls the lightning summoner during the Dragaryle pattern (allowing the use of summoners attached to walls).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Solisium Grand Morph Festival[/h3][list][*][p]From August 21 through September 18, the Solisium Grand Morph Festival comes to town![/p][/*][*][p]Take part in Morph Races throughout the event to collect Festival Commemorative Medals. Trade in your Medals for event-specific rewards including an updated Morph, Gesture, Profile Frame, and Title.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect special meal ingredients through daily check-ins, Amitoi Expeditions and Fishing to craft a limited-time event meal that provides bonus Sollant and weapon specialization gain as well as increased Abyssal coin efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event - Queen Bellandir[/h3][list][*][p]Between August 21 and September 3, guilds will have access to a special version of the Arch Boss Queen Bellandir fight as a Guild Raid.[/p][/*][*][p]The Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.[/p][/*][*][p]Guilds may enter the Queen Bellandir guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active![/p][/*][*][p]Defeating the Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.[/p][/*][*][p]In this run of the Call to Arms event, Guild Raid Queen Bellandir will also drop the new material used in upgrading Bellandir weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Punishment Stones purchased for the Tevent Guild Raid event will be removed during maintenance, and cannot be used for the Queen Bellandir event.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mystic Portal: Lucky Pouch Event[/h3][list][*][p]From August 21 through September 3, receive a Plentiful Lucky Pouch when opening Mystic Portals and Mystic Globes. Lucky Pouches contain varying amounts of Sollant, including a chance at a 100,000,000 Sollant prize.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Custom Headstones[/h3][list][*][p]Customized Headstones are all the rage in Solisium! Decease in a style that suits your personality. Pull fast, die often, and leave a pretty grave.[/p][/*][*][p]Dying in PvE encounters will leave behind the headstone you've selected through customization.[/p][/*][*][p]Dying in PvP will display the customized headstone choice of your killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom Headstones are set in the new section of the Mirror Boutique, under 'Appearance Effect'.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Dimensional Trial Season End Date: Corrected the display of the current Dimensional Trial Season ending date in the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards will be sent automatically at the completion of the current Dimensional Trial season.[/p][/*][*][p]Sword and Shield: Fixed an issue allowing Counter Barrier to block some skills every 0.1 seconds instead of 0.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand: Ray of Disaster now damages multiple targets when the Targets Expanded Specialization is applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Spear: Fixed an issue causing Rising Slash to not go on cooldown when blocking at the same time it was used while Deluzhnoa's Serrated Shard was equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Archboss: Fixed an issue allowing Tevent to be attacked from a Safe zone in PvP events.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Settings: Fixed an issue preventing some options from being changed within the 'Current' Comat Settings tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat: Arrow keys can once again be used to navigate the list of chat commands.[/p][/*][*][p]Runes: Chaos Rune favorites are now saved when relaunching.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Controller users can now use the "Follow" option (foot icon) from the Party HUD to quickly move to another player's instance.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance: Fixed an issue causing the client to hitch when changing body types in the Change Appearance menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: Fixed an issue causing all Shop offers to be displayed in English when launching the game after previously selecting a non-English language.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to be displayed in the Sync menu if opened before reaching level 50.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.22.0
notes.content: [p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.22.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on August 6 and last approximately 5 hours. It includes the return of the Archboss Guild Raid event, Mystic Portal Treasure Hunt, and more. Find the full list of changes, plus various bug fixes below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event Returns[/h3][list][*][p]Between August 6 and August 20, guilds will have access to a special version of the Arch Boss Tevent fight as a Guild Raid.[/p][/*][*][p]The Guild Raid version of Tevent has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.[/p][/*][*][p]Guilds may enter the Tevent guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active![/p][/*][*][p]Defeating the Guild Raid version of Tevent will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.[/p][/*][*][p]In this run of the Call to Arms event, Guild Raid Tevent will also drop the new material used in upgrading Tevent weapons.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Mystic Portal: Treasure Hunt[/h3][list][*][p]From August 6 through August 20, daily login rewards will grant you special Mystic Keys. Open Mystic Portals to play a treasure-hunting minigame![/p][/*][*][p]Hunt down hidden treasure chests through different puzzles for a variety of rewards, including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials![/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Artifacts: Default artifact inventory size is now 300 slots, expandable up to 500.[/p][/*][*][p]Summer Splash: Fixed an issue causing additional Splash Coins to not drop upon defeating enemies while Gigantrite's buff was active.[/p][/*][*][p]Queen Bellandir of the Frenzied Flame: Fixed an issue where this version of Queen Bellandir could become un-attackable if a section was destroyed during the leap attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Tevent: Fixed an issue allowing Tevent to be attacked from unintended safe locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Sword and Shield: Shield Survival Technique: Removed the damage reduction effect granted by defending against a Fury attack within 0.5 seconds. Increased the shield amount granted when defending against a Wrath or Fury attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Sword and Shield: Stalwart Bastion: Reduced duration from 9 seconds to 6 seconds. Targets affected by Stalwart Bastion must wait 45 seconds before receiving Stalwart Bastion effects from other casters. This does not apply to effects from the same caster.[/p][/*][*][p]War Games: Riftstones: Fixed some areas of the map where targeting and sightlines differed between the standard and War Games version.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Fixed an issue causing the previously selected rune slot to be updated instead of the current one when adjusting socket types.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Fixed an issue where skill tooltips would always be shown despite settings selected to not show them.[/p][/*][*][p]Raids: Adjusted the movement animations when teleporting between raid locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking: Fixed an issue causing the accepted role highlight to display incorrectly when the Matchmaking Successful prompt is shown twice before all players have accepted.[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeons: Fixed an issue causing the first room in the Crypt of Augmentation to appear much brighter than intended while using Low graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Settings: Fixed an issue causing hotkeys to activate when entering a name for a Combat Setting preset.[/p][/*][*][p]Auction House: Removed various Earring Lithographs from the Auction House that cannot be obtained.[/p][/*][*][p]Shop: Fixed an issue preventing the Congratulatory Packages granted upon completing Chapters 5, 7, 9, and 13 from being displayed in the Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect weapon skin to be shown when selecting the Daggers, Crossbows, Staff, or Longbow from the Desert Star Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that rarely prevented any movement beyond dodge-rolling until relaunching the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass: The Tidal Weapons and Skill Core Imprint Scroll can now be purchased from the Summer Splash Shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass: The quantity of Abundance Fruit, Mastery Report, and Dimensional Contract Token II items received from the Summer Splash Shop have increased from 1x to 2x.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat: Added max-value limits to the following stats:[/p][list][*][p]Cooldown Speed increase now caps at 200%.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff Duration increase now caps at 150%.[/p][/*][*][p]Attack Speed increase now caps at 150%.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Localization[/h3][list][*][p]Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to be shown in the Skill Core Device menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to be shown when using the Unlock All option in the Artifact menu.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Cosmetics[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a case where skill effects could display incorrectly when changing weapons that had their appearance customized.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the Shield of the Azure Moon weapon skin to be held incorrectly resulting in the players hand clipping through it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing hair to appear translucent on the Eternal Archer Headpiece when dyed silver.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing parts of tattoos on the Summer Splash outfit to not display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Morphs: Fixed an issue causing the Iron Tsarca to not be available in the Morphs menu.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.20.0
notes.content:
[p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2q9zapS1SPWHKUz0fzRWti/109efc881157a5c5a00e38075a414564/TL_Summer_Splash_Screenshots_AmitoiWaterBalloonFestival_A_v01_1080.jpeg"][/img][i]
[/i][/p][p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.20.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 23 and last approximately 6.5 hours. Find the full list of changes below.[/p][h3]Summer Splash Event[/h3][p]Hunt down Tidebully Goblins, join the Splash Bash arena for refreshing fun, and receive a Blessing of Summer Buff from Beach Party Gigantrite. The Summer Splash event will send waves across Solisium from July 24 through August 13.[/p][p]Beyond the sandcastles, colorful parasols, and tropical decorations will be event exclusive fish, cooking recipes, and login rewards. Earn Splash Coins through different festivities for event-specific rewards like the Llama Playful Morph or check out the Store for new summer swimsuits.[/p][p]For more details on the festivities, see the event article \[[url="https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-gb/news/articles/summer-splash"]HERE[/url]].[/p][h3]Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized some large-scale combat FPS performance for content like Arch Bosses, Field Bosses, and War Games. Significant FPS improvements should be noticeable depending on your hardware setup.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance when casting multi-target skills against large groups, and reduced motion blur and camera shake effects triggered by critical hits on multiple targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved positional desync when jumping onto or off of lifts or breezelines.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved movement desync when landing on a sloped surface when gliding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a client hitch encountered when entering the underground section of Doomrot Grove.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Miscellaneous Inventory[/h3][list][*][p]A Miscellaneous inventory has been added to store Fish and Cooking Ingredient type items.[/p][list][*][p]The default storage size is 100 slots, expandable up to 300 slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Currently stored Fish and Cooking Ingredients will be placed in your warehouse, and once moved into the Lifestyle inventory, cannot be stored in the warehouse again.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Artifact UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]The layout of the Artifact UI has been adjusted to make it easier to see the bonuses of individual artifacts in your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Added search functionality so you can search Artifacts by set, primary, and secondary stats.[/p][list][*][p]You can also save search filters for easy re-use.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the ability to compare a selected artifact against a currently equipped artifact's stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Added recommended artifact equipping based on saved search filters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added bulk lock and unlock functionaliy for artifacts.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Combat: Fixed an issue preventing some heal over time effects from applying.[/p][list][*][p]Precious Health Regen Crystal[/p][/*][*][p]Overture of Eternal Salvation Wand[/p][/*][*][p]Greatsword: Davinci's Courage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Arch Boss Weapons: Skill Cores extracted from Tier 1 Arch Boss Weapons can now be crafted into the upgraded Tier 2 version Arch Boss Skill Core.[/p][/*][*][p]Davinci's Favor: Weekly Resistance Contract missions now count the additional completion bonus from Davinci's Favor.[/p][/*][*][p]Davinci's Favor: Gaining Abyssal Contract Tokens while having an amount above max quantity will no longer reset your total to the max quantity.[/p][list][*][p]Nebula Island: You can now purchase Advanced Nebula Stones for 15 Nebula Stones at the Nebula Stone Merchant.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]These items no longer need to be crafted using Nebula Essence, and Nebula Essence is no longer available. Dissolve any leftover Nebula Essence to receive 5 Nebula Stones.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Reduced the Map Icon clutter at the entry point for Nebula Island.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Exodus and Grimturg now appear at the same time on the Sunday Nebula Island schedule. We'll keep an eye on feedback and participation after this schedule adjustment and may adjust it again in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Arena: Completing the Weekly arena mission will now automatically grant mission rewards and display them as a system message in the chat window instead of requiring an additional UI confirmation.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss Instances: Slightly increased the amount of time between the boss' death and the instance closure to allow players who resurrect late in the fight additional time to pick up loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Field Boss: Increased the common rune rewards from Field Boss rune boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Arch Boss: Fixed the Peace and Dominion gates for Giant Cordy despawning after 3 minutes instead of 5 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Arch Boss: Deluzhnoa: The terrain below Deluzhnoa no longer rotates to increase combat stability and performance. Some of Deluzhnoa's skills have been adjusted to account for the change in ground movement to keep a more dynamic fight experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Dagger: Specialization: Thundering Bomb: Fixed an issue preventing Thundering Bomb from consuming Thundercloud stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbows: Concentration Stance: Fixed this ability causing the player to run to the targeted ally when having auto move settings enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Item: Talus' Crystalline Staff: Fixed an issue where being stunned did not trigger the weapon skill.[/p][/*][*][p]War Games: Fixed a case where War Games chat was not displaying.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure Codex: Chapter 14: Fixed an issue where the name and codex marker for the NPC Felix were not displayed during Appendix: New Life.[/p][/*][*][p]Lithograph Book: Added 9 new collections using Heroic equipment items to the Lithograph Book.[/p][/*][*][p]Cooking: Adjusted the names of Cooking recipes to make searching for recipes easier by removing the quality marker from the name.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting: Fixed an issue preventing fishing rods from being crafted at Sundries Crafter NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where health would be restored when equipping and unequipping certain armors.[/p][/*][*][p]Guild Contracts: Increased the amount of Guild Contract refresh attempts from 10 to 99.[/p][/*][*][p]Map Pins: The default interaction for map pins has changed from Left/Right mouse click to CTRL+Left/Right Mouse Click.[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetics: Fixed an unintended change where dyed metallic materials on costumes and illusions was not properly displaying the mettalic effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetics: Fixed an unintended change to the display of dye color D8BE68.[/p][/*][*][p]Morph: Shapeshift: Wraith Hound has learned how to climb stairs.[/p][/*][*][p]Graphics: Fixed a case where the Resolution Scale option wouldn't take effect if you had DLSS/FSR/XESS active.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Raid: Altar of Calanthia[/h3][list][*][p]Removed some persistent raid buff icons from displaying in the party UI and blocking visibility of other effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Calanthia: Fixed the aggro radius of the boss arena to prevent attacks on players in the resurrection area.[/p][/*][*][p]Arkeum Shadowmancer's fury attack indicator now matches the actual attack range.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Fixed an issue where players could not target themselves after certain mechanics in the Altar of Calanthia raid.[/p][/*][*][p]Raid Board: Fixed recruitment posts remaining on the raid board after leaders disband the party.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spectator Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to hide the Spectator Mode control UI while in Spectator Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now set a focused team while spectating PvP content to highlight that team's used skills for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of lines displayed on the kill feed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Interface Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Buffs: Remaining buff timers now display in buff tooltips on the main HUD.[/p][/*][*][p]Warehouse: Added options to adjust the displayed item icon size as well as hiding equipped items from the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Vanguards: Added Vanguard UI to the available HUD editing functions.[/p][/*][*][p]World Map: Adjusted the size of the content settings window when viewing the Schedule → Content Settings UI.[/p][/*][*][p]War Games: Fixed a case where the Kill and Assist counts in the Guide UI could be reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Guild UI: Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate entries for individual Guild Raids in the raid history UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Party Matching: Added status messaging to the standby UI when waiting for Party Matching.[/p][/*][*][p]Party Matching: Fixed an issue where the Raid tab would not be visible when opening the Party Matching UI through a shortcut key.[/p][/*][*][p]Character: A red notification dot now appears on presets that have unspent stat points.[/p][/*][*][p]Waypoints: Using Waypoints from the Schedule UI now works without showing the local map.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Material Transmutation UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Tradable equipment in your inventory is now shown in the Material Transmutation item list to help display that you have it, but it is unable to be selected or used as a material.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the sort and filter display on the Material Transmutation UI.[/p][/*][*][p]A notification dot now appears on the Material Conversion icon in the main menu when automatic material conversion is complete.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Controller[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Weapon Mastery Battle Pass bonus reward button could not be selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing the Vanguard Party controls from opening when using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Mirror Boutique: Fixed an issue leading to unintended results when confirming changes while hovering over hairstyles.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Localized Spanish Support Update[/h3][list][*][p]To better focus our resources on future updates, all web and in-game content moving forward will no longer receive localized support for Spanish. This content will instead be localized into LATAM Spanish.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.18.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/99cd75bbbe499392792fe1888cd427e1e1a03618.png"][/img][/p][p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.18.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 9 and last approximately 4.5 hours. It includes the new 4-Star Dimensional Trial: Crypt of Augmentation. Find the full list of changes, including bug fixes, below.[/p][p][/p][h3]New 4-Star Dimensional Trial[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2MKziWC3kNjIc5oKw3u4sW/fe935b5ef918767d1602552a77fffcda/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_01_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019299.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Challenge Velentra in the latest addition to Dimensional Trials, the new 4-Star Dimensional Trial: Crypt of Augmentation.[/p][list][*][p]This update marks the end of Dimensional Trial Season 2. Strive for new personal bests alongside new seasonal score rewards, including a new Morph, Title, and Epic Chaos Runes when Season 3 starts after maintenance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Arkeum Invasion Field Event[/h3][p]Fight back invaders from the Arkeum Legion for unique rewards, like an event gesture, Amitoi, and Morph after maintenance through July 23. Remember to exchange your event currency with special NPCs in town to reap your hard-earned spoils of war.[/p][list][*][p]The Arkeum Invasion field event will spawn 3x per day on weekdays and 4x per day on weekends, across multiple zones.[/p][list][*][p]Weekdays (UTC): 01:30, 05:30, 12:30.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekends (UTC): 01:30, 05:30, 12:30, 21:30.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Field Boss Guild Portals[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/23Z4pZhvDtNpyTguV6Kva/c7ffeae7d6a9033a54f14e51988ddc79/tl_announce_screenshots_dungeons_sileousabyss_c_1920.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Guild Portals for Field Bosses will now occur only twice per day at 20:30 and 23:30 local server time. The half-hour time offset is to allow players to participate in Peace/Dominion Field Bosses separately from guild portals.[/p][list][*][p]New Rune Box reward: Guild Field Bosses now offer a Rune box that guarantees a rune, plus the occasional Rare or Epic Chaos Rune. Both guilds will receive 1 million Weapon Mastery Experience per participant upon victory.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Obsidian Fragment Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Obsidian Fragments have been added to the Arena reward shop for purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]Obsidian Fragments now have a chance of dropping from mining nodes on Gigantrite.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Raid: Altar of Calanthia[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/76DiijrFZlpG8enHuH5TrD/5e3e548a67bad339ba57f4678b9e221b/Calanthia_Concept_Art_-_1920.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Items: Added two new earring drops to the second encounter in Altar of Calanthia.[/p][/*][*][p]Items: Polished Crystals dropped during the Altar of Calanthia raid will now go directly to personal inventories and not into guild loot distribution.[/p][/*][*][p]Calanthia: Fixed an issue where the Fury attack indicator for Chain Lightning appeared for the wrong players.[/p][/*][*][p]Codex: Altar of Calanthia: Fixed an issue where the third stage of the Exploration Codex for the Altar of Calanthia raid didn't recognize completion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]The Forbidden Ritual milestone end date has been extended by two weeks to August 21. This milestone will unlock the new Altar of Calanthia Nightmare difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]New Accessories have been added, including set bonus effects for four different sets.[/p][list][*][p]These accessories provide additional defensive stats that pair well with the increased offensive power gained through upgrading Heroic raid weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]12 new Accessories can be acquired from each of the following sources:[/p][list][*][p]4-Star Dungeons and Dimensional Trials[/p][/*][*][p]All Things Workshop[/p][/*][*][p]Material Transmutation[/p][/*][*][p]Nightmare difficulty Hall of Illusion[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]14 new Accessories can be crafted from Crandace the Special Equipment Crafter, requiring a Lv. 12 version of their existing counterparts as material.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the level cap for Runes to level 90.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare quality Chaos Runes can now be obtained from a variety of gameplay sources.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Added a Nebula Accessory Chest purchasable at the Nebula Stone merchant for 350 Nebula Stones.[/p][/*][*][p]Weekly Missions: For the following two weeks, Chaos Prisms can be obtained through Weekly Mission rewards. These replace the previously available Entropy Shards.[/p][/*][*][p]Inter-Server Siege: The team with the most attempted throne captures will now properly determine results in the case of a tie between teams.[/p][/*][*][p]Inter-Server Siege: Fixed an issue causing all participation rewards for Inter-Server Sieges to get sent to a single guild.[/p][/*][*][p]Inter-Server Siege: Reduced the duration of the preparation time from 10 minutes to 4 minutes to reduce the overall wait time before matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Field Boss events: Reduced the duration of the preparation time from 5 minutes to 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Raid matchmaking: Your currently active raid progression is now selected by default when opening the Raid matchmaking or party board UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle Pass: The "Use Recovery Crystals" Battle Pass mission will now progress when using Precious Recovery Crystals.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator Mode: Fixed players incorrectly entering a dungeon or raid as a spectator if they were invited to join the group after previously observing them as a spectator.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement: Fixed abnormal rubberbanding at the top of waterfalls.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement: The camera will no longer rotate on its own when teleporting while moving the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings: Fixed a variety of UI issues that occurred if a non-default Contrast setting was used.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Fixed an issue causing a placeholder string to be shown in the Matchmaking Success popup.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: The search bar in the Party/Raid Board is no longer case-sensitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Console: The Chatbox Settings menu is no longer empty.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Combat[/h3][list][*][p]Wand: Vampiric Contract: Fixed an issue where the range for the passive effect was being determined by equipped weapon melee range.[/p][/*][*][p]Wand: Calanthia's Doctrine of Chaos now animates appropriately.[/p][/*][*][p]Longbow: Blitz can once again reset the cooldown of Swift Healing, Frenzied Sword Dance, and Valiant Brawl.[/p][/*][*][p]Longbow: Flash Wave's visual indicator now properly matches the ability's range.[/p][/*][*][p]Spear: Culling Arc will now automatically re-trigger when the respective Ability key is held down.[/p][/*][*][p]Sword and Shield: The Mastery effect Roar Amplifier now only activates on melee damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Items[/h3][list][*][p]Cordy's Warblade of Creeping Doom: Giant Cordy's Spore Poison effect now follows the victim of Death Blow.[/p][/*][*][p]Deluzhnoa's Serrated Shard: Increased Rising Slash damage by 60% for the Deluzhnoa's Waves effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Fixed an issue where Deluzhnoa's Cold effect would trigger even when blocking Arrow Vortex.[/p][/*][*][p]Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Deluzhnoa's Cold effect has been changed to deal damage to the first enemy hit by Arrow Vortex, then deal damage and collision effects to targets within a 3m radius.[/p][/*][*][p]Deluzhnoa's Edge of Eternal Frost: Replaced the Deluzhnoa's Annihilation effect with a new skill, Deluzhnoa's Touch.[/p][/*][*][p]Deluzhnoa's Touch: Controlling Rake's hit area width increased to 4m and reduces movement speed of all enemies in the area by 60%. On hit, increases damage reduction by 3 for 5 seconds, stacks up to 10 times.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Crypt of Augmentation[/h3][list][*][p]Velentra: Defense is reduced even further if Velentra is stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]Velentra: Reduced the hit radius of Velentra's Phantom Bullet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed icons and tooltips that appear when Velentra becomes charmed by players with the 'Echoes of Seduction' status.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Velentra's charm status would occasionally not be removed after being charmed by players with the 'Echoes of Seduction' status.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.17.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/840dec8eb269d07a14bb03a15cda2a602687bd3a.png"][/img][/p][p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.17.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 2 and last approximately 3.5 hours. Various improvements have been made to the Altar of Calanthia Raid. Find the full list of changes below.[/p][h2]Raid: Altar of Calanthia[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed Dragaryle to be fought outside its intended area.[/p][/*][*][p]The stairs leading to Calanthia during the third stage now always regenerate after wiping or exiting and re-entering the instance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that blocked progression in the first stage if the Arkeum Shadowmancer was killed before the respective objective had started.[/p][/*][*][p]Using Party Matchmaking to fill an empty slot no longer resets progress in the instance.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused players to be removed from the instance after another player joined via Party Matchmaking.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused players to get kicked when joining while a Spectator was present.[/p][/*][*][p]Stage progress is no longer reset upon transferring servers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where damage from Zairos' Shield Explosion mechanic could be blocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused a third player to be tethered during the Zairos/Vulkan chain mechanic on Difficult mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the arena to not reset in stage 2 if the Vanguard wipes just before Zairos and Vulkan transform into Radeth on Difficult mode. If this occurs, the fight will now automatically reset after 30 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 7/1: Players affected by Dragaryle’s Petrification cannot be healed after debuff expires.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 7/1: Resolved an issue that prevented the use of Entropy Shards locked before the 2.16.0 release. If you have shards in storage, removing them from storage will put them into your currency tab.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 7/1: Controller: Fixed the 'Select Role' popup issue that prevented matchmaking confirmation when role quotas weren't met.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 7/1: Controller: Corrected an issue that caused the D-Pad interaction to require multiple right presses to accept matchmaking invitations.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Heroic Equipment: Dissolving Trait Extracts from Heroic Equipment now properly grants 40x Precious Magic Powder instead of Entropy shown in the Auction House.[/p][/*][*][p]Items: The Windsheer Spear Lithograph can now be sold on the Auction House again.[/p][/*][*][p]Codex: Getting knocked back by Velentra at the start of her notes.title: Update 2.16.0
notes.content: [p][i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.16.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 25 and last approximately 5.5 hours. It includes the first 12-player Raid, Ascended Arch Bosses, and more. Find the full list of changes below.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="suODKOk1aOA;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Altar of Calanthia: 12-Player Raid[/h2][p]Vanquish Calanthia before her dream becomes a nightmare for all of Solisium. Fearsome bosses will attempt to stop you on your way to the altar. Upon your arrival, you’ll face the Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion.[/p][list][*][p]Complete the Two Wings of Sylvaeth Codex part I and II to enter Altar of Calanthia. Entry portals and related crafting NPCs can be found in the north end of Herba Village.[/p][/*][*][p]Party Matchmaking and Party Board listings for the Altar of Calanthia can be accessed through the Raid UI at the entry portal. The standard Party Matchmaking UI will not show the raid. Matchmaking can only be used to enter Normal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]The Raid matchmaking system will form two parties consisting of one tank, one healer, and four DPS roles. Pre-formed Vanguards do not have role restrictions on party formation. Teams can structure their Raid group as they prefer.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal mode requires players to be at least 5,000 Combat Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficult mode requires players to be at least 6,000 Combat Power. Difficult mode has increased boss stats, mechanics, and phases.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can complete and receive rewards from both Normal and Difficult mode each week.[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints: Defeating a boss in Altar of Calanthia counts as a checkpoint. Groups will be able to re-enter and pick up from checkpoints at a later time within the week. Players are not locked to specific group progress and can join multiple groups in a week. Defeating previous bosses again will not offer additional rewards until the week resets.[/p][/*][*][p]When a team is fully defeated on any boss in Normal Mode, all players will receive a damage and HP buffs for additional attempts. This buff stacks up to 10 times and can only be applied once every 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards: Each week, killing Calanthia on any difficulty guarantees a Heroic Armor or Weapon. Difficult mode offers higher chances for Weapon drops or Selection Chests instead of random drops. Heroic Accessories will be available alongside an even more difficult version of the Raid in the future.[/p][/*][*][p]Altar of Calanthia introduces two new materials: Entropy Shards and Chaos Prisms. These materials are used to make Heroic enhancement materials, Heroic Skill Core management items, and Heroic gear.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Solisium Style Pack[/h3][p]Transform your look with our biggest style update yet when the Solisium Style Pack comes to the Shop on June 26! Discover new hairstyles, hats, helmets, plus Dye and Sewing Thread to further personalize your favorite outfit.[/p][p][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4Yj5SXvt97fhIM75eh1Q11/90161516e1b1499bd23079751bc2007b/TL_Solisium_Style_Pack_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019407.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Solisium Style Pack includes:[/p][list][*][p]30x Illusion Scroll[/p][/*][*][p]100x Dye[/p][/*][*][p]40x Sewing Thread[/p][/*][*][p]Hairstyles: Polished, Free Spirit[/p][/*][*][p]Hats: Leather Bush Hat, Admiral’s Bicorne[/p][/*][*][p]Helmets: Crested Centurion, Basic Bruiser[/p][/*][/list][h3]Heroic Gear[/h3][list][*][p]The Altar of Calanthia raid introduces a new grade of equipment drops: Heroic grade.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters may only equip one Weapon and one Armor of Heroic grade at a time.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic grade is a higher grade than existing Epic gear. A base powered Heroic item is equivalent to a max enhanced Tier 2 Epic item.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic items have primary and secondary stats as well as three slots for traits, similar to other gear grades. They also have a Heroic Trait that enhances one of the 5 base stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic Weapons do not come with passive skills. Instead, you can extract the passive skill as a Skill Core from any Tier 1 Arch Boss Weapon or any Epic Tier 2 weapon and apply it to your Heroic weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Craft Skill Core items at the Skill Core NPC near the Altar of Calanthia Raid portal.[/p][/*][*][p]Heroic gear is leveled using the new craftable Heroic Growthstones as materials.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ascended Arch Bosses: Queen Bellandir and Tevent[/h3][list][*][p]New upgraded difficulty versions of arch bosses Tevent and Queen Bellandir are now on the weekly schedule:[/p][list][*][p]Ascended Arch Bosses take place at 4:00pm local server time on Tuesdays and Saturdays. The regular Queen Bellandir previously scheduled on Saturdays will now take place on Friday.[/p][/*][*][p]These new Arch Boss versions drop materials used to upgrade your existing Arch Boss weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 2 versions of the Tevent and Bellandir Arch Boss Weapons can now be crafted at any Weapon Crafter.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting a Tier 2 Arch Boss weapon requires a Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon of the same type as crafting material.[/p][/*][*][p]For the consumed Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon, all traits will be reset and do not carry over to the Tier 2 weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Tier 2 Arch Boss weapons have an enhanced weapon skill compared to their Tier 1 counterparts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Arena Season 2[/h3][list][*][p]Arena Season 2 will end at the start of maintenance.[/p][/*][*][p]A month-long 6v6 Arena event season will begin after maintenance completes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Markers: Ground markers can now be placed in the world to indicate tactical locations for your party.[/p][list][*][p]By default, the Party Leader has access to place ground markers, but permissions may be managed through the Party UI.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Observer Mode expansion: Observer Mode can now be activated on PvE content such as Raids, Guild Raids, Dimensional Trials, and more. Manage Observer mode settings through the Party Management UI.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Item Quickslots have been expanded from 4 slots to 8 slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Mastery: Tooltips for Weapon Mastery nodes now show the current stat benefit applied from the node, the value gained by the next level, and the value gained at max level.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Tax Delivery and Castle Siege now take place back-to-back on the same day instead of split across 2 weeks. The alternate week is now scheduled for Interserver Siege battles. These 2 events will cycle on a biweekly schedule.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing spawn protection provided when spawning during Sieges.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat: A variety of pre-set chat messages have been added that can be assigned to the ring menu for quick selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat: Message triggers may now be set to send pre-written chat messages based on activity triggers, like logins or party joins.[/p][/*][*][p]Riftstones and Boonstones: Increased the stat bonuses provided by Riftstone and Boonstone owner buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]Riftstones and Boonstones: Decreased the preparation timer at the start of Riftstone and Boonstone battles from 5 to 2 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Adjusted the portal location for the boss portal in Seal Sanctuary to be further south.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: Grimturg: Adjusted some cases where Grimturg unexpectedly moved during mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Urstella Fields: Adjusted mob density in some areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeons: 3 and 4-Star Dungeon reward chests may now be opened two times per run.[/p][/*][*][p]Nebula Island: The corruption debuff from Exodus will now be removed upon moving to a safe zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Contracts: Fixed an issue where interactable bottles in Talandre for the 'Collect Letters in a Bottle' contracts were only visible while within 5m of range.[/p][/*][*][p]Food: The buff granted by Enticing Cream Pudding now matches its description.[/p][/*][*][p]War Games: Players on different teams can no longer form a party together.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting: Fixed an issue where the quantity button was inactive when supplementing materials from a selection chest during crafting.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure Codex: Chapter 4: Fixed a case where the Rescue Operation codex could sometimes not be progressed.[/p][/*][*][p]Siege: Fixed a case where players could swap weapon types without incurring an intended ability cooldown.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Longbow[/h3][list][*][p]Flash Arrow: Increased area of effect by 2 meters. Now always attempts to hit, but the effect can be resisted by the target. On hit, applies a ranged evasion debuff to the target. Cooldown reduced from 60 seconds to 36 seconds, damage increased from 150% to 250%.[/p][/*][*][p]Brutal Arrow: Now increases damage by 40% against stunned or bound targets.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Mastery: Rhythmical Shooting: General weapon damage increases by 3~12 for 3 seconds each time you use different skills in sequence. Stacks up to 5 times.[/p][/*][*][p]Healing Touch: Added a fourth specialization that changes Healing Touch to a self-buff, adds a damage bonus when using longbow skills, but also reduces your movement speed for 4 seconds while active.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spear[/h3][list][*][p]Phoenix Barrage: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 91% of Base Damage +23, to 73% of Base Damage +19. Damage boost against monsters increased from 125% to 180%.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Fury: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 360% of Base Damage +100, to 288% of Base Damage +80. Damage boost against monsters increased from 40% to 75%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Dagger[/h3][list][*][p]Thundering Bomb: Reduced base damage. Reduced damage bonuses applied when striking from the back or when target is under Weaken effects. Damage boost against monsters increased from 15% to 40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Shadowy Escape: Fixed an issue where players would rarely teleport back to their casting point upon teleporting with Shadowy Escape.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Greatsword[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing Death Blow and Guillotine Blade to be canceled if used a 2nd time while it's being charged.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Staff[/h3][list][*][p]Burning Smokescreen: Added a short cooldown before a 2nd Burning Smokescreen can be used to prevent it from accidentally being cast twice.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Amitoi and Morphs: Tooltips on Amitoi and Morph icons now tell you if you've acquired that Amitoi or Morph.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller: Added the ability for controller shortcuts to be assigned to main menus such as Inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Matchmaking: Changing zones or closing a menu no longer closes the 'Matchmaking Successful' popup resulting in it being declined.[/p][/*][*][p]Trials: Fixed an issue causing Trial-specific Dungeon UI elements to rarely not be displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Codex: Fixed an issue causing the camera to occasionally get stuck when attempting to teleport to the Amitoi house while the camera pans during a cinematic scene.[/p][/*][*][p]PlayStation 5: The sun now appears without a black object in front of it.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.[/p]

notes.title: Raid: Altar of Calanthia
notes.content:
Vanquish Calanthia before her dream becomes a nightmare for all of Solisium. The Altar of Calanthia, our first 12-player Raid, launches on June 26. Catch up with Tico, godspeed, and the team at NCSOFT for an in-depth look at everything you need to know about this new PvE activity.

Our Raid deep dive video covers design, character, narrative decisions, and more. After the video, read on for insight into future Calanthia appearances, plus details on difficulty. We’ve also shared concept art featuring Altar of Calanthia environments.

[previewyoutube=uqLBiCLOEzU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion[/h2]
Fearsome bosses will attempt to stop you on your way to the altar. Upon your arrival, you’ll face the Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion.

[h3]Will players encounter Calanthia more in the future?[/h3]
NCSOFT: In the existing Adventure Codex, the player grows alongside the Resistance after coming from Whisp Island. Throughout their journey, they meet various characters and solve incidents, becoming a central figure in that organization.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1OnPHukfUVc253PqCNz2ly/e41401f0e71c2e99a542c131201e527d/Calanthia_Raid_-_Calanthia_Concept_Art_-_1920.jpg[/img]
Naturally, they also learn about key members, such as DaVinci and Janice Cartair, as well as important figures in Arkeum, like Reville Lupius, Calanthia, and Kazar. As part of the Adventure Codex and Bonus Codex updates releasing alongside the Raid, you will discover more not only about Calanthia but also about the stories of major Resistance figures, including Clay and Roen.

Experience the stories surrounding the Altar of Calanthia to find out whether you’ll encounter her more in the future.

[h2]Raid Difficulty[/h2]
Find out what kind of experiences players can look forward to when challenging more difficult modes.

[h3]How will the difficulty of future raids be expanded?[/h3]
NCSOFT: We are designing the difficulty to require both 'harmony' and 'growth'. It's not just about placing stronger enemies, but requiring organic party composition and individual role performance abilities.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4ebpbI2Rv2CJPkvCZxvY3Y/c4722b3ebde61fcb8653cad58627db40/Altar_of_Calanthia_-_Exterior_Entrance_Concept_Art_1920.jpg[/img]
Additionally, progressing to higher difficulty levels will require learnings gained from lower-level raid experiences. Each raid is designed to provide players with meaningful triumphant moments.

Given that [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] has many skilled PvE players, we have high expectations for their abilities. The hard difficulty mode of the Calanthia Raid is extremely challenging. Even top players will barely be able to clear it. However, as players regularly play it and acquire unique gear, the difficulty will gradually become more manageable.

For the future expert difficulty mode, players can expect an even more intense challenge. We can't wait to see players try it.

[h2]Altar of Calanthia Concept Art[/h2]
See how the Raid went from concept to execution through the following images.

[h3]Fire and Ice Arena[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4POjFciorXAgL0cDkGdXv9/8491f268276dcc1a7f17864fb7150dee/Altar_of_Calanthia_-_Fire_Arena_Concept_Art_1920.jpg[/img]

[h3]Calanthia[/h3]

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.14.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1AngRHW9BfbAsrsNaPF0Ef/3026e6932de5bda4d3a39f5d7b119b17/TL_Swamp-of-Silence_02_Final_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.14.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 11 and last approximately 6.5 hours. It includes the Archboss Guild Raid event, Road to Raid activities, and special login rewards. Find the full list of changes below.

[h2]Road to Raid[/h2]
[url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/road-to-raid-event]Road to Raid[/url] continues with additional rewards for Dimensional Trials as well as Dynamic Event player kills and assists (PvP). Whether you return to Nebula Island, Dimensional Trials, or look for new guild members, crafting with Abyss Contract Tokens will further improve your gear before your destined showdown against Calanthia on June 26.

Claim special login rewards to finish your Raid preparations during Storm's Eve from June 19 through 26.

[list]
[*] Day 1: 5x Random Chaos Rune Chests
[*] Day 2: 30x Rare Artifact Chance Chests
[*] Day 3: 50x Precious Rune Chance Chests
[*] Day 4: 4x Nebula Conquest Chests
[*] Day 5: 25x Adventure Coin: Loyalty
[*] Day 6: 10x Trait Resonance Stone
[*]  Day 7: 7x Chaos Soul Shard: Calanthia
[/list]
Milestone 10, "Vengeance Ascendant," leads up to the Raid, opening with in-game milestones to take part in.

[h3]Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2ldsN68Qy2mgmOlHnjJ7bS/6bc4643ff6eae59826d0fe4adfd9dcae/T_L_Launch_Team_Update_Screens_Tevent_v01_B_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Between June 12 and June 25, guilds will have access to a special version of the Tevent fight as a Guild Raid.
[*] The Guild Raid version of Tevent has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
[*] Guilds may enter the Tevent guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
[*] Defeating the Guild Raid version of Tevent will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
[/list]
[h3]Arena Season 2 Ending[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2AX7uOA3QNkt2rqsxecXc7/6f39e229b3d25fc4e58979769f39fdbe/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_Arenas_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
Arena Season 2 officially comes to a close on June 26th.

[h3]Crafting: Precious Recovery Crystals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Four new kinds of high-tier Recovery Crystals are now available for crafting via the Cooking skill.
[*] Recipes to craft these new Recovery Crystals can be purchased from the Contract Coin Merchant for 3,000 Contract Coins each.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Items: Rune chance boxes for non-Chaos runes now auto-open when acquired.
[*] War Games: Scoreboard healing values now only include applied healing amounts and do not count healing above full health.
[*] Wand: Vampiric Contract: Now grants its healing buffs when using targeted skills.
[*] Crypt of Augmentation: Adjusted boss abilities so they're less likely to kill revived players standing outside of the boss arena.
[*] Crypt of Augmentation: Fixed several issues preventing proper credit of exploration codex quests in this dungeon.
[*] Crypt of Augmentation: Fixed an issue where the door to the final boss arena would remain closed after the boss was defeated, preventing revived players from accessing the reward chest.
[*] Guild Raids: Equipment acquired from Guild Raids will no longer be tradeable.
[*] Field Boss: Players will no longer be pulled into the same instance as old party members after leaving a party that has signed up for a Dominion event, then signing up again.
[*] Dimensional Trials: Trials: Fixed an issue rarely resulting in Trial Season Rankings not updating after clearing a new tier.
[*] Arena: Defensive food buffs are now properly removed when entering the Arena.
[*] Arena: Additional ranking points are now granted during win streaks, as well as when breaking a lose streak.
[*] Codex: Fixed various interactable objects not appearing throughout the Adventure Codex quests.
[*] Codex: Wings of Sylaveth Part 1: Fixed an issue where a combat effect could get stuck when fighting Velentra.
[*] Adventure Codex: Adjusted the quest steps for Chapter 10 when dispelling the Moonlight Spell to make the necessary actions clearer.
[*] Nebula Island: Fixed a case where the Corruption debuff did not get removed even when leaving the boss area.
[*] Quests: Corrected the timing of some dialogues where auto-advancement took longer than it should to proceed.
[*] Wisp Island: Helpie's face will no longer appear distorted during the tutorial on Wisp Island.
[*] Cosmetics: Black Swan outfit: The transparent areas of this costume now properly show the texture beneath.
[*] Shop: Earring Runes can now be obtained from the Precious Rune Chance Chest available in the Ornate Coin section of the Shop.
[*] PC: Added a setting to limit FPS of the client to 30 FPS when not in focus.
[*] Cosmetics: As it cannot be dyed, the dye window will no longer appear when selecting the Checkpoint Officer Hat within the Mirror Boutique.
[*] Item: Wand: The Forbidden Demonic Lexicon appearance now properly matches its icon.
[/list]
[h3]Controls and UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Console: UI: Fixed a case where equipped weapon UI would not appear on the HUD after changing weapons.
[*] UI: Name transparency settings for non-selected characters now always apply even when no target is selected.
[*] Weekly Mission: Fixed the alignment of reward icons on the Weekly Mission Reward UI.
[*] Controller: Accepting a Party Matchmaking pop-up while viewing a product in the Shop will no longer result in the viewed product from being purchased as well.
[*] Controller: Custom chat tabs can now be renamed.
[*] Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Aftereffect Cure button from being usable.
[*] Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the conversation history output window from being scrolled.
[/list]
[h2]Nature’s Celebration Packs[/h2]
[url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/shop]Bronze, Silver, and Gold Nature’s Celebration Packs[/url] will be available at 10 a.m. PT on June 12.

[h3]Bronze[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3SC6zdzPBh1enJ2QYG6ssN/5dd1577962266813c88a8faa6f756bce/TL_Matures_Celebration_Pack_-_Bronze_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019220.jpg[/img]
Call upon the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Bronze. The Gigantrite Gneiss Amitoi is here to accompany you on your next quest alongside 1,125 Lucent.

[h3]Silver[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5tmkIIKJGsvpnd3OskRmhJ/30a9f1d22acb511a23a473ab42416616/TL_Natures_Celebration_Pack_-_Silver_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019221.jpg[/img]
Tap into the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Silver. Swim like a mobile fortress as the Castle Dracoryft Turtle morph and strike fear across the land as the Sigil Ursa dash morph. You'll also receive 2,875 Lucent.

[h3]Gold[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/25ONVHpYl71MrXKxRVGAVS/d9989d13cac0b366763d97f9271cfb22/TL_Natures_Celebration_Pack_-_Gold_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019222.jpg[/img]
Command the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Gold. Glide across Solisium as the majestic Barn Owl morph and leave a lasting impression on friends and foes with the Bloodcrystal Plate and Headpiece. This pack also includes 6,000 Lucent.

Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Battle Pass: Royal Star
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5goSuWdcBluwybn3ynR0RT/7263b1e5be54a5aac8daad1236f11084/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_01_Final_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Bring even more prestige to Solisium with the Royal Star Battle Pass, available now through July 3rd, 2 p.m. PT. It features the Royal Crown Armament Weapon Cosmetics, Whacky Thwump Amitoi, Stonegard Throne Pose, Plated Walaroo Dash Morph, and more.

Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

Learn more about the Royal Star rewards below and then explore answers to your [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/battle-pass-faq]most common questions[/url].

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3XLzzW5ehSO22yZFRNcNaO/f66c2c4886956f9f489a61be1430d506/TL_Battle_Pass_9_Royal_Star_Final_1920x1080_CT-000018800.jpg[/img]
There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot.
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track): Plated Walaroo Dash Morph
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track): Pose - Stonegard Throne
[*] Level 20 (Free Track): Pose - Oath
[*] Level 31 (Premium Track): Whacky Thwump Amitoi
[*] Level 50 (Free Track): Illusion Scroll
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track): Royal Crown Armament Selection Chest (Select 2 of the 8 weapon cosmetics)
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in the Royal Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals. Here are some of the featured items from the Royal Star Point Shop.
[list]
[*] (Premium only) All 8 Royal Crown Armament Weapon Cosmetics
[*] Rare Rune Category Selection Chest
[*] Precious Ore Selection Chest
[*] Trait Extraction & Conversion Stones
[*] Nebula Charge Stones
[*] Rare Artifact Chance Chests
[*] Weapon Mastery Experience
[*] Skill Conversion Books
[*] Trait Unlock Stones
[*] Precious Parchment
[*] and more!
[/list]
Want to learn more about how the Battle Pass works? Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/battle-pass-faq]FAQ[/url].

Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Omen of Chaos Event

[*] Pose: Mind Training
