[*] Precious Polished Crystal
[*] Precious Magic Powder
[*] Precious Ore Selection Chest
[*] Quality Stellarite
[/list]
Thanks for your support and stay tuned for more activities on the [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/news/articles/road-to-raid-event]Road to Raid[/url]. We’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Fortune's Calling Event
notes.content:
Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 11. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions for a chance to score extra rewards like the Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest throughout this event.

Following the completion of certain activities, players will receive Fortune Stones. Surpass Fortune Stone milestones for a chance to earn extra rewards, including a Black Anvil Weapon. Once enough players have collectively gathered enough Fortune Stones for a given reward, everyone who has at least 1 Fortune Stone will automatically receive guaranteed bonus loot, such as the Fire Crown.

Net highly desirable rewards, while also supporting your fellow adventurers on the Road to Raid.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5gwqq0CD1495l6UC4UfQnx/9d741666b3a28773ad8424757dfae861/TL_Fortunes_Calling_Weapon_Set_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019314.jpg[/img]
The chance of earning non-guaranteed rewards will change based on how many players complete the required number of activities. For example, if 1000 players reach the threshold for the Nebula Boss Accessory Selection Chest reward, everyone will have a 5% chance of obtaining it since only up to 50 these Chests can be awarded. All rewards will be distributed automatically in-game within 2 weeks of the event.
[h3]Growth Bundle[/h3]
[list]
[*] Includes: 50x Weapon Growthstones, 50x Armor Growthstone, 50x Accessory Growthstones, 50x Precious Skill Growth Books, 50x Precious Rune Chance Chests, 50x Rare Artifact Chance Chest, 50x 100,000 Weapon Mastery Seal, 5x Precious Chaos Rune Chance Chest
[*] Everyone that receives 750 Fortune Stones is guaranteed to receive this reward.
[/list]
[h3]Zenus Weapon Selection Chest[/h3]
[list]
[*] Everyone that receives 1000 Fortune Stones is guaranteed to receive this reward.
[*] Precious Growth Fruit Bundle x5
[*] This food buff grants 200% Weapon Mastery and Sollant for 1 hour.
[*] Everyone that receives 1750 Fortune Stones is guaranteed to receive this reward.
[/list]
[h3]Growth Bundle[/h3]
[list]
[*] Includes: 50x Weapon Growthstones, 50x Armor Growthstone, 50x Accessory Growthstones, 50x Precious Skill Growth Books, 50x Precious Rune Chance Chests, 50x Rare Artifact Chance Chest, 50x 100,000 Weapon Mastery Seal, 5x Precious Chaos Rune Chance Chest
[*] Everyone that receives 3000 Fortune Stones is guaranteed to receive this reward.
[/list]
[h3]Trait Resonance Stones x400[/h3]
[list]
[*] Out of everyone that reaches the 5000 Fortune Stones milestone, 50 randomly chosen players will receive this reward. If 50 or less players reach that milestone throughout the event, this reward will be guaranteed.
[*] If 2000 players surpass the 5000 Fortune Stones milestone, all players with at least 1 Fortune Stone will receive 20 Trait Resonance Stones.
[/list]
[h3]Non-Archboss Weapon Selection Chest (Select any Tier 2 weapon)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Out of everyone that reaches the 8000 Fortune Stones milestone, 50 randomly chosen players will receive this reward. If 50 or less players reach that milestone throughout the event, this reward will be guaranteed.
[*] If 1500 players surpass the 8000 Fortune Stones milestone, all players with at least 1 Fortune Stone will receive the Wave emote.
[/list]
[h3]Nebula Boss Accessory Selection Chest[/h3]
[list]
[*] Out of everyone that reaches the 9000 Fortune Stones milestone, 50 randomly chosen players will receive this reward. If 50 or less players reach that milestone throughout the event, this reward will be guaranteed.
[*] If 1000 players surpass the 9000 Fortune Stones milestone, all players with at least 1 Fortune Stone will receive the Free-Spirited Gneiss.
[/list]
[h3]Black Anvil Weapon[/h3]
[list]
[*] Out of everyone that reaches the 10,000 Fortune Stones milestone, 25 randomly chosen players will receive this reward. If 25 or less players reach that milestone throughout the event, this reward will be guaranteed.
[*] If 500 players surpass the 10,000 Fortune Stones milestone, all players with at least 1 Fortune Stone will receive 15 Obsidian Fragments.
[/list]
[h3]Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest (Any Tier 2 weapon from Giant Cordy and Deluzhnoa)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Out of everyone that reaches the 12,000 Fortune Stones milestone, 10 randomly chosen players will receive this reward. If 10 or less players reach that milestone throughout the event, this reward will be guaranteed.
[*] If 100 players surpass the 12,000 Fortune Stones milestone, all players with at least 1 Fortune Stone will receive the Fire Crown.
[/list]
[h2]Featured Activities[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6Ze4H3xRHLmP8tpLg5My21/ae958498596abd6299b50e80df697593/TL_New_and_Returning_Player_Guide_v01_A_1080_CT-000016184.jpeg[/img]
Each activity offers a different number of Fortune Stones.

[b]Resistance Contracts[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones: 3
[/list]
[b]Co-Op Dungeons[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones:
[*] 1-Star: 5, 2-Star: 10, 3-Star and 4-Star: 20
[/list]
[b]Dynamic Events[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones: 10
[/list]
[b]Field Bosses[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones:
[*] Participation: 7, Field Boss Dominion Victory: 12, Field Boss Guild Victory: 12
[/list]
[b]Amitoi Expeditions[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones: 2
[/list]
[b]Event Fishing[/b]
[list]
[*] Fortune Stones: 1 (35% chance)
[/list]
[b]Sollant spent
[/b][list]
[*] Fortune Stones: 80 for every 5M spent
[*] Sollant spent will be tallied and then players will receive their Fortune Stones at the end of the event. Sollant spent from purchasing things from NPCs will not count towards your total.
[/list]

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Void where prohibited. Open to players of Throne and Liberty who are at least 18 years old. Not open to players in Poland and Netherlands. Fortune Stones and Event Rewards can’t be substituted, transferred, or exchanged for cash.

Participation is subject to the [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/forward-link?id=amazon-terms]Amazon Games Terms of Use[/url], and Amazon Games reserves the right to modify or cancel the Event at any time or suspend or disqualify any player suspected of undermining the Event.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.12.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3Mc1DCfYy7t8mKtqeKwLBy/2a9ef0fcc46078432b88d15846ebbb25/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_03_Final_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.12.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 28 and last approximately 5 hours. Descend into the depths of a new 4-Star Co-Op Dungeon, gain more power with new Earring equipment, and experience new events on your Road to Raid. We also have a new episode of Tico Talks covering the latest updates.

Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.

[h2]Tico Talks[/h2]
[previewyoutube=g88JpOz5bU0;full][/previewyoutube]
Welcome back to Tico Talks, featuring THRONE AND LIBERTY Globalization Design Manager, Tico. This episode covers Raid gear, PvP meta changes, Dimensional Trials, Nebula Island, and Interserver Castle Siege. What do you think is going to be the meta for beating the raid? Let us know your answer to this episode's community question in the comments section of our YouTube video or on [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]​4-Star Co-Op Dungeon: Crypt of Augmentation[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2MKziWC3kNjIc5oKw3u4sW/fe935b5ef918767d1602552a77fffcda/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_01_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019299.jpg[/img]
Confront the necromancer Velentra in the Crypt of Augmentation for substantial rewards, including essential Tier 2 equipment drops, that will accelerate your gear progression. Once a professor of light magic at Venelux, Velentra's life changed forever when she witnessed the extraordinary powers of the Arkeum knight Calanthia. Now transformed by dark magic, this mysterious necromancer stands before us, commanding ancient powers in devoted service to her dark mistress.

The Crypt of Augmentation will require a Combat Power of 5000 to enter. Master it for an easier time against Calanthia no matter how badly she wants your Star Fragment.

[h3]Earrings - New Equipment Slot[/h3]
A new accessory equipment slot has been added: Earrings!
[list]
[*] The Earring slot is available automatically to all characters after the 2.12.0 update.
[*] Earrings can be acquired through various content such as Tier 2 tokens at the All Things Merchant, Nebula Island, Co-Op and Solo Dungeons, and Talandre Arch Bosses.
[/list]
[h3]Combat Update - Positional Attacks[/h3]
[list]
[*] The combat system now recognizes when an attack comes from front, rear, or flanking directions.
[*] Multiple abilities have been updated with positional damage or effects based on attacking from the flank or rear of the target, so take a moment to review your skills for potential benefits!
[/list]
[h3]Interserver Siege[/h3]
[list]
[*] Castle-owning Alliances can now take part in an Interserver Siege event every 3 weeks, pitting castle owners on different servers against each other in Siege combat.
[*] Alliances will be paired up and both sides will have an opportunity to attack and defend.
[*] A portion of tax revenue from each participating server will be added to the reward pool, and divided among the participating alliances based on the outcome of the battle.
[*] Emerging victorious will reward participants with a temporary title, temporary cloak cosmetic, chaos runes, and consumables.
[*] Victorious alliances will also bring a 48-hour server wide buff to their home server, granting all players on that server increased Abyss Point efficiency and combat damage bonus.
[*] The less-victorious Alliance members will receive a selection of consumables and chaos runes for their efforts.
[*] The first Interserver Siege is slated to take place June 15, with eligible participants based on the outcome of the regular Sieges on June 1.
[/list]
[h3]Mystic Globe Sollant Event[/h3]
Mystic Globes and Mystic Portals have inexplicably been swapped for Lucky Bags. Gather Lucky Bags around Solisium from May 29 until maintenance on June 11 for additional rewards and Sollant items.

[h3]Fortune’s Calling Event[/h3]
Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 11. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions for a chance to net extra rewards like the Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest.

[h3]Color Craft: Amitoi Edition Winner[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1RgJdrPhgx3NrhHWKlU3XJ/b6f4880302c77cfa80a1123a8420bdd1/TL_Amitoi_Coloring_Contest_Final_1920x1080_CT-000018962__1_.jpg[/img]
We asked you to color in Growling Wolfie Amitoi images with your own personal touch as part of the Color Craft: Amitoi Edition Discord event. Following the final community vote, we’re excited to announce the winner in [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Discord[/url]. Their Amitoi will be added to the game as a future reward.

[h3]New Codex Entries[/h3]
New Adventure and Extra Codex entries have been added with additional story quests and rewards.
[list]
[*] Interlude: The Order of the Swan and Extra: Two Wings of Sylvaeth introduce story related to the upcoming raid release.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collection Codex: Added the Miscellaneous Collection Codex with additional collections to complete and new rewards, including materials and profile frames.
[*] Morphs: Increased the level cap for Dash, Glide, and Swim Morph levels and bonuses!
[*] Nebula Island: Combined basic and greater Nebula Stone merchants into a single shop merchant.
[*] Field Boss: Players will no longer be pulled into a Dominion event after leaving the party that signed up for it.
[*] Events: Festival of Fire: Fixed a rare issue causing Phase 2 to not complete after extinguishing all fires around a Chief Priest's Brazier.
[*] Cooking: Enticing Cream Pudding: Changed the bonus Wildkin damage and resistance effect to bonus Construct damage and resistance effect.
[*] Cooking: Added more types of Cooking contracts to the Contract NPCs in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre. This should also fix cases where players ran into empty Cooking contract lists when pursuing them.
[*] PvP: Removed the setting for 'Always Use Amitoi Recovery in PvP Combat' which did not actually use recovery items.
[*] Siege: Slightly increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing applied when respawning during Siege or Tax Delivery events.
[*] Crimson Manor: Fixed an area where players could get stuck if landing from a glide near Snowburn Summit.
[*] Cosmetics: Fixed various rendering issues with the Casual Chic outfit.
[*] PlayStation-Only Servers: New characters created on PlayStation-Only servers will once again receive a complimentary server transfer ticket.
[*] Controller: Fixed a rare issue causing UI navigation to continue even after the joystick was released.
[*] Console: Xbox Series S: Fixed an issue causing NPC's to occasionally T-pose upon log in.
[*] Voice Chat: Fixed an issue causing voice chat to deactivate when entering/exiting instances.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party Matchmaking: Added the ability to sort the list of available dungeons and Dimensional Trials in ascending or descending difficulty.
[*] Targeting: Added icons to Boss NPCs to indicate their Boss status.
[*] Guild: Adjusted the layout of the Guild UI to reduce the size of the Friendly Guild list and display more Guild Notices.
[*] HUD: Weather info will no longer be hidden after collapsing then expanding the minimap.
[*] HUD: Icons on the minimap are now displayed correctly when the minimap size is expanded beyond the default setting.
[*] Minimap: Fixed an issue where icons for former party members could remain visible on the minimap.
[*] Minimap: Added options to allow or prevent click interactions on the minimap.
[*] Settings: Added options to allow rotating character in place through mouse drag.
[*] Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of visual effects.
[*] Settings: Fixed an issue preventing some HUD UI sizes from being selectable in the Settings menu.
[*] Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of floating damage numbers.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stats: Added new bonus effects for reaching stat values of 80 or more.
[*] Items: You can now receive buff effects from both attack and defensive food at the same time.
[*] Akman's Bloodletting Crossbow: Akman's Fragment effect will now only trigger when the Selfless Diffusion skill is active.
[/list]
[h3]Crossbow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wild Barrage: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be displayed in some locations when the Wild Barrage specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
[*] Nimble Leap: Whirlpool Specialization: Movement speed increase within the Whirlpool area reduced from 20% to 15%.
[*] Wind Snatcher: Maximum movement speed bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.
[*] Mastery: Agile Strike: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 3% to 2%.
[*] Mastery: Mirage Dancer: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 10% to 8%.
[/list]
[h3]Dagger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camouflage Cloak: Duration reduced by 3 seconds. Slightly reduced the duration extension provided through specialization.
[/list]
[h3]Greatsword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Reckless Assault: Fixed an issue where Reckless Assault was not applying the additional 50% boost to Raging Frenzy.
[*] Blood Devotion: After being affected by Blood Devotion, players will now be unable to receive the affects of Blood Devotion again for 45 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Longbow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Healing Touch: The amount of healing provided has been reduced by 16%.
[*] Blitz: Can no longer reset the cooldown on Wand's Fountain of Life.
[/list]
[h3]Spear[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rupture: Fixed an issue where Rupture ignored Weaken Resistance.
[*] Predator: Added a function to Predator that removes stacking recovery effects applied by player skills in the order they were most recently applied, one stack at a time.
[/list]
[h3]Sword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Provoking Roar: This ability now forces the user to the top of the target's aggro list for 6 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Wand[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blessed Barrier: Fixed an issue causing the player's Buff Duration Bonus to not apply to the secondary buff applied by Blessed Barrier.
[*] Swift Healing: Mana cost of tier 2 and 3 Swift Healing has been reduced to match the cost of Tier 1, however the amount healed by tier 2 and 3 is also reduced.
[/list]
[h3]War Games[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spectator Mode: Additional features added to Spectator Mode including quick-swap saves for following specific characters, UI improvements to reduce on-screen clutter, and camera rotation sensitivity settings.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck underground when entering a War Games match as a Spectator while dead.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Spectators to occasionally swap from Tracking Mode to Free Roam Mode without input.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck when navigating to specific areas.
[*] Portals and Pitons can no longer be targeted while in Spectator mode.
[*] The Camera Speed setting now affects the camera's zoom in/out speed as well.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Road to Raid Event
notes.content:
Calanthia awaits in our first 12-player Raid, Altar of Calanthia, on June 26. Join Road to Raid activities starting on May 29 for rewards that will prepare you to face the Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion.

Road to Raid will feature different content every few weeks, like an adventure through your favorite game modes. The first two weeks kick off the event with Co-Op Dungeons and Field Bosses. The festivities will continue in the following weeks via Dimensional Trials and Nebula Island. Looking for tougher challenges? A new variant of Tevent with different mechanics will also wreck havoc for a limited time.

While you’re improving your gear, Calanthia will be preparing a ritual to resurrect Revillele Lupius. Vanquish Calanthia in the Raid before her dream becomes a nightmare for all of Solisium. Altar of Calanthia will launch with both normal and hard difficulties. Look forward to more information on a third difficulty tier in the future.

[h2]Schedule[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3kcQtjHKdwSOLFblzzkBrX/2a325f11c86161c4895a6494f253d9c9/XX_NAME_Final_1920x1080_XX_CT.jpg[/img]
To best prepare players for their fated clash with Calanthia, every few weeks will include progressively more difficult content, plus increasingly more desirable rewards. Specific activities and bonus rewards can also be found in the weekly completion tab.

[h3]Phase 1[/h3]
Week 1 (May 29 - June 5) and Week 3 (June 12 - 19) include:
[list]
[*] Co-Op Dungeon completion: 7M Sollant.
[*] Field Boss participation and kills: 60 Rare Artifact Selection Chests.
[*] Mystic Globe Sollant Event: Mystic Globes and Mystic Portals have inexplicably been swapped for Lucky Bags. Gather Lucky Bags around Solisium for additional rewards and Sollant items.
[/list]
After you’ve claimed your additional rewards, set forth alone in Solo Dungeons, gather your guild for Abyss Dungeons, and then challenge Field Bosses.

[h3]Fortune’s Calling Event[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6Ze4H3xRHLmP8tpLg5My21/ae958498596abd6299b50e80df697593/TL_New_and_Returning_Player_Guide_v01_A_1080_CT-000016184.jpeg[/img]
Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 4. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions to score. Based on your progress, you’ll earn tiered rewards to bolster your power.

[h3]Omen of Chaos Event[/h3]
Earn extra rewards from June 5 through June 26 by gathering Traces of Chaos from activities like Amitoi Expeditions, Mystic Portals, and more. Stay tuned for more details closer to the event.

[h3]Phase 2 [/h3]
Week 2 (June 5 - 12) and Week 4 (June 19 - 26) include:
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trial completion: 12 Nebula Conquest Chests.
[*] Dynamic Event Player Kills and Assists (PvP): 12 Nebula Conquest Chests.
[/list]
Make your Nebula Conquest Chest rewards the first of many more. Whether you return to Nebula Island, Dimensional Trials, or look for new guild members, crafting with Abyss Contract Tokens will further improve your gear before your destined showdown.

[h3]Guild Raid Archboss: Tevent[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2ldsN68Qy2mgmOlHnjJ7bS/6bc4643ff6eae59826d0fe4adfd9dcae/T_L_Launch_Team_Update_Screens_Tevent_v01_B_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Tevent has been defeated countless times, but they’re ready for revenge from June 12 through June 29. Conquer new mechanics and discover altered loot tables as you take on a trickier variant of this familiar foe.

Thanks for your support! Gather your guild and get ready for Calanthia. We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.10.0
notes.content:
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.10.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 14 and last approximately 3 hours. Queen Bellandir has been defeated countless times, but they’re ready for revenge from May 15 through May 29. Conquer new mechanics and discover altered loot tables as you take on a trickier variant of this familiar foe. Bonus weapon mastery points and expedited fishing progression will also be available from May 15 through May 22.

Find the full list of changes below.

[h3]Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Between May 15 and May 29, guilds will have access to a special version of the Queen Bellandir fight as a Guild Raid.
[*] The Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
[*] Guilds may enter the Queen Bellandir guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
[*] Defeating the Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
[/list]
[h3]Fishing Bonuses: Special Bait Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pick up special Fishing Bait from event NPCs in Kastleton, Vienta Village, and Herba Village between May 15 and May 22 and get to your nearest shoreline to put it to use!
[*] Anglers of all levels can benefit from this bait, as it can catch special fish that provide bonus Fishing experience as well as additional items when reeled in.
[/list]
[h3]War Games - Spectator Mode[/h3]
This update adds Spectator Mode cameras that allow anyone to watch the action during a War Games match.
[list]
[*] Browse the list of upcoming War Games and join public matches as a Spectator. Match owners retain control over whether matches are public or private, and the access of individual participants including spectators.
[*] Both Free Camera and Target Follow Camera options are available in Spectator Mode.
[*] Free Camera allows you to fly around the match space to view any part of the action that most interests you, or set up to view critical map points.
[*] You can also save specific camera angles to function keys and quickly swap between them later.
[*] Follow Camera lets you select the player you wish to follow from the list of active players in the match to lock the camera to their movement.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] After reviewing player feedback and gameplay data, equipment drop rates will be slightly increased across a variety of content, with an emphasis on increased accessibility of Tier 2 equipment.
[*] Boss-type content: Guild Raids, Field Bosses
[*] Dungeon content: 3-Star Dungeons, Hall of Illusion
[*] Open-world Content: Abyss Dungeons, Nebula Island (Blessing Pouches and Conquest Chests)
[*] Material Transmutation rewards
[*] All Things Workshop: Added a variety of miscellaneous crafting recipes that exist on other crafting merchants to the All Things Workshop.
[*] Guilds: Added the option to teleport to zones currently controlled by the guild through the Guild UI.
[*] Map: Added the ability to share your map pins to others via chat link, by either selecting the link button on the pin or by Alt-Left Clicking the pin.
[*] Chat: Added a category for recently used stickers to make them more quickly accessible.
[*] Party Board: Added the ability to Favorite individual Party Board categories and view them through the shorter Favorites list.
[*] Codex: Players will no longer be stuck in an invisible state when exiting the instanced area during the One-Eyed Hawk Exploration Codex in Urstella Fields.
[*] Crimson Manor: Adjusted the event area of 'Best Way to Prevent the Worst' so it no longer overlaps with the waypoint.
[*] Grayclaw Forest: Wolf King Hill: Fixed a spot where players were blocked by unexpected collision.
[*] Localization: Updated tooltips on several abilities for clarity on how they function.
[*] Vanguards: Fixed an issue where the previous Vanguard leader would still be labeled as such after changing Vanguard leadership.
[*] PlayStation 5: Controllers will now vibrate again when playing on PlayStation 5.
[*] Controller: Cooking: Results are now immediately shown when using the search bar in the Cooking menu.
[*] Morphs: A Swim Morph will no longer be entered when using a Dash Morph in shallow water.
[*] HUD: Removed the red dot notification from the Upcoming Schedule widget.
[*] Party: Party invitations are now automatically declined upon changing instances.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the camera shake effect when being hit by broad area effect abilities.
[*] Staff: Fixed an issue causing the Mana Regen effect from Inner Peace to be lost upon receiving a CC effect while the Immune to CC Specialization was active.
[*] Crossbow: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be shown in various locations when the Wild Barrage Specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
[*] Wand: Ray of Disaster now deals damage to moving targets.
[*] Greatsword: Mastery: The Reckless Assault Mastery Node now grants the described effects.
[/list]
[h3]Cosmetics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the VFX on the Dawnlight Crossbows weapon skin to be displayed in the incorrect position.
[*] Fixed an issue causing lightning VFX to not be shown on parts of the Stormcaller Shroud outfit.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the book to be held upside down when the Abyssal Wand weapon skin was equipped.
[*] The Adventurous Pioneer outfit can now be dyed.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Wilds of Talandre: World Design
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4qR7G95NqmB6uYyF2E39tN/1e2ae110bf1ea76d017abda3f9e94214/01_Talandre__Illustration_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i]: Wilds of Talandre introduces new diverse environments to Solisium. From an ancient library hidden within the cliffs of a lake to the ruins of a fallen ancient giant, NCSoft iterated on multiple concepts before doubling the size of their world. We caught up with the Development Team for insights into how they meticulously crafted some of the free expansion’s most memorable areas.

[h3]Herba Village[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5W3AHNyzo6LzjxWzFV1cfz/2f547fd4a1b57fece9a475f0879117d8/Herba_Village_concept_art_1920_1080.jpg[/img]
Herba Village’s wind wheel lift is located at the highest point in the center of Talandre, allowing players to easily take in the landscape of the new zone. The wind car routes were also designed with this in mind. We spent a lot of time thinking about what a flying chariot in THRONE AND LIBERTY would look like. Using magical elements only felt too artificial and predictable, so we started with the concept of a modern-day cable car and explored ways to make it feel as medieval as possible.
[list]
[*] An aerial transportation system using massive chains or ropes.
[*] Operated manually or powered by wind, using cogs and pulleys.
[*] A large rotating wheel that winds and unwinds the rope to create movement, similar to a quarry pulley system.
[/list]
It’s not just a simple means of transportation, but an open-air design that allows players to fully appreciate the breathtaking vistas of Talandre.

[h3]Bercant Mansion[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3xonQuaIY8s6GQhDpN7Kzk/4711a94f7dc36f9f075223c402d48921/06_Talandre_Bercant_Mansion_Illustration_1920.jpg[/img]
We referenced the layouts of various castles and mansions to make Bercant Mansion feel like an actual home of a powerful noble faction. As a result, the Bercant Masion features a unique architectural style not seen in existing zones, designed with the goal of leaving a strong impact on players.

Inspired by the ornate exterior of the Louvre, we prioritized stylistic distinction over historical accuracy. The mansion tells the tragic story of Limuny Bercant. We reinforced this narrative visually by contrasting its elegant architecture with the dilapidated village and desolate farmland outside. Inside, we used red as a key accent color to create a sense of opulence, standing in stark contrast to the desaturated tones of the exterior.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3w8CliH6kHJjnWfyxXHMck/a528450cdfd8eef9958d10f63ada5f34/Bercant_Mansion_02_1920.jpg[/img]
In the audience chamber, where Limuny appears as the boss, the most beautiful red tree in the realm ironically emphasizes the theme of a cursed transformation into nature.

We aimed to create a dramatic contrast between the mansion’s interior and exterior for a truly memorable scene. This area serves as a key visual representation of the game’s story and themes, designed to leave a lasting impression and enhance player immersion.

[h3]Temple of Truth[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/12k3OdtzzYvzdlsEeAlDfH/d84ffd17e35a199ecdd0382dd7d06b64/Temple_of_Truth_02_1920.jpg[/img]
The Temple of Truth was inspired by an ancient library hidden within the cliffs of a lake. To emphasize the mystery of antiquity and the passage of time, it features a concealed entrance and ancient architecture.

We made the ancient and mysterious characters luminescent to express the mystical power of the library, while the crumbling and ruined appearance further emphasizes the passage of time. As for the theme of recording facts and history, what better choice than a library?

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7ct3suPqiuG3Xei3zzcQzm/3f06c4acd62627641f7c9eb5e3cf9a35/Temple_of_Truth_03_1920.jpg[/img]
This is a place where ancient records transform into truth, surrounded by enormous inscriptions. Here players will confront knowledge long thought lost to time.
[h3]
Quietis’ Demesne[/h3]
This region originates from Quietis, a giant who ruled over water. We wanted to convey the events that took place here in the past. Said to be the most powerful of the ancient giants, Quietis lost his heart in a war against a coalition of humans, elves, and orcs. He was then petrified and became Conquest of Quietis, a land that still bears the scars of battle.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4u2TVTnW9euVrSW4YhGNss/dfee1bd4635d8a7ec197dee4f92feb93/Quietis_s_Demesne_03_1920.jpg[/img]
The concept for this area is a landscape of ruins intertwined with the undulating terrain formed when Quietis lost his heart and collapsed.

The Guardian’s Forest: This area represents the aftermath of Quietis’ fall, where the ground has cracked open, releasing powerful magical energy. We envisioned this mystical forest as a place where destruction and magic intertwine creating an awe-inspiring yet eerie atmosphere.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/RxuonAxP5DSN4wNKseGK1/74a7eff162fefde6172fdefbdc8e5a5c/Quietis_s_Demesne_01_1920.jpg[/img]
The Scream of Quietis: This area depicts Quietis turning to stone and merging with nature. The landscape reflects a forgotten history, where remnants of past wars and myths are woven into the terrain itself. I remember working on this area with the idea that players could engage in battle on the back of the fallen Quietis.

Conquest Battles: This stage features a steep ravine leading to a circular battleground. The ravine is filled with massive boulders, shattered by Quietis’ impact and tangled with vines and tree roots that have emerged through the cracks. We designed this area with a specific contrast in mind. After crossing the harsh and treacherous bridge, players will arrive at a calm and serene battlefield.

[h3]Black Anvil Forge[/h3]
The dwarves established a civilized settlement even in the harsh terrain, possessing their own unique culture and technological prowess. This explains the advanced transportation elements such as elevators and minecarts throughout the area. From their weapons and armor to their architecture, everything in this region was forged from powerful ores.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/423vjfuxmpyXT6D7CfyhWM/37adaca1ff46bb3e935cd919b61495a3/Black_Anvil_Forge_03_1920.jpg[/img]
We wanted to use iconic colors to represent the harsh environment and strength of the dwarves:
[list]
[*] Red soil symbolizes a land filled with both life and hardship.
[*] Black stone architecture features sharp, angular, and geometric designs, emphasizing the dwarves’ strength and grandeur rather than soft, rounded shapes. We believed that incorporating stone and metal elements was essential to enhance the medieval fantasy aesthetic.
[*] Green minerals, the source of both dwarven vitality and magic, serve as a striking highlight, adding depth to the overall concept.
[/list]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5R43GQ5oHWcTV6zdl2AaPc/77743186e4fd5c8713df2cf930e2516e/03_Talandre__Black_Anvil_Forge_Illustration_1920.jpg[/img]
Through these three symbolic elements, our goal was to create a distinct region that reflects the dwarves’ advanced craftsmanship and ingenuity.

[h3]Crimson Manor House[/h3]
The Crimson Manor House follows the same architectural style as the Bercant Mansion, but with a rougher and more grotesque emphasis. The basement laboratory within the mansion combines elements of a prison, laboratory, and bone-themed design, adding to the dark atmosphere of the Crimson family.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7DbnFhStNmcEq8aeQvXPai/a14d989e996e8674c3fb75028b7f0885/Crimson_Manor_House_06_1920.jpg[/img]
Through this eerie design, we strove to suggest that sinister and secretive experiments took place here. The Snowburn Highlands and Manor Fields are desolate regions abandoned by humans. Now they’re ruled by wild monsters, conveying the concept of a raw and untamed wilderness.

We drew inspiration from the Dolomite landscapes of Italy, and designed areas outside of the Crimson Manor with stone-carved objects, mushroom-like peaks, and lakes of awakening, making them appear as if overtaken by unusual flora. These design elements act as symbolic representations of nature’s beauty and the hidden dangers within, creating a powerful visual storytelling experience.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3tFBNUuDeB9MgoovNEXBl4/0afa4dd096d76c66431af53b6f4fd1b7/Crimson_Manor_02_1920.jpg[/img]

[h3]Swamp of Silence[/h3]
The Swamp of Silence is the game’s most frequently changing environment. The water level of the entire swamp fluctuates due to various factors such as day and night, clear skies, and rain, subtly altering the gameplay experience.

Long ago it was once a vast ocean, but became a swamp after the sudden disappearance of the seawater. The sharks that couldn’t escape in time endured years of suffering, but over generations of adaptation evolved into the dominant predators of the marsh. Based on this backstory, we designed the area to feel dark and desolate, emphasizing the harsh natural environmental and its bleak atmosphere.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/73Sc1FG9cy5HO5OcWfkuyW/71a699ba72b5c7d948144bfb77f26a6f/05_Talandre__Swamp_of_Silence_Illustration_1920.jpg[/img]

The Swamp of Silence is divided into two distinct zones:
[list]
[*] River Swamp: We aimed to capture the natural feel of green landscapes by incorporating vegetative elements such as ferns, moss, aquatic plants, and lotus flowers.
[*] Sea Swamp: This area is shrouded in mist, limiting visibility and adding to its mysterious and desolate feel.
[/list]
We placed wrecked ships that couldn’t escape when the seawater receded, and Minutrite creatures lying in pain and mud, partially obscured by the fog. This enhanced the sense of secrecy and abandonment.

Exploring this region, players will notice unique rock formations scattered throughout. Though the final in-game implementation changed slightly, the original concept featured large rocks with cavernous holes, each housing evolved sharks. To capture the texture of these rocks, we drew inspiration from naturally eroded and weathered stones, formed over thousands of years.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7ixW5jcXELguRdUXOWGxVn/a60b9280a01b238fbc8b661303d44d54/Swamp_of_Silence_06_1920.jpg[/img]
One final standout element in this area is the rotating ship. It was designed with the concept of a ghostly vessel drifting in the current, endlessly circling the same spot. This dynamic element was carefully integrated to balance the stillness of the marsh with motion. We wanted to create a harmonious yet eerie atmosphere.

[h3]Forest of the Great Tree[/h3]
Amidst countless trees in this region stands the majestic Ancient Tree of the Sage, the most magnificent of them all. Talandre is now a ruin and left with scars due to the long wars, but the ancient tree remains unchanged, preserving its timeless beauty.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/34zETLGsLcdSDb8iqBgJh6/6786799c1dd5b6430adfc0e3597abb59/04_Talandre__Forest_of_the_Great_Tree_Illustration_1920.jpg[/img]
The concept for the Forest of the Great Tree is based on a mystical and spiritual place where ancient elves once taught magic to humans. We designed the silhouette to ensure that the elven architecture and the grand ancient tree blend naturally, emphasizing the idea that this sacred tree protects the elves.

At night, the tree emits a soft, ethereal glow, further enhancing its mysterious aura. Inspired by Yggdrasil from Norse mythology, our focus was on showcasing the immense scale of the tree, avoiding overly complex structures to allow its grandeur to be immediately captivating.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5j4AoXSszgoVO8hHwC1zGm/d456aab94e5702917a3f1c8972c14184/Talandre__Forest_of_the_Great_Tree_03_1920.jpg[/img]
Let us know which area in the new zone is your favorite. Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: May Community Events
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7iMGYhkLh2eL0zKjv3F1DK/46a3d58764bc73b799b6a51be3d30543/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_Traversal_B_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Join activities like Mystic Portal: Treasure Hunt, Fortune’s Calling, and special Archboss Guild Raids throughout this month. These events are more than just fun twists on your favorite game modes. From Conquest Battles with over one million Lucent on the line to a Queen Bellandir Archboss variant featuring new loot and mechanics, we want your accomplishments to be even more rewarding.

Here’s everything you need to know about the upcoming community events.

[h3]Mystic Portal: Treasure Hunt[/h3]
Hunt down hidden treasure chests now through May 15 for a variety of spoils, including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials. Each day you’ll receive a Mystic Key as a login reward. Use Mystic Keys to open Mystic Portals across Solisium. Solve puzzles and finish the minigame to claim your prizes.

[h3]Fishing Bonuses[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6J82t5U95XGnrqpESiE888/43b30fa9d63a546380899d5ae17ad87e/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_LifeStyle_B_1080_CT-000015060__1_.jpeg[/img]
Extra weapon specialization points and expedited fishing progression will also be available from May 15 through May 22. Craft special bait, find your preferred fishing spot, and reel in event-specific rewards. It’s the perfect chance to get into fishing or brush up on your bait.

[h3]Color Craft: Amitoi Edition[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6tzEojG7hinx9jr0IOWscc/0b0fbae9413ee44dcf87356fda70f1ac/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_Amitoi_B_1080_CT-000015060.jpeg[/img]
This is your chance to directly influence future Amitoi. Mark your calendar for May 15 and get ready to color a new Amitoi. We’ll provide images for you to color with your own personal touch before the May 22 deadline. Players will then vote on their favorite Amitoi. The most popular choice will be added to the game as a future reward. More details to come.

[h3]Archboss Guild Raid[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/LS7c8CLzb6sgA23GfM9V8/582680bb8d0b3209f0a4dc97cbdc2768/T_L_Launch_Team_Update_Screens_QueenBellandr_v01_B_1080.jpeg[/img]
Queen Bellandir has been defeated countless times, but they’re ready for revenge from May 15 through May 29. Conquer new mechanics and discover altered loot tables as you take on a trickier variant of this familiar foe.

[h3]Blue Squadron Best in Guild Talandre Championship Series[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/zUnx1LoYf0Cnb53BnYeoo/e7e45e6865a14920579d71a7f02d23f6/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_ConquestBattles_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/blue_squadron]Blue Squadron[/url] is back with another THRONE AND LIBERTY tournament, and this time the stakes are even greater. Leave your mark on Solisium as the winner of the Best in Guild Talandre Championship Series for your share of the 1,300,000 Lucent prize pool.

Sign your guild up to participate in this massive Conquest Battle competition on May 26 through June 21. Sign up and learn more in Blue Squadron’s regional Discords:
[list]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/BGMXcuU5Gc]NA - East Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/SyVRfw9wJA]NA - West Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.com/invite/M72EB5ZP5a]EU - Discord[/url]
[/list]
We’ll post another article reminding players to tune into their favorite streamers once the event kicks off.

[i]Disclaimer: This tournament is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or otherwise associated with THRONE AND LIBERTY. Blue Squadron is solely responsible for the operation of this tournament, including signing up participants, running the tournament and ensuring prizes are distributed to winners.
[/i]
[h3]Fortune’s Calling[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6Ze4H3xRHLmP8tpLg5My21/ae958498596abd6299b50e80df697593/TL_New_and_Returning_Player_Guide_v01_A_1080_CT-000016184.jpeg[/img]
Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 4. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions to score. Based on your progress, you’ll earn tiered rewards to bolster your power!

Look forward to more details closer to the event.

[h3]Mystic Globe Sollant Event[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5hJ9mduo4odwcbEdAvRXRc/2ee23022eecaef861c522bb749056471/TL_New_and_Returning_Player_Guide_v01_B_1080_CT-000016184.jpeg[/img]
Mystic Globes and Mystic Portals have inexplicably been swapped for Lucky Bags. Gather Lucky Bags around Solisium from May 29 until June 12 for additional rewards and Sollant items. Stay tuned for the full list of rewards closer to the event.

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.8.0
notes.content:
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Update 2.8.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 30 and last up to 3 hours. Search for treasure in the Mystic Portal event, experience the new Trait Resonance feature, and show off your favorite looks with Illusion Workshop. There’s even an Ornate Coin Twitch Drop waiting to be claimed.

Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.

[h3]Mystic Portal: Treasure Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] From May 1 through May 15, daily login rewards will grant you special Mystic Keys. Open Mystic Portals to play a treasure-hunting minigame!
[*] Hunt down hidden treasure chests through different puzzles for a variety of rewards including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials!
[/list]
[h3]Trait Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Equipment that has fully developed Traits - all 3 unlocked and at max tier - can now take on a fourth trait through Trait Resonance.
[*] When you unlock Trait Resonance on an item, the fourth trait can be added randomly or specified at unlock through the use of Trait Resonance Stones. Trait Resonance can be re-rolled at any time after unlocking.
[*] Re-traiting one of the base three traits on an item will cause the Trait Resonance to become inactive, but not lost, until the base traits are at max tier once more.
[*] Trait Resonance Stones are acquired by obtaining fragments through Material Transmutation and crafting them along with ores into Trait Resonance Stones at any crafting merchant.
[*] New Lithograph Book entries have been added which grant Trait Resonance Stones as rewards.
[/list]
[h3]Illusion Workshop[/h3]
[list]
[*] Take character customization to even greater heights by customizing the appearance of individual gear pieces through the new Illusion Workshop!
[*] Use consumable Illusion Scrolls to capture the appearance of gear collected in the world and then transform it into a usable Illusion for your cosmetic collection.
[*] Illusion appearances can now be dyed, allowing for even more variety in what you wear.
[*] Apply these appearances to your currently worn equipment to customize your look! Additional illusions will be added to this system over time. At this time, only Epic gear items are available for Illusion Workshop.
[/list]
Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/illusion-workshop]official announcement[/url] for additional details.

[h3]Ornate Coin Twitch Drop[/h3]
Top up on Ornate Coins with the latest THRONE AND LIBERTY Twitch Drop. From activities that will help fast track progress to an open tournament with over one million in Lucent on the line, May is all about rewarding players through unique events. To kick off the festivities, the Ornate Coin Twitch Drop will be available following maintenance on May 1.

Whether you watch your favorite streamer or hang out with a few new Creators, simply tune in for 5 hours of cumulative watch time before May 14 to claim yours.
[list]
[*] 200 Ornate Coins (2 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Ornate Coins (5 total hours watched)
[/list]
If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform) you play on. Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trials: Party Matchmaking rewards for Dimensional Trials matchmaking are now acquired after opening the tier's treasure chest, and only acquired on the first tier after a group uses matchmaking to form.
[*] Arena: When a match ends with no deaths on either team, both teams will see a Loss result but team members will not lose ranking points or matchmaking reward counts.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Icons now display on the Party UI for each member of a party that shows which role they selected for matchmaking - tank, healer, or damage.
[*] Party Board: Added Abyss Dungeons and Nebula Island as categories to post Party Board recruitment notices.
[*] A shortcut to the respective Party Board section has been added to the Map Region List for each Abyss Dungeon.
[*] Hall of Illusion: Haylock: Fixed the display of the Ice Pillar explosion attack so that it shows as a Fury attack instead of a Wrath attack.
[*] Items: Purchasing items with max purchase limits now works with partial remaining quantities when using the Purchase All button.
[*] Items: When filtering merchants for Limited quantity items, the display now also shows items in the list that you have already purchased max quantities of.
[*] Gameplay: Fixed an issue where NPCs and objects occasionally need to be interacted with twice after leaving or joining an instance.
[*] Gameplay: The Map and Minimap are now hidden while inside various instanced locations that don't have map to be shown.
[*] Cooking: Honey Roasted Apple recipe text no longer appears in Korean.
[*] Gameplay: Codex: Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on the wrong side of the Inner Castle Gate as a Jumping Golem.
[*] Schedule: Fixed an issue where later events (such as Gigantrite spawns) would sometimes appear before other events on the schedule.
[*] Amitoi House: Additional cinematics are now available from the Memories of Adventure book in the Amitoi House.
[*] Shop: Server Transfer Tickets should now appear available on the Server Transfer page as soon as they've been purchased.
[*] Nebula Island: The weekly time cap (playable hours) for Nebula Island has increased to 10 hours per week. This is a hard time limit cap and cannot be exceeded.
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deluzhnoa's Edge of Eternal Frost: Added an effect on hitting a target that increases Damage Reduction by 3 for 5 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Increased damage by 50% against monsters.
[*] Deluzhnoa's Permafrost Razors: Added an effect that reduces the cooldown of Phantom Mist by 30%.
[*] Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Added an effect that reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind Arrow by 30%. Increased damage by 50% against monsters.
[*] Deluzhnoa's Ancient Petrified Staff: Now Reduces the casting speed of Infernal Meteor by 50%. Changed Cooldown Speed 4% to Perception 4 on the item stats.
[*] Cordy's Grasp of Manipulation: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Giant Cordy's Blessing, so that it no longer refers to the wrong skill in the description.
[*] Daigon's Stormblade: After using the Whirlwind Shield skill, when the One-Strike Shield skill hits, there is an 80% chance to fire a Whirlwind Shield projectile that deals 135% of the base damage.
[*] Cloak of the Frozen Expanse: Crafting this item no longer results in receiving a Shaikal's Mindveil Spear.
[*] Forgotten Lotus Gloves now properly drop in Bercant Estate.
[*] Crimson Doomblade: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Kasier's Thirst, so that it no longer incorrectly states that it increases Witty Retort's healing.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon Mastery: Adjusted the text descriptions of multiple Weapon Mastery nodes to better clarify their effects.
[/list]
[h3]Crossbows[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Tactical Counterattack: Now has a 1-second casting time.
[/list]
[h3]Daggers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mastery: Movement Speed Focus: Fixed this Tactics Mastery so it no longer decreases Buff Duration by 14% instead of 1.4% at 8/10 points.
[/list]
[h3]Greatsword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guillotine Blade: The effect that reduces incoming healing effects is now subject to the target's Weaken resistance.
[/list]
[h3]Wand[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blessed Barrier: Duration increase specialization will no longer cause the duration to end prematurely.
[*] Celestial Boost: Fixed an issue where the tooltip was not updating with dynamic values.
[/list]
[h3]Sword and Shield[/h3]
[list]
[*] A Shot at Victory: Annihilation Blade specialization: Reduced the required points from 10 to 7.
[*] Mastery: Blade Momentum: Fixed an issue where specific dynamic values in the description were not being retrieved correctly.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Controller: UI layout customization can now be performed using a controller, including on consoles!
[*] Controller: The input button can now be held when donating to a Guild to do so multiple times.
[*] Controller: A variety of controller optimizations for better controller interactions with menus and UI.
[*] Controller Settings: Added the ability to adjust both the character and crosshair position offset on screen.
[*] Mouse/Keyboard: Hotkeys have been added to the Refresh, Accept, and Share with Party buttons when viewing Contracts.
[*] Party List: Party member numbering no longer changes automatically when a party member leaves. Remaining party members keep their assigned numbers in the party list, and as new members join they fill in the empty numbers left by departed party members.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Removed the "create invitation link" option from appearing on the Party Matchmaking UI.
[*] Weapon Mastery: Improved the display of affected stats in Weapon Mastery details, such as when a stat is reduced by the Weapon Mastery effect.
[*] Weapon Mastery: Fixed an issue where remaining Mastery Points displays negative numbers after a level swap with another weapon on a secondary set.
[*] Cooking: Added Search functionality for the Cooking UI.
[*] Crafting: Tabs for crafting groups you don't have recipes under are no longer shown.
[*] Dynamic Events: The Event UI has been updated to better show Regional Contribution Certificates you've earned and how they impact your event rewards.
[*] Dynamic Events: Selecting a Dynamic Event icon from the HUD will now open the event details window for the respective event. For events with multiple turn-in locations, clicking on the respective icons will pan the map to where the exchange location is.
[*] Rune Book: When obtaining a rune and it does not level up, the system message shown now includes the rune's current Growth Points and amount required for a guaranteed level.
[*] Inventory: The 'Unequip from All Equipment and Stats Sets' option can now be used on gear directly from the Inventory
[*] HUD: Added Regional Contribution Certificates to the list of currencies in the on-screen tracker, and removed Mystic Keys.
[*] Guild Distribution: Adjusted the alignment of the member list in the Guild Distribution UI to make it easier to find the list of people selected for distribution.
[*] Vanguards: Dead party member health bars no longer appear as full.
[*] Vanguards: Players who take damage while in another instance no longer appear to have zero health.
[*] Morph: The icon for the Swim Morph Tide Tsarca in the Morph menu is now more consistent with the morph's appearance.
[*] Chat: 'Viewer Transparency' setting should now affect more than just the primary chat window.
[*] Chat: Attempting to use chat while under a chat restriction no longer displays the error message in Korean.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.7.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3JF5pK3G1MPEEgshnup9RV/52c335da63a267f66fb5e3e146b816fa/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_NPC_A_1920_720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.7.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 23 and last approximately 8 hours. Based on completion of additional maintenance tasks this week, the downtime may end significantly earlier. From April 24 through April 30, the Loot Goblin Festival event will descend upon Solisium. Golden Goblins have recently pulled off a successful vault heist. If you catch them, their spoils can be yours!

Find the full list of changes, including bug fixes listed below.

[h3]Loot Goblin Festival Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Golden Goblins and Golden Goblin Chiefs will spawn randomly throughout the world, including in recently added Talandre zones. Golden Goblin Chiefs have been entrusted with particularly large quantities of Sollant from the Goblins' stash.
[*] A system message will appear when a goblin spawns — so keep an eye out.
[*] Hunting Golden Goblins can reward enterprising adventurers with a title, playful morph, Adventure Coin: Loyalty, Runes, Artifacts, Growthstones, Sollant, and occasionally Tier 2 and Nebula item drops!
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI: Moved the 3-Star Weapon rewards to the top of the Expected Rewards list in co-op Dungeon menus, rather than the bottom.
[*] UI: Hall of Illusion: Moved the accessory rewards to the top of the Expected Rewards list rather than at the bottom.
[*] Items - Grayeye's Bloodlust Greatsword: Fixed a text error in the description of Grayeye's Vitality, which stated "Base damage increases by 16%" instead of "Base damage increases by 16."
[*] Cooking: Roast Honey Apple is back on the menu.
[*] Controller: Fixed an issue causing all Pins to be removed when switching between mouse/keyboard and controller.
[*] Items - Argent Justice Headpiece: Fixed the eye color not matching the color of dye used when dyeing this cosmetic.
[*] Items - Forward General's Cloak: Corrected this item appearance so it no longer duplicates the Cloak of Accuracy.
[*] Items - Cloak of Frozen Expanse: Fixed this item not being listed for crafting at the Armor Crafter.
[*] Localization: Fixed an issue occasionally causing Korean text to display in the Guild skills menu.
[*] Localization - Brazilian Portuguese: Fixed an issue causing "plus que" to appear in front of every number while playing in Brazilian Portuguese.
[*] Addressed several client crash issues to increase stability.
[*] Items: Bercant's Steelstring Bow: Fixed an issue causing some values to be swapped in description of Limuny's Last Shot.
[*] Performance: Fixed the client hitching when entering the cave in the Doomrot Grove 3-Star Dungeon.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Daggers - Cleaving Moonlight: Increased Cleaving Moonlight's cast distance to 4m.
[*] Daggers - Shadowy Strike: Fixed an issue preventing the Shadowy Escape Specialization from moving players back to the casting location.
[*] Sword and Shield - Piercing Strike: Fixed an issue allowing Piercing Strike's cooldown to immediately reset each time it was used when Counter Barrier and Gerard's Precision were active.
[*] Crossbow - Mother Nature's Protest: Adjusted the description text to make it clear that the Mana Cost Efficiency stat does not impact its usage mana cost.
[*] Sword and Shield: Annihilation Blade: Fixed an issue causing the Power Breach Mastery effect to not activate when Annihilation Blade was used.
[*] Greatsword: Cold Warrior: Adjusted the skill description to state "Hit Chance" in place of "Heavy Attack Chance".
[*] Wand: Warrior's Gambit: Adjusted the text to make it clear the Base Damage is increased by 25% of the healing that was received by Noble Revival, not a flat 25% Base Damage increase.
[*] Daggers: Camouflage Cloak: Adjusted the skill description to make it clear that Stealth is removed upon attacking another player, not when being attacked.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Illusion Workshop
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6OziygF57gaqNHJo6pDI9D/225581a44e6e639caa4e10dd43add836/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_LifeStyle_B_1920_72-.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Show off your favorite outfits when Illusion Workshop comes to THRONE AND LIBERTY following maintenance on May 1. Use consumable Illusion Scrolls to capture the appearance of gear collected in the world and then transform it into a usable Illusion for your cosmetic collection. Which look will become your legacy?

[h3]How to Make Illusions[/h3]
Obtain Illusion Scrolls in exchange for Lucent and select a specific piece of gear in your inventory. At release, only Epic gear can be turned into Illusions. Converting gear into an Illusion will consume the gear, removing it from your inventory and making it available in the Mirror Boutique. You’re now ready to mix and match your favorite gear into new outfits without worrying about stats.
[list]
[*] Any item that is currently in your possession following the release of Illusion Workshop can have its appearance transformed into an Illusion.
[*] Weapons will cost 6 Illusion Scrolls.
[*] Armors will cost 2 to 3 Illusion Scrolls depending on the armor piece.
[*] Illusions are character-bound (not account) and will now appear in the Mirror Boutique.
[/list]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3asC1m77DJuKpuqcoMBT0x/ed236730ddcecf38ef4654eb890c0fe5/TL_Header_Blog_Images_2025_LifeStyle_D_1080_CT-000015060.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Illusion Scrolls[/h3]
Illusion Scrolls can be obtained through the in-game shop in exchange for Lucent. Please note that Illusion Scrolls are character-bound and cannot be sold in the Auction House.
[list]
[*] 1x Illusion Scroll: 100 Lucent
[*] 30x Illusion Scroll Bundle: 2400 Lucent (20% discount)
[/list]
[h3]Can I create Illusions across different Weight, Weapon, and Apparel Types?[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can use Illusions across light to heavy or medium armor appearances and vice versa.
[*] You can only use Illusions within the same Weapon type (Swords to Swords, Staffs to Staffs, etc).
[*] Illusions only work across the same slot for apparel (head only works with head, chest with chest, etc).
[*] All tiers, but only epic grade items can become Illusions.
[/list]
[h3]How do Dyes Work with Illusions?[/h3]
Once a player uses the Illusion Scroll to collect an appearance, they can then use dye to change the color of their Illusion just like with current outfits from the Shop. The color can be kept or reverted to default color through the mirror boutique.

Thanks for your support! We look forward to seeing what eye-catching Illusions the community will create.

[h3]Loot Goblin Festival Event[/h3]
Trouble securing extra loot? Starting on April 24, hundreds of Loot Goblins will attempt to run away with riches every 3 hours. Their escape only takes 15 minutes, so act fast for bountiful spoils, including Sollant, Growthstones, Crystals, a Playful Morph, Gear, Nebula Chests, and more. The Loot Goblin Festival event will end on May 1.

Join the [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord server[/url] or visit this episode of Tico Talks on YouTube to answer our latest community question. With the recent release of the Weapon dye system, which weapon do you want to see enabled for dyeing next?

Thank you for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.6.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5tzkrniGeBKMJXnm6KVpiZ/b64eb14633abcabf25388538f589aed5/Solo_Dungeon_interior_-_update_2.6_-_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.6.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 16 and last up to 8 hours. Based on completion of additional maintenance tasks this week, the downtime may end significantly earlier! It includes dyeable weapon skins, new Solo Dungeon bosses, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.

[h3]A word from the Breezeline Management Association[/h3]
[list]
[*] Herba Village: Adjusted voice lines from Breezline Manager Haize to reduce repetitive announcements. Don't worry. If you're in the Resistance, it's still free.
[/list]
[h3]Hall of Illusion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hall of Illusion difficulty tiers have been reduced to three tiers from five.
[*] New Hall of Illusion bosses have entered the rotation! Verence and Marta make their first appearances on April 17.
[*] This new set of Hall of Illusion bosses offer Nebula Island necklaces and belts as possible rewards. Ring and bracelet accessories will return to the potential drop table when the prior set of bosses return!
[/list]
[h3]Mirror Boutique[/h3]
Perhaps you love that weapon skin, but wish it came in a different color? Stylish Solisians rejoice; we're adding the ability to dye your weapons through the Mirror Boutique. While not every weapon skin will be dyeable right away, we'll add more to this system over time.

Several lines of weapon skins are now dyeable, including:
[list]
[*] Stormcaller Weapons
[*] Abyssal Weapons
[*] Sanguine Weapons
[*] Fortunate Weapons
[/list]
Add more flair to your outfits with stylish new print patterns that can be used in various Mirror Boutique outfit customizations.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trials: Matchmaking Reward boxes have been temporarily removed from Dimensional Trial completion rewards and will return in a future update.
[*] 3-Star Dungeon Weapons have been added to the dungeon reward pool. These weapons are now also obtainable from the All Things Merchant.
[*] Nebula Island event schedule now runs off of server region time, aligning boss and other event times to the same day of the week for all regions.
[*] Dimensional Trials: Chapel of Madness, Halls of Tragedy: Fixed collision adjustments in the boss arenas to prevent players from attacking without retaliation.
[*] Bosses: Dominion and Guild vs. Guild bosses now give higher Activity Point values, and Peace mode bosses give slightly less.
[*] Field Boss: Fixed an issue causing Daigon to not reset appropriately when attacked from higher terrain while no other targets were present.
[*] Combat - Wand - Blessed Barrier: Fixed an issue causing the Duration Increased Specialization to not function if used on a player that does not have the same Specialization active.
[*] Weapon Mastery: Significantly improved the text descriptions on several Weapon Mastery nodes to better convey their functionality.
[*] Battle Pass: Increased the quantity of Abundance Fruit and Mastery Report received from the Abyssal Star Battle Pass Shop.
[*] Exploration Codex: Adjusted the Torture Chamber of Screams codex requirements to be achievable with prior changes to dungeon mechanics.
[*] Exploration Codex: Chapter 3: Fixed an issue preventing players from interacting with the NPC required for "Guard the Starlight Observatory Ruins."
[*] Combat: Increased Training Dummy health values to keep up with increased player damage output.
[*] Combat: Fixed a case where custom outfit colors could revert to default when using certain skills.
[*] Guardians: Fixed an issue allowing Feral Wolfer Aranka's Song of the Wild effect to be permanently active.
[*] Morphs: Fixed an issue causing the Armored Diatrima Dash Morph to not be shared across all characters on an account.
[*] Guilds: Fixed an issue preventing Guild Tags from being added or edited.
[*] Cosmetics: Fixed an issue causing the Darkfire Ember and Lucid Weapon Skins to appear incorrectly.
[*] Material Transmutation: Fixed an issue causing materials to be selected when using the rarity filters in Material Transmutation.
[/list]
[h3]Items - Equipment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the stats displayed for various equipment pieces to not match the actual stats granted. Most of these were Rare Tier 2 items.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from crafting the Crown of Icebound Infinity.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Black Anvil Passion weapon buff to increase the Sollant Bonus by a different amount each time it was equipped.
[*] Synch: Fixed an issue causing equipment to become temporarily untradeable after being Synched to another gear piece.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI - Material Transmutation: Combined the weapon, armor, and accessory tabs into a single equipment section.
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where the Resurrection button would disappear after opening and closing another fullscreen UI.
[*] Vanguards: Added new nameplate colors to better distinguish members of your own and other parties within a Vanguard.
[*] Vanguards: Fixed an issue causing the health bars within the Vanguard UI to flicker and display incorrect HP values.
[*] Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Settings menu from being navigated while having a Fishing Rod equipped and aimed at a body of water.
[*] Controller: Fixed an issue causing the skill target preview area to be shown on the left or right of a target instead of directly on them.
[*] Runes: Fixed an issue causing Korean text and the incorrect Runes to be shown when previewing another player's weapons.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.
