notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.4.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/umhrp0op95v1/25PpSocJAeP2asPe2NunFT/2140350f255da4b6a08795b82fc4786a/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Dungeons_TempleofSilaves_A.png[/img]
[i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] update 2.4.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on April 2 and last approximately 3.5 hours. It includes a new system to manage your runes, adjustments to Guild and Riftstone Boss loot, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.

[h3]RUNE MANAGEMENT[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new Rune Book UI has been added to the Item section of the Main Menu.
[*] Instead of obtaining multiple copies of each rune as an item, obtaining runes now unlocks and levels up a single unified entry in the Rune Book UI - these unified basic Rune can be equipped to multiple items at once. Chaos Runes can only be equipped to one item at a time.
[*] Rune Synergies have been simplified by removing the various quality tiers and providing a single maximized Synergy benefit for each rune color combination.
[*] The Rune listings allow you to search, favorite, and filter through the list of your available Runes.
[*] When selecting an item to modify equipped runes, the rune list will only show runes that are eligible to equip to that item type.
[*] Drag and drop Runes from your collection list to the Item's unlocked Rune slots in the top section of the UI to equip Runes to an item.
[*] The rune list now displays the level, stat benefit, and stat value of each collected rune along with a progress bar that displays along the bottom of each Rune entry.
[*] This progress bar acts as a Rune leveling progress guarantee; now when you receive Runes of the same level as the one you have collected, this progress bar increases until it fills.
[*] Once filled, that rune will increase to the next level; setting a maximum amount of times, you can receive an individual rune of the same level before receiving a rune level increase.
[*] Chaos Runes: A maximum of 100 Chaos Runes can be stored in the Rune UI. Chaos Runes you don't intend to use can be deleted from the list, freeing up a slot.
[*] Rune Fragments will no longer be able to be acquired, and any existing rune fragments in your inventories or storage will eventually be removed!
[/list]
[h3]GUILD RAID AND RIFTSTONE BOSSES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the loot drop tables for Talandre Guild Raid and Riftstone bosses (Daigon, Leviathan, Pakilo Naru, Manticus Brothers) to include a guaranteed T2 Armor or Accessory drop on each kill in addition to the current drop pools.
[/list]
[h3]MATERIAL TRANSMUTATION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Material Transmutation: Implemented options to auto-add designated material types and grades to your Material Transmutation progress.
[*] Material Transmutation: Added the ability to split stacks of items with Shift-Left Click when adding items to Material Transmutation.
[*] Material Transmutation: Bulk-adding materials now selects up to 300 eligible items, increased from the previous cap of 20 at a time.
[/list]
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dimensional Trial: Fixed an issue preventing groups from posting Party Board recruitment above Tier 1 for Dimensional Trials.
[*] Added the option to copy skill and specialization presets to a new preset for editing as an alternative to creating skill presets from a blank state.
[*] Skill presets can now also be pasted as a chat link that allows others to copy the preset skill and specialization contents.
[*] Replaced Rare Rune chests with Epic Rune chests for the following reward types: Dimensional Trials, Weekly Missions, Arena Coin shop, Abyss dungeons, World Bosses, Guild Raids, and Material Transmutation. Items: Removed Epic Tier 2 and Tier 1 equipment drops from basic zone population mobs.
[*] Adjusted the crafting menu for items like Skill Books to enable you to combine component ingredients that have multiple substitutes into a single craft.
[*] Herba Village: Added Arena Sundries Merchant to the available town NPCs.
[*] Guilds: Tax Deliver, Siege, and Interserver Riftstone and Boonstone award distribution can now be distributed unevenly when distributing to all members, not just participants.
[*] Gate of Infinity, Taedal's Tower: Added the ability to move to other floors without exiting the dungeon.
[*] Targeting: Added an option to target nameplate settings to prevent nameplate transparency being applied to targets who are actively attacking you.
[*] Siege: Small adjustments to the defense area boundaries to teleport out non-defenders from walls at the start of a Siege.
[*] Arena: Fixed a situation where some food buffs that should be removed on Arena entry were not being removed properly.
[*] Nebula Island: Removed some ceiling clutter from the boss arena that interfered with viewing angles.
[*] Nebula Island: Fixed an issue where Grimturg's attack pattern could behave unexpectedly when its aggro target was at a distance.
[*] Guild Raid: Fixed boss reset behavior for Pakilo Naru.
[*] Character: Wind indicators on your character are now hidden during cutscenes and interaction camera views.
[/list]
[h3]HALL OF ILLUSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added checkpoints to Hall of Illusion levels to allow players to take breaks between fights.
[*] Molgras: Fixed an issue where Molgras could occasionally teleport outside of the attackable area.
[*] Molgras: Festive Trees now respawn 10 seconds after Molgras returns to the center of the arena.
[*] Hall of Illusion: Lionhead: Fixed an issue that could cause the Zone of Pain effect to apply even though your interaction was interrupted.
[/list]
[h3]WAR GAMES[/h3]
[list]
[*] War Games: Added a display of which weapons members of the team are currently using to better inform team-making strategy.
[*] War Games: Can now edit the display name of War Game Lobbies.
[*] War Games: Minor adjustment to the color displayed for Yellow Team to avoid overlap with the yellow used for Friendly guilds.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chained damage or healing now displays as an increasing floating damage number that sums up the total damage or healing done rather than separate numbers for each hit.
[*] HUD: Added setting to enable/disable Item Acquisition popup messages.
[*] Weapon Specialization: Added shortcuts to open material containers in your storage for material costs needed to unlock Weapon Specialization nodes.
[*] Adjusted the Hall of Illusion reward popup to clarify the rewards can only be claimed once.
[*] Guild Menu: Adjusted display of Friendly guilds in the Guild info UI.
[*] Added HUD shortcuts for Amitoi House and Fishing mode that can be arranged within the UI.
[*] Currency display: Removed outdated event coins that had zero-quantities from token lists in the UI.
[*] Items: Minor adjustments to the display of Lithograph information when viewing item tooltip details.
[*] Controller: Made multiple adjustments to UI windows for controller focus areas and window priority.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.3.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3pBV4BzxyAdd0rHbIpixjA/d866cd788785018fb5fdd4ee8a6c36a7/TL_Temple-of-Truth_1920.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.3.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on March 26 and last approximately 4.5 hours. Race to the finish in the Starbloom Festival event, claim your leaderboard spot in the new Dimension Trial and Arena season, and look forward to new Arch Bosses.

Find the full list of changes, including various bug fixes listed below, plus the latest episodes of Tico Talks and Eye on Solisium.

[h3]Tico Talks[/h3]
[previewyoutube=xMdv98awomk;full][/previewyoutube]
Set aside some time for Tico. This month's episode covers gear distribution, guild vs guild and dominion mode bosses, solo dungeon difficulty, trait resonance, and more.
[h3]Eye on Solisium[/h3]
[previewyoutube=epj7kto2lPo;full][/previewyoutube]
Catch up with Publishing Producer godspeed for the latest on all things THRONE AND LIBERTY: Wilds of Talandre. Let us know your answer to this month’s community question. With the new Weapon Mastery and Artifact Systems, will you try different weapon combinations? If so, which weapons and why?
[h3]Starbloom Festival Event[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5iQFo9lRqOO9Kv6186bnCC/88a5597730ee1f580e73640d37da3421/TL_StarbloomFestival_MorphRaces2_1920x1080_CT-000017108.jpg[/img]
Race to the finish when the Starbloom Festival event blossoms across Solisium on March 27 through April 16. Event-only morph races, unique prizes like the Rainbewe sheep morph, seasonal delicacies, and festive village decorations await. Spring cosmetics, including the Blossom outfit and Alluring weapon skins will also be available. Check out our event announcement for additional details on Morph races, rewards, and more.
[h3]New Dimensional Trial and Arena Season[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/66tERNy6UaYPZO1Jc39AcJ/1d200a3c13b4e8d8b98afad226d590e9/TL_2st_Dng_1_Carmine_Rage_Island_1080.jpg[/img]
The next season of Arena and Dimensional Trials starts after maintenance. Triumph in either endgame activity for unique morphs, titles, and other desirable rewards. Even if you fall short of your goal during one round, failure is sometimes the best lesson for improvement. Another effective way to get better is through these tips from Twitch Creators NorgannonHH and Grenton.

[h2]Upcoming Arch Bosses[/h2]
Topple new Arch Bosses like Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy for unique rewards on your way to the throne.

[h3]Deluzhnoa[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4bHMDlmiHbmBd3iQ5WCsRV/f02ac145eaa77532ac62eb10392d87d3/TL_DelugeNoah_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
Long ago Deluzhnoa, a Lightbringer Society wizard, harnessed Quietis' Heart to stop the Shadowmancers invading Einar Temple. However, using this forbidden power sent her into a frenzied state, and she was transformed into a monstrous being. She has been encased in frozen armor and wields a colossal icy spear, and will pose a challenging threat.

The first Deluzhnoa Arch Boss battle will take place on March 29.

[h3]Giant Cordy[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4EsI7NmRF0nzpZnfbRRd5K/e2d86175ecad95f0cf9c11f12c167f17/Giant_Cordy_1080.jpg[/img]
A tiny poisonous mushroom spore landed on a fragment of Sylaveth's Star, absorbing ritual energy and mana before transferring its consciousness to another spore. This spore infected a Chief Mitran seed on Mount Snowburn, taking control of its host and absorbing ambient mana to grow tremendously strong. The resulting creature, known as the Giant Cordy, has been linked to numerous disappearances in the Snowburn District.

The first Giant Cordy Arch Boss battle will take place on April 2.

[h3]Dimensional Trials[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to use Party Matchmaking to form Dimensional Trial groups, accessed through the Co-Op Dungeon > Dimensional Trial tab.
[*] Dimensional Trials now drop Epic Runes and have received additional loot table updates!
[/list]
[h3]Arenas[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new Victory Rewards for Arena matches that award Tier 2 Tokens and potentially other items based on your Arena Ranking. The number of Victory Rewards you can claim is limited and recharges over time, similar to the Dimensional Contract Token system.
[*] Arena Coins that are part of Weekly Objective rewards have been replaced with new Arena Coins: Flames for rewards as well as purchasing currency in the Arena Shop. Existing Arena Coins will expire during this maintenance.
[*] Anonymized the names of Arena opponents on the matchmaking and mid-match screens. Opponent names will be displayed on the Results popup at the end of matches.
[/list]
[h3]Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Field Boss: As of 3/20, Dominion bosses now slowly lose HP over time after 20 minutes have passed, until they reach 10% HP remaining.
[*] With the addition of this change, the previous 30% HP reduction to overall Dominion boss HP has been removed.
[*] Arch Bosses: Reduced the preparation phase after entering an Arch Boss portal to 1 minute from 5 minutes.
[*] Arch Bosses: With the unlock of Arch Boss fights for Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy, their respective Fragment items may now be obtained from Amitoi Expedition and Fishing reward pouches.
[*] Bosses: Guild Portals now attempt to matchmake earlier than Dominion or Peace portals at the 3 minute mark, allowing players who fail to find a Guild portal match additional time to participate in one of the other modes.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] World: Adjusted a piton in Bercant Manor that could appear to be floating in midair at lower graphic settings.
[*] Cooking: Grilled Crown Fish: Added Solisium Carp as an eligible fish ingredient for this recipe.
[*] Twisted Laboratory: Kaiser Crimson: Added numbers to the Fear overhead visual effect.
[*] Items: Added tooltip indicators for items that can be acquired through Dissolving.
[*] Items: Increased item stack limits for Potions and Food items.
[*] Items: Poultry-type cooking ingredients have been consolidated to a unified Bland Meat ingredient.
[*] Targeting: Adjusted Tab-Target picking to hopefully improve the logic of targets chosen based on proximity and direction from your character.
[/list]
[h3]Hall of Illusion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved Hall of Illusion rewards by replacing Rare tier runes with Epic tier (purple) runes, artifacts, and replacing the Tier 1 Equipment Chest with Tier 2 Tokens. Tier 5 has a chance of dropping Nebula Island accessories.
[*] Adjusted boss HP and damage output to reduce overall difficulty of Tier 1 and 2.
[*] Added the ability for players to trigger a life-steal effect during Tier 1 through 4 to increase self-healing opportunities.
[*] Umbrakan: Adjusted defensive skill timing for Tier 5 to better reflect Tier 1-4.
[*] Umbrakan: Slightly increased the time available before Umbrakan uses its execution skill in Tier 5.
[*] Umbrakan: Changed the execution skill used by Umbrakan in Tier 1-4 to deal damage instead of instant death.
[/list]
[h3]Longbow[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deadly Marker: Cooldown reduction effect no longer stacks, even if multiple Deadly Markers are applied to the target.
[*] Deadly Marker: No longer affected by Evasion. Deadly Marker can still miss based on Weaken Resistance. Added Weaken tag to the Deadly Marker tooltip.
[*] Zephyr's Nock: Added additional 20% damage vs NPC targets effect.
[*] Decisive Sniping, Decisive Bombardment: Increased damage bonus against NPC targets from 60% to 85%.
[*] Brutal Arrow: Added additional 100% damage vs NPC targets effect.
[*] Strafing: Increased damage bonus against NPC targets from 15% to 25%.
[/list]
[h3]Wand[/h3]
[list]
[*] Curse Explosion: Improved hit area detection for instant damage.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auction House: Moved Lithograph auction listings to their own category.
[*] Swapped the order of Equipment Sync and Combat Settings buttons on the Character window.
[*] HUD: Added the ability to hide certain UI elements from the Edit HUD customization.
[*] UI: Added icon indicators for a target's species type (Humanoid, Construct, Wildkin, etc) to the target UI.
[*] UI: Additional highlighting on the Target-of-Target nameplates to improve indication of these sub-targets.
[*] Ornate Coin Shop: Replaced missing text descriptions on several items.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Starbloom Festival
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4ngVikxRwmVPfqkqXtWoqr/fe5ae2b47b00cf90241d249d3869fc80/TL_StarbloomFestival_MorphRaces1_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Race to the finish when the Starbloom Festival event blossoms across Solisium on March 27 through April 16. Event-only morph races, unique prizes like the Rainbewe sheep morph, seasonal delicacies, and festive village decorations await. Spring cosmetics, including the Blossom outfit and Alluring weapon skins will also be available.

The Starbloom Festival began over a century ago when divided magic users gathered to foster understanding through transformation magic. Now it is a grand sporting event where participants compete for glory while honoring the celebration's origins of harmony and unity.

[h2]Morph Races[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5iQFo9lRqOO9Kv6186bnCC/88a5597730ee1f580e73640d37da3421/TL_StarbloomFestival_MorphRaces2_1920x1080_CT-000017108.jpg[/img]
Compete in any of the three special events for Starbloom Coins. Each race requires skill — and a little bit of luck for the item roulette — to win.
[list]
[*] Wild Dash: Dash past rivals with speed, agile movements, and swift decisions on your way to the finish line.
[*] Rapids Rush: Swim through lakes and rivers, overcome natural and artificial obstacles, and outmaneuver other participants for first place.
[*] Skyborne Challenge: Soar through magically conjured aerial routes before your foes.
[/list]
Participants will receive Starbloom Coins up to 10 times per week. Afterwards, they’ll receive Quality Stellarite.

[h3]Event Shop[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7JfCs2dz5iQRZzVmgVUJzX/da07cde100c6a261423bc82936651b5a/TL_StarbloomFestival_SheepMorph_1920x1080_CT-000017108.jpg[/img]
Trade in your Starbloom Coins for event-specific rewards ranging from a morph to special food.
[list]
[*] Title: Force of Nature
[*] Dash Morph: Rainbewe
[*] Food: Skewers
[*] Temporarily increases evasion, skill damage resistance, and all CC resistance.
[*] Does not stack with Defense food items.
[*] Food: Fish Nugget
[*] Temporarily buffs movement and attack speeds.
[*] Does not stack with Utility food items.
[*] Food: Marble Candy
[*] Temporarily buffs critical hit and damage rates.
[*] Does not stack with Attack food items.
[*] Stellarite
[*] Weapon Mastery Seal: 100,000 Points
[*] Precious Ore Selection Chest
[*] Precious Polished Crystal
[/list]
[h3]Blossom Mochi[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2Y13UIlxIYd1QbWm6FaF2R/43d4aa290b147d185001891a2427919e/TL_StarbloomFestival_VillageDecorations1_1920x1080_CT-000017108.jpg[/img]
Enjoy Blossom Mochi to gain temporary bonuses for Sollant, weapon mastery experience, and Abyssal Contract Token efficiency. This signature Starbloom Festival delicacy consists of three ingredients: Milk, Starbloom Petals, and Rice Flour. Milk can be found at various merchants, while Starbloom Petals and Rice Flour are available through the activities listed below.

[h3]Daily-Check In Rewards[/h3]
Each day you log in during the festivities, you’ll receive one of the following rewards:
[list]
[*] Starbloom Coin: Participate in races to earn even more Starbloom Coins.
[*] Starbloom Petal: Additional Starbloom Petals can be reeled in while fishing.
[*] Rice Flour: Send your favorite Amitoi on expeditions for more Rice Flour.
[/list]

notes.title: Arena and Dimensional Trial Tips
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/vfqIEeUzQO3CH3siZNZj8/a842c0541feb9b7d4814a7196b5dabd9/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_Arenas_v01_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]

The next season of Arena and Dimensional Trials starts after maintenance on March 27. Triumphs in either endgame activity will score you unique morphs, titles, and other desirable rewards. Even if you fall short of your goal during one round, failure is sometimes the best lesson for improvement. Another effective way to get better is through these tips from Twitch Creators NorgannonHH and Grenton.

Here’s how to get even more enjoyment out of each activity.

[h2]3v3 Arena[/h2]
Welcome to the arena, the ultimate proving grounds for battle-hardened warriors. In this cross-server 3v3 mode, players engage in fast-paced, strategic combat. Two unique battlegrounds — the celestial amphitheater and the ever-changing magical laboratory — offer distinct challenges that test adaptability and teamwork.

The objective is clear. Be the first team to reach 200 battle points within a tight 5-minute limit. Points are awarded every 30 seconds based on how you perform kills and eliminations, but success requires more than raw power. Scoring incentivizes offense and defense, so it will take a smart use of abilities, quick thinking, and flawless coordination to dominate the arena.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5o24jpO9qZTjORcsjaHDS7/bcd8280a9aa99beb3bfca9463eee1b35/T_L_WarGames_Screenshots_Arenas_v01_A_1080_CT-000013742.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Player Tips[/h3]
"As a new player, you should know that the arenas are dedicated to a rock-paper-scissors combat,“ said NorgannonHH. "Each class archetype will have its counter. Therefore, in the composition of 3v3 combat gives space for each option."
[list]
[*] During arena combat, positioning plays a fundamental part, not standing too close to the respawn area of your enemies is also part of this, using the environment to remove the line of sight of enemy skills as well, or to gain space to kite.
[*] The party leader can place pins to give positional indications and place icons on enemies to give more precise focus target calls.
[*] Inside the arena, certain foods cannot be eaten, but foods such as life, mana, or utility can be used prior to entering the arena. This will give you a general advantage against players who do not consume anything.
[*] Learn from trial and error through combat to predict certain patterns of specific archetypes. For example, anticipate greatsword skills and combos to parry attacks that can determine the game’s outcome.
[*] The importance of cooldowns is absolutely vital. Understanding the average cooldown times between combos will help you make better decisions as a tank, healer, or DPS. For instance, waiting to do a collision push when you see a greatsword player connect their stun and prone combo. The healer would provide a buff like Invincible Wall or Blessed Barrier to avoid the full damage combo that could send them to the respawn.
[/list]
[h3]Experienced Player Tips[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3gqwLi8wQPdL38fhA5QoaJ/0eb4d259c08ee4a213b587a3bf3267c3/T_L_WarGames_Screenshots_Arenas_v01_B_1080_CT-000013742.jpeg[/img]
[list]
[*] Ensure your gear is optimized for arena. Players will often feel less effective in fights when their abilities aren’t as impactful against other players.
[*] Your ability selection matters, so it’s important to understand that crowd control or defensive skills may be more important than pure damage.
[*] Communicate often and be ready to make decisions based on the situation. Your enemy can make mistakes like missing a stun, blocking too early, or drifting too far from their group to receive support. Call those actions out to help increase your chances of winning!
[*] Pay attention to the environment. Some arenas have moving walls and pillars that you can use to your advantage. Whether you can cause your enemy to lose their line of sight or push them out to score a kill, avoid unnecessary open area combat.
[/list]
[h2]Dimensional Trials[/h2]
Challenge your favorite dungeons at various difficulty options. Depending on your chosen difficulty, dungeons will have higher enemy stats, harder boss mechanics, and additional effects applied. Clear higher levels to contribute toward leaderboards and seasonal rewards. Dimensional Trials can be challenged repeatedly and do not have a cost to enter.

To take on a Dimensional Trial, players must have cleared the 3-Star Dungeon of the same name at least once after this content update. Party members must also meet a minimum Combat Power to enter. There's no time limit to complete a level, but additional levels will be accessible based on the time taken to clear one. Clear additional levels to obtain new Runes as rewards as well as progress toward the Dimensional Trials achievements and seasonal rankings!

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/66tERNy6UaYPZO1Jc39AcJ/1d200a3c13b4e8d8b98afad226d590e9/TL_2st_Dng_1_Carmine_Rage_Island_1080.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Players Tips[/h3]
Grenton shared the following advice for players interested in running their first Dimensional Trials.
[list]
[*] Always try to bring a greatsword user – Having a greatsword tank or DPS is crucial since they provide Blood Devotion, a powerful party-wide sustain buff that helps with survivability as well as buffs your damage!
[*] Maximize group DPS with Deadly Marker – Bow users should take advantage of Deadly Marker, which significantly boosts the entire party’s damage output against marked targets.
[*] Healers do more than heal – Support classes bring strong buffs like Janice’s Revenge (damage boost) and Enchanting Time (CDR), so don’t overlook them when forming a party.
[*] Use Party Pins for coordination – When running with new groups, map markers (party pins) help keep everyone on the same page and avoid confusion.
[*] Utilize food buffs, stellarite, and Guardians – Always eat food and equip stellarite before entering to boost damage or survivability, and summon Guardians for extra defensive or offensive benefits.
[/list]
[h3]Experienced Player Tips[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4V4TOYGoyV2DLcYE6UD0SY/ec1430a4afd79ee602e4a52643e4d618/TL_2st_Dng_3_Island_of_Terror_1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Optimize your skill rotation – Learn when to sync burst windows with buffs like Deadly Marker, Blood Devotion, and Janice’s Revenge for maximum DPS.
[*] Positioning is key – Some boss mechanics are much easier to handle by standing in specific spots, reducing incoming damage and making healing easier.
[*] Learn enemy patterns – Each Dimensional Trial boss has specific attack patterns. Knowing when to dodge or preemptively shield will make a huge difference.
[*] Stack defensive layers – Tanks should rotate mitigation skills before big attacks, while healers should time shields/buffs instead of just spamming heals.
[*] Efficient buff stacking – Coordinate with the group so buffs don’t overlap. For example, don’t wastemultiple Blood Devotions at the same time, and ensure key buffs are staggered for continuous uptime.
[/list]
[h3]Featured Creators[/h3]
Make sure to follow our featured Creators on Twitch for more guides, high-level THRONE AND LIBERTY gameplay, and other original content.
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/notgrenton]Grenton[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/norgannonhh]NorgannonHH[/url]
[/list]
[url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Share your highlights[/url] and let us know what you’d like to see next for these endgame activities. Looking for more tips? Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/wilds-of-talandre-guide]Wisdom for the Wilds guide[/url]. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you on the Leaderboards.

notes.content:

[list]
[*] Additional Dimensional Trial season reward titles will be sent out during this maintenance for characters who were missed in the March 13 maintenance.
[*] Party Matchmaking
[*] Fixed recent issues related to party matchmaking that caused party members to be placed into separate instances, and prevented claiming of the random matchmaking rewards even after rejoining the rest of the formed party.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nebula Island: Several Rift Fracture mobs now use the party contribution system to determine item drops.
[*] Contribution will be determined by the efforts of the entire party. Once an item drop has been assigned to a party, all party members have an equal chance of receiving the item.
[*] Combat Settings: Added new Target-of-Target and Target-of-Other-Player display options to the UI that appear below the current Target bar.

[*] Weapon Mastery: Added the ability to Alt-Click on Mastery skills to link them in the chat window.
[*] Weapon Mastery: Staff: Flame Discipline: Adjusted the auto-firing behavior from this Mastery ability.
[*] Weapon Mastery: Staff: Burning Ripple: This will now properly affect other players in PvP.
[*] Bow: Deadly Marker: Fixed an issue causing Deadly Marker to not grant cooldown reduction in some cases while on higher ground.
[*] Artifacts: The 'Ruling Demon' set bonus should now properly grant 6% Shield block chance.
[*] Adventure Codex: Added retry buff mechanics to several elite boss fights encountered throughout the story quests.
[*] Adventure Codex: Fixed an issue that caused stat debuffs to remain applied after completing a story instance.
[*] Adventure Codex: 'Hidden Treasure in the Waterfall' now correctly rewards an Artifact Chest.
[*] World: Adjusted the placement of a piton near Deluzhnoa Temple to make it easier to use.
[*] Bosses: Improved boss reset behavior for Nirma and Minezerok.
[*] Morph: Totem Ursa is now available account-wide.
[*] Gamepad: Removed the default reverse-direction behavior from the L2 stick and added the ability to customize this behavior in the Gamepad preferences.
[*] Audio: King Khazaizin: Fixed a set of Korean language audio lines.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gamepad: Fixed an issue causing party members to incorrectly display Party Leader icons on the Gamepad party UI.
[*] Chat: Added new chat stickers including numbers 0-9 and a Spear visual.
[*] UI: Added a button to navigate to the Skill menu from the Weapon Mastery window.
[*] Items: Corrected some Tier 2 equipment tooltips that were missing links to view their trait extract listings on the Auction House.
[*] Items: Fixed some Tier 2 items incorrectly displaying as available from the Contract Coin Merchant.
[*] Console: Cutscenes: Updated some low-resolution textures causing Helpie to be less expressive than usual.
[*] Ornate Coin Shop: Replaced missing text descriptions on several items.
[*] Fixed several additional minor UI interaction and focus related bugs related to new features.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.1.0
notes.content:
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.1.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on March 12 and last approximately 7.5 hours. It includes Nebula Island, Artifacts, new solo dungeon bosses, and new 3-Star Dungeons. Find the full list of changes listed below, plus a guide on our new features from [url=https://www.youtube.com/@grobsXO]GrobsXO[/url].

[h3]New Activity: Nebula Island[/h3]
“For me, one of the biggest highlights of Talandre is Nebula Island and the Artifact System,” GrobsXO said. ”If you’re into PvP and love tweaking your character’s build, you're going to love these updates.”

[previewyoutube=1d6Sd6t4K0M;full][/previewyoutube]
Nebula Island is a new interserver activity accessible to level 55 players through the Secret Dungeons' Lawless Wilds tab. Players can spend up to 5 hours per week there, with additional time available through Nebula Charge Stones.

The island consists of a central village and six distinct regions, including one peaceful zone and four war zones where PvP is always enabled. Players can access various hunting grounds through portals in the central village and collect Lesser and Greater Nebula Stones to exchange for items. The island features hourly events and periodic field boss battles with limited participation capacity. A new exclusive accessory system called Artifacts has also been introduced specifically for Nebula Island content.

[h3]New System: Artifacts[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6OBOGZ15oVLqS29n2yS6dl/a24196adb13a370110c9d5ae9dceee7b/Artifact-1920.jpg[/img]

Redefine your playstyle through unique skills with Artifact item sets. Artifacts can be obtained from Nebula island and Abyss Dungeons in Talandre.

The system consists of six parts: four Talistones, a Solarstone, and a Lunarstone, each with unique stats and effects. There are 14 different Artifact sets across three grades (2 Common, 4 Uncommon, and 8 Rare), with some stats being randomly determined upon acquisition. Players can trigger set bonuses by equipping 2, 4, or 6 matching pieces from the same set. The Solarstone provides an Active Skill while the Lunarstone grants a Passive Skill when equipped.

[h3]New Solo Dungeon Bosses[/h3]

[previewyoutube=gL7hvLDJicU;full][/previewyoutube]
Conquer new solo dungeon bosses like Umbrakan and Lionhead for unique rewards on your way to the throne.

[b]Umbrakan[/b]

The ferocity of a beast, the intelligence of a human, and the vitality of a great tree. This grotesque being hid in the forest to eat small animals and insects for nutrients. However, after absorbing the mana from a human wizard, it began hunting humans. Now it casts illusions to slaughter intruders.

[b]Lionhead[/b]

The Arkeum subjected Demian, a child born between a demon and a human, to intense training, including mana infusions from the Abyssal Meteor. Demian achieved remarkable feats on the battlefield. However, upon seeing blood he caused excessive slaughter. His steel lion helmet became a symbol of death and terror.

[h2]New 3-Star Dungeons[/h2]
[h3]Doomrot Grove[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1yjNHWGyQzzTgUZOgHQ2s2/37b39849ea0a3c5127cf01f0a30dd114/Screenshot_HighRes_20250124_164530_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

Norn Bercant was kidnapped by the Crimson family and turned into a ferocious, mutated creature. With a power as immense as her deep grudge, she created Doomrot Grove, a secluded garden cut off from the outside world.

[h3]Twisted Laboratory[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7JJqgVZcEE8D9JPcc2FQ6G/e41e419450fe5b122a75d0d827485c89/Screenshot_HighRes_20250124_160322_1920.jpg[/img]

Bioweapons leaked out of the Crimson family’s lab and killed most people in the manor. The mystery of Kaiser Crimson’s survival remains. Those who discovered the truth have taken it to their grave.

[h3]Vanguards - Multi-Party (Raid) System[/h3]
We now support raids (multi-party groups) of up to 8 parties and 48 players.
[list]
[*] Vanguards can be created through the Party Management window.
[*] The player who first forms the raid becomes the initial Vanguard Leader, and can transfer the role later.
[*] Vanguard Leaders can adjust party composition or remove members from the vanguard.
[*] Vanguard Leaders may also set join conditions such as 'Guild Members Only','Allied Guilds Only', or open-entry.
[*] Various content can be completed while in Vanguards with some exceptions.
[*] You cannot join party-based instances such as Dungeons or Dimensional Trials while in a vanguard.
[*] Field Boss instances are also unavailable for entry as a vanguard.
[*] If a player enters a Dominion event they will be removed from the vanguard.
[*] Entering Siege or Tax Delivery events as a vanguard will remove all members not in the Vanguard Leader's guild from the parties.
[/list]
[h3]Nameplate Targeting Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] New targeting features have been added to Settings > Gameplay > Character > Large Scale Combat Mode.
[*] When Large Scale Combat Mode is activated, an effect is added that emphasizes the target's nameplate more.
[*] Additional options are available in this new setting menu to customize your targeting experience:
[*] Character nameplate transparency
[*] Non-target character nameplate transparency
[*] Target color adjustments
[*] An additional new option has been added to Settings > Gameplay > UI > HUD to adjust the size of the vertical target indicator line that appears on the nameplate of targeted characters.
[/list]
[h3]Dimensional Trial Season 1 Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ranking rewards from Dimensional Trial Season 1 will be distributed after this maintenance, to characters who had eligible scores prior to Server Consolidation. Check your mail to receive these!
[/list]
[h3]Field Bosses[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Talandre field bosses will have their health nerfed by 30% to account for those struggling to kill them in guild vs guild and dominion events. This is a temporary measure and a permanent feature will arrive in a future update.
[*] Reduced wait time at the start of Field Bosses: Party formation portals will continue to remain open for 5 minutes, while the Boss preparation time after parties have entered the instance has been reduced to 1 minute, down from 5 minutes.
[*] Field Boss: Daigon: The boss will now reset properly when the last player dies during his leap phase.
[*] Field Boss: Fixed an issue that caused allied players to appear as targetable during Dominion or Peace Field Boss events.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Battle Pass: Fixed an issue where the "Craft 3 Uncommon or higher equipment items" mission would not complete after 3 successful crafts.
[*] Battle Pass: Abundance Fruit and Weapon Mastery Book items now have a 30 minute effect duration when consumed.
[*] Unfortunately, Golem shapeshifts acquired while on the quest 'When the Day Comes' will now have to remain in the quest area and may not go on adventures to boss fights or other world locations.
[*] PvP: Adjusted the Fonsine's Blessing timers for respawn locations used during Siege and Tax Delivery.
[*] Cooking: Fixed several instances of incorrect utility buff icons on craftable food items.
[*] The opening Talandre cutscene now only plays automatically once when entering the game after the Talandre update.
[*] Black Anvil Forge: Fixed an issue that caused team colors to not display when re-entering the Dominion event in Black Anvil Forge.
[*] Console: Fixed several issues related to automatic party matchmaking for Dominion bosses on consoles.
[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused healing reduction effects between Meteor and Focused Fire Bombs to stack to excessive values.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the following combat abilities from firing successfully when using the auto-move to target settings. Affected abilities:
[*] Greatsword: Devastating Smash, Guillotine Blade
[*] Dagger: Inject Venom (Secondary Ability), Frenzied Sword Dance
[*] Spear: Death From Above
[*] Bow: Zephyr's Knock, Ensnaring Arrow, Strafing, Deadly Marker
[*] Crossbows: Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Weak Point Shot
[*] Wand: Cursed Nightmare, Time for Punishment, Ray of Disaster
[/list]
[h3]Hall of Illusion[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to continue to spawn after the completion painting appeared.
[*] Adjusted a water height that caused players to drop out of swim morph in the Waterways section of Hall of Illusion.
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple mismatches between English voiceover and in-game subtitles in the Talandre Adventure Codex. Additional subtitle polishing will continue to address remaining mismatch issues in future updates.
[*] Updated Weapon Mastery description tooltips across multiple skills to better reflect their functional behavior.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Party Window: Fixed the display of the controller version of the party menu that showed all members with the Party Leader icon.
[*] Field Bosses: Updated text to fix Korean strings being displayed on Field Boss reward UI.
[*] Ring Menu: No longer displays unacquired Emotes or Morphs when customizing the ring menu.
[*] Characters below level 55 should no longer be able to access the Hall of Illusion UI when using a controller.
[*] Players will no longer be blocked from leaving the Lithograph menu when using a controller.
[/list]
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Wisdom for the Wilds of Talandre
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6Ze4H3xRHLmP8tpLg5My21/ae958498596abd6299b50e80df697593/TL_New_and_Returning_Player_Guide_v01_A_1080_CT-000016184.jpeg[/img]
Now is the perfect time to play THRONE AND LIBERTY, especially if you’re new to the game. Quality of life improvements, updates, and the free Wilds of Talandre expansion continue to help Solisium evolve into an even more enjoyable experience. Many of these changes were a direct result of player feedback. Whether you prefer PvP modes, lifestyle activities, the camaraderie of guilds, or something in-between, there’s something for everyone.

Join godspeed and Tico for an overview of the new zone, features, and systems, followed by guides featuring Twitch Creators [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kanonxo]KanonXO[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/notgrenton]Grenton[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wakayashi]Wakayashi[/url] before you set out on your next quest.

[h3]What is Wilds of Talandre?[/h3]
[previewyoutube=rHkOc0xoyy4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]KanonXO - Overview[/h3]
“If you're a new player or someone who is thinking about returning to the game to check out the expansion, now would be the best time to do so,“ [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kanonxo]KanonXO[/url] says. ”Tier 2 means there is essentially a reset in gear, so even if you don’t have maxed out Tier 1 gear, that’s okay because everyone needs to farm new Tier 2 pieces and build it up from scratch again anyway. They’re also releasing new T2 blue gear, which is going to be on par with T1 purple, only with less traits that can be attached to them that should also aid in catching up.“

[previewyoutube=SiAlS3uVLG8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Grenton - Revamped Weapon Mastery[/h3]
“We finally have a way to put our unique play styles and flair into the weapon combination we pick,” [url=https://www.twitch.tv/notgrenton]Grenton[/url] says. “Do you want to be a TRUE tank and give up a lot of offensive capabilities to just be able to tank a ton of damage? Yeah, you can do that! Want to finally fully submerge yourself into the damage over time playstyle of wand and forgo the healing side of it almost completely? Yup, you guessed it you can do that too.”

[previewyoutube=xLrrTojBXwA;full][/previewyoutube]

Returning players can look forward to level progression updates, new, diverse events, unexplored field dungeons, and ferocious new field bosses, plus a few surprises.

Note: This video is in German, but can be viewed with subtitles.

[previewyoutube=J04JwbFl1B0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Featured Creators[/h3]
Make sure to follow our featured Creators on Twitch for more guides, live high-level THRONE AND LIBERTY gameplay, and other original content.
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/kanonxo]KanonXO[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/notgrenton]Grenton[/url]

notes.title: Wilds of Talandre Twitch Drop, Discord Quest, and Prime Gaming Bundles
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2uTcBiHPfJyNkBj8XNCgif/d1c5425b64b9743f61f2fc767d43d5d4/TL_Summer_Game_Fest_Press_Screenshots_World_LizardIsland_v01_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Set off for the new zone with a Casual Chic outfit Twitch Drop, Talandre Prime Gaming bundle, and an Amitoi & Coin Bundle Discord Quest. All three will be available following the release of Wilds of Talandre on March 6. Here’s everything you need to know to explore the free expansion in style.

[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7zsh3adOKUp3uIGqUb22wt/b16446a7c612282fc58ecd7725d5839d/TL_TwitchDrop_TalandreCasualChic_1920x1080_CT-000016581.jpg[/img]
Support your favorite THRONE AND LIBERTY Twitch streamer following server maintenance on March 6 until March 19 to receive the Casual Chic outfit Twitch Drop. Additional Twitch Drops will also be available throughout March to celebrate the release of Talandre.

[h3]How to receive the Casual Chic outfit[/h3]
Two paid subscriptions (regular or gift) are required to receive the Casual Chic outfit Twitch Drop.
[list]
[*] If a gift subscription is purchased, the reward is granted to the person who paid for the subscription.
[*] Renewing an existing subscription will also count toward the reward.
[*] The subscription must be to any Creator who is broadcasting in the THRONE AND LIBERTY category during this campaign.
[*] Free subscriptions, including through Amazon Prime, will not count toward this Twitch Drop.
[/list]
If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform) you play on. Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.

[h3]Additional Talandre Twitch Drops[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5oksOoYKSjfftxvTvgIplu/d88be9d5dbef0d36bdf6592bd60166e6/TL_TwitchDrop_TalandrePart1_1920x1080_CT-000016582.jpg[/img]
Whether you watch your favorite streamer or hang out with a few new Creators, tune in for 4 to 9 hours of cumulative watch time starting March 6 until March 12 (9 a.m. PT) to receive the following:
[list]
[*] 500 Ornate Coins (4 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Event Pass: Wilds of Talandre Star Crystals (6 total hours watched)
[*] Disco Wolfie Amitoi (9 total hours watched)
[/list]
Drop progress is accrued toward all items simultaneously.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4Zw1zFJAkbBDJ3bMFmzoI2/2179362e2224f67a514539ce6a731958/TL_TwitchDrop_TalandrePart2_1920x1080_CT-000016583.jpg[/img]
A second Twitch Drop featuring the Gryphon Glide Morph will be available from March 13 until March 19 (9 a.m. PT). You can tune into the same streamer or give an entirely new set of Creators a try for 4 to 9 hours of cumulative watch time to receive the following:
[list]
[*] 500 Ornate Coins (4 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Event Pass: Wilds of Talandre Star Crystals (6 total hours watched)
[*] Gryphon Glide Morph (9 total hours watched)
[/list]
[h2]Amitoi & Coin Bundle Discord Quest[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/755BbiDw7iXW2w5elAzc84/701372f3a831dfc2f3daea1c59b64311/TL_Discord_Talandre_Promo_WEB_1920x1080_CT-000016550.jpg[/img]
The Quest for a Fuzzy Percy Amitoi, 200 Ornate Coins, and 200 Event Pass Star Crystals will be available for all Discord users. Play THRONE AND LIBERTY in Discord for 15 minutes following server maintenance on March 6 until 11:59 p.m. PT on March 12 to earn your Amitoi & Coin Bundle.

Please note this promotion is available for customers on all platforms located in territories supported by Amazon Games. Offer available while supplies last. Coupon codes from this Quest can only be used once per account and are valid until May 6.

[h3]Quest Completion[/h3]
This Discord Quest can be completed entirely through the Discord UI. Here’s how to walk away with your next Amitoi:
[list]
[*] In Discord, select the Discover icon at the bottom of the server list on the left side of the app. This will direct you to the Discover page where you can explore available Discord Quests. Select the Quest tab within the Discover list.
[*] In Quests, you will find the Wilds of Talandre Quest. Select Accept Quest to begin participating.
[*] Then, play THRONE AND LIBERTY for 15 minutes. You must be logged into the Discord desktop app to track your progress.
[/list]
[h3]Redemption Instructions[/h3]
Follow these steps to redeem your Coupon code:
[list]
[*] Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY and progress to the Title Screen.
[*] Either select an existing character or create a new one.
[*] Complete the tutorial and progress to Kastleton to unlock the Coupon feature.
[*] Open the Main Menu and select the Coupon button from the right pane.
[*] Enter the Coupon code received, then press the "Use" button.
[*] The relevant rewards will automatically become available on the character once the Coupon is claimed.
[/list]
You can even stream your gameplay with friends or save a favorite moment for the future. Additional information on Discord Quests can be found at [url=https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/22225719947543-Discord-Quests-FAQ]Discord Support[/url].

[h2]Talandre Prime Gaming Bundle[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4tgFeqH0ckS7nk7xgBJdkt/7a38bd40f894f5e37a9d91aee331cd6a/TL_PrimeGaming_WinterFestivalCache_1920x1080_CT-000011736.jpg[/img]
Additional Ornate Coins and other rewards are available from March 6 through [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-ca/forward-link?id=prime-gaming]Prime Gaming[/url] until April 9. If you are a Prime member, make sure to pick up the Talandre Bundle!
Enjoy Wilds of Talandre even more with the following loot:
[list]
[*] 300 Ornate Coins
[*] 10 Resistance Contracts
[*] 5,000 Abyssal Contract Tokens
[/list]
With Prime Gaming, members enjoy a rotating, monthly selection of free games, a free monthly Twitch channel subscription wherever Twitch is available, and more. Prime Gaming’s selection of free PC games is always growing and rotating to stay fresh, with new items and free games added every month.

Players who are not currently Prime members and are interested in accessing this limited-time THRONE AND LIBERTY cache can sign-up for a free, 30-day trial on the [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-ca/forward-link?id=prime-gaming]Prime Gaming website[/url]. Prime Gaming Loot can only be claimed once per account.

Stay tuned, we’ll have more content for Prime Gaming members in the future.

notes.title: See What's New in Throne and Liberty: Wilds of Talandre
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4OAWYdjtsWJi2XTgBQki0l/4eacf22994d09a2bd73e7db868578de5/TL_Wilds-of-Talandre_Final_1920x1080_WEB_EN_CT-000015764.jpg[/img]
A massive new zone, customizable weapon system, unexplored dungeons, unique events, and ferocious bosses await, plus a few surprises. Here's an overview of what to expect alongside our upcoming free expansion, Wilds of Talandre. Beyond the details you'll find our latest episode of Tico Talks, release notes, and a preview of our Talandre Celebration Packs.

[h3]New Zone: Talandre[/h3]
The new zone Talandre is ready to be claimed. Discover the next chapter in the story of THRONE AND LIBERTY, level up your character to 55, increase your lifestyle content levels to 25, and more. Along the way, you’ll encounter new, diverse events, unexplored field dungeons such as the Temple of Truth, and ferocious new field bosses.

Following the launch of Talandre, frequent milestones will introduce new regional events, archbosses, field dungeons, and other surprises. Watch our latest episode of Eye on Solisium for a brief overview of the content releasing alongside Talandre.

[previewyoutube=ocjOidvEzd8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Solo Dungeons[/h3]
Want to make an even bigger impact in your next group or guild activity? Triumph over new solo dungeons for an easier transition into more difficult content. You’ll also earn rewards for overcoming foes, obstacles, and unique mechanics. Stay tuned for an in-depth look at this new activity closer to release.

[h3]3-Star Dungeons[/h3]
For those that have mastered 2-Star Dungeons, we’re excited to see more experienced adventurers venture into our greatest challenge yet: 3-Star Dungeons. 3-Star Dungeons unlock when you hit level 55 and require a minimum combat power of 3,500.

Team up with your strongest allies to overcome the following 3-Star Dungeons:
[list]
[*] Rancorwood
[*] Halls of Tragedy
[*] Chapel of Madness
[*] Doomrot Grove
[*] Twisted Laboratory
[/list]
Desirable drops, like powerful Epic II Gear Sets, Training Dew, Amitoi, Abyssal Contract Token Points, and crafting materials await. You'll also receive rewards that can be used to craft items that drop Dimensional Soul Shards in each 3-Star Dungeon.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/oqm6xr8o02XM6nQCWVfil/d542835241d0453eee8c2f23dd9080fc/TL_Temple-of-Truth_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]Weapon Mastery Revamp[/h3]
Our weapon mastery revamp will introduce another layer of personalization as you progress your favorite weapons. Select nodes, alter or empower skills through key nodes, and experiment with different weapons and builds to unlock special skills across your entire arsenal.

Your current weapon mastery level will be converted into experience points in the new system.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/bzNsevjUYue6QefaosgSS/a57a0ddf2a675063a1c728182528b530/TL_HerbaVillage_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]Nebula Island[/h3]
Nebula Island, releasing after maintenance on March 13, is a new interserver activity accessible to level 55 players through the Secret Dungeons' Lawless Wilds tab. Players can spend up to 5 hours per week there, with additional time available through Nebula Charge Stones. 

The island consists of a central village and six distinct regions, including one peaceful zone and four war zones where PvP is always enabled. Players can access various hunting grounds through portals in the central village and collect Lesser and Greater Nebula Stones to exchange for items. The island features hourly events and periodic field boss battles with limited participation capacity. A new exclusive accessory system called Artifacts has also been introduced specifically for Nebula Island content.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/43A9Cm46LoUOJhzeSiR8HX/8507b2d8b80f2c3312f306ded90994ce/TL_Nebula-Island_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Artifact System[/h3]
Redefine your playstyle through unique skills with Artifact item sets when Artifacts release alongside Nebula Island following maintenance on March 13. Artifacts can be obtained from Nebula island and Abyss Dungeons in Talandre. 

The system consists of six parts: four Talistones, a Solarstone, and a Lunarstone, each with unique stats and effects. There are 14 different Artifact sets across three grades (2 Common, 4 Uncommon, and 8 Rare), with some stats being randomly determined upon acquisition. Players can trigger set bonuses by equipping 2, 4, or 6 matching pieces from the same set. The Solarstone provides an Active Skill while the Lunarstone grants a Passive Skill when equipped.


[h3]New Lifestyle Content[/h3]
Enjoy the cozier aspects of Talandre with 24 new fish, 4 new fishing rods, and a variety of new collectibles, plus 10 new cooking recipes and forage items. Players will also have another reason to gather ingredients now that the 5 types of Elixir items (Excellent Attack/Defense Elixirs, Rare Attack/Defense/Purification Elixirs) can be cooked.

While you’re exploring the zone for collectibles like the Cornelian Cherry Tree, your favorite Amitoi can set forth on Talandre Expeditions. They might even bring back new rewards.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5FHAADYIfUMjTaoGtwKsHP/487f919102c0bb14242206633b44beaa/TL_Wilds_Of_Talandre_EN_Final_1920x1080_CT-000015928.jpg[/img]

[h2]THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.15.2[/h2]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.15.2 downtime will begin at 9:00AM PT (5:00PM UTC) on February 26 and last approximately 10 hours for server consolidation. From the end of 1.15.2 maintenance until the start of maintenance on March 6, please enjoy double Field Boss spawns on all servers. Beginning after the 1.15.2 maintenance, 2 Arch Bosses will now spawn during Arch Boss schedule windows indefinitely. For more details on server consolidation, check out our announcement article.

Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below, plus the latest episode of Tico Talks featuring everything you need to know before Wilds of Talandre releases on March 6.

[previewyoutube=8MYNaeh2H8Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Talandre Celebration Packs[/h3]

Alongside the Wilds of Talandre expansion we’ll also be refreshing our popular launch celebration packs. We plan to keep the existing Bronze, Silver, and Gold format with newly added cosmetics. All 3 Talandre Celebration Packs will be available through the Shop on March 6. 

If you haven’t had a chance to pick up the THRONE AND LIBERTY Launch Celebration Packs, they will remain available until March 20. 

[b]Bronze[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/BD90BE1e9j3OlpF0CQ4h8/92a412d27bb9acc383f9a1216ed3c458/TL_Talandre_Bronze_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Detective Glynt Amitoi
[*] 1,125 Lucent
[/list]
[b]Silver[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3fPa1fP7zX3ExaAYDsalLM/72143a3e5f24ec54f87740b7ad3eb7ec/TL_Talandre_Silver_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Dappled Lumicora dash morph
[*] Steam Tsarca swim morph
[*] 2,875 Lucent
[/list]
[b]Gold[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2CExMLnaUaqOTnW9uHG3R2/5012d137b7e7c20e47b03b21c871ef1b/TL_Talandre_Gold_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Clover Wolfertinger glide morph
[*] Black Swan Outfit
[*] 6,000 Lucent
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused total points awarded from Dimensional Trials to not display correctly.
[*] Precious Purification Stone can now remove Fear effects. 
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented players from putting away the fishing rod unless they restarted the game when targeted by a party member's Salvation Chain ability.
[*] Codex: Chapter 10: Wolf and Spear quest has been added to the codex, making the Feral Wolfer Aranka guardian acquirable.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Queen Bellandir's Serrated Spike from being eligible for sale on the Auction House despite crafting one with a Great Success.
[*] Fixed an issue with previously Friendly guilds returning to the Friendly list even after the 3-guild limit had been reached.
[*] Culinary Contracts can now reward food items... again.
[*] Fixed an issue causing matchmaking penalties to apply when players changed instances (such as entering/leaving the Amitoi House) while a successful matchmaking popup was active.
[*] Morphs: Caerulean Cygnus and Rankuian Purpuma now properly contribute Growth Points.
[/list]
We can’t wait for players to get even more out of their adventures in Solisium when THRONE AND LIBERTY: Wilds of Talandre releases on March 6. In the meantime, stay tuned to our website, social channels, and release notes for the full list of new content, store updates, events, bug fixes, and more over the coming months.

Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Battle Pass: Ember’s Star
notes.content:
Set Solisium ablaze. This new Battle Pass features the Darkfire Ember Weapon Set, Little Rock Talem Amitoi, Winter Almiraz Dash Morph, Dote Gesture, Crouch pose, and more. Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

We have also decreased the length of the battle pass season from five weeks to four weeks. Quest reward XP has been increased to match the total obtainable Star Crystals from previous seasons. Learn more about the Battle Pass below, discover every featured reward in our video showcase, and then explore answers to your most common questions.

[h2]Showcase[/h2]
[previewyoutube=8Jg16MASg70;full][/previewyoutube]

The Ember’s Star Battle Pass will be available following maintenance on February 13 PT through March 13, 2 p.m. PT. There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot:
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track): Winter Almiraz Dash Morph
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track): Crouch Pose
[*] Level 20 (Free Track): Dote Gesture
[*] Level 31 (Premium Track): Little Rock Talem Amitoi
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track): Darkfire Ember Weapon Set (Select 2)
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in Ember’s Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals.

Here are some of the featured items from the Ember's Star Point Shop:
[list]
[*] Darkfire Ember Weapon Set
[*] Rare Rune Category Selection Chest
[*] Precious Processed Gem Selection Chest
[*] Trait Extraction and Conversion Stones
[*] Extra Resistance Contracts
[*] Dimensional Contract Tokens (Type I and II)
[*] Abyssal Contract Tokens
[*] Skill Conversion Books
[*] Trait Unlock Stones
[*] Precious Parchment
[*] and more!
[/list]
Want to learn more about how the Battle Pass works? Check out our FAQ.

[h3]FAQ[/h3]
How do I buy the premium track?
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial, the premium track can be purchased with Lucent from the Battle Pass screen. Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY, and once in-game navigate to the Battle Pass section of the in-game menu to purchase the premium track from there. If you need Lucent, it can be purchased from the in-game store.
[/list]
How can I progress my Battle Pass?
[list]
[*] Players can complete daily, weekly, and ongoing seasonal challenges to progress their Battle Pass. Additionally, players can purchase up to 49 levels with Lucent. Levels purchased beyond the max are converted to Star Crystals.
[/list]
Do I miss out on daily quests if I don’t log in every day?
[list]
[*] No! Daily quests are granted each day throughout the season and “banked.” That means you can complete as many as you have available upon log in.
[/list]
How can I access the Battle Pass Point Shop?
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass Point Shop is accessible to all players as soon as you gain Battle Pass Shop Points. The shop contains various rewards and offers, including items to help with progression. Once a character achieves the maximum Battle Pass level, all subsequent Battle Pass experience will be converted into Battle Pass Shop Points.
[/list]
Do I need to purchase the Battle Pass to buy items from the Battle Pass Point Shop?
[list]
[*] Generally everything is purchasable for all players. There my be items, typically cosmetic, that are gated behind the premium purchase.
[/list]
Can I buy the Battle Pass late into the season?
[list]
[*] Yes! When you purchase the premium track you'll receive all of the rewards up to your current Battle Pass level retroactively.
[/list]
If I don’t buy the premium track can I still earn rewards?
[list]
[*] Yes! If you don’t purchase the premium track you’ll still earn a reward for every completed level on the free track.
[/list]
If I buy the premium track do I still get the rewards from the free track?
[list]
[*] Yes! Everyone that plays THRONE AND LIBERTY can make progress and earn rewards on the free track.
[/list]
Can I earn rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?
[list]
[*] After a Battle Pass ends, many of its rewards will become unobtainable. However, for a limited time you’ll have a grace period to claim some of the free and paid track rewards you might have missed.
[/list]
Can I claim my rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?
[list]
[*] Yes! After a Battle Pass ends you will still be able to claim any earned rewards from that Battle Pass. These items can be found in the Battle Pass menu. Select the tab of the previous season to claim your items. You will have until the end of the following Battle Pass to claim them.
[/list]
How will the Battle Pass work for multiple characters on the same account?
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass progression and non-cosmetic rewards are character specific.
[*] Battle Pass Rewards can be earned and claimed once per character.
[*] If you transfer your character to another server, battle pass progress will transfer with the character.
[*] Cosmetic rewards are account wide. Once they are claimed on any of your characters, they’ll be available to all of your characters.
[/list]
If I buy the premium track on one platform, can I access it on another platform?
[list]
[*] No, the Battle Pass is character specific and can only be accessed on your character’s platform.
[/list]
Can I replay or complete previous Battle Passes?
[list]
[*] Progress cannot be made on a Battle Pass once the season ends.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.15.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5I3udAAZDfoljqa2W5Vkf0/acc6bd396be796053424224139d575a5/tl_announce_screenshots_shapeshift_goblins_1920-720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.15.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on February 12 and last approximately 6 hours. It includes the start of the Solisium Valentine's Day event. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.

[h3]Free Server Transfer Period Begins - Server Consolidation[/h3]
Following maintenance on February 13 PT, all players will be able to purchase one free server transfer per character from the in-game shop. Transfer cooldowns will be reset for all characters and temporarily reduced to 72 hours. Players may choose to transfer to any eligible server during this period.

At the end of the free-transfer period on February 27 PT, all characters remaining on consolidation servers will be transferred automatically to the new destination server. No manual action is required. Character transfer cooldowns will also be reverted back to the standard 30 days.

Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/server-consolidation]Server Consolidation announcement[/url] for more details.

[h3]Bonus Buffs and Items - Server Consolidation[/h3]
All characters on all servers will receive the following buffs for the duration of the open transfer period from February 13 PT until February 27 PT:
[list]
[*] Sollant Buff: Gain 20% more Sollant from hunting monsters.
[*] Mastery Buff: Gain 50% more Mastery experience from defeating mobs in Abyss Dungeons when Abyssal Tokens are consumed.
[*] Training Dew: Receive 50% more Training Dew from sources that reward it.
Example: If a Contract normally awarded 4 Dew, you would receive 6 Dew during this Event.
[/list]
Log in daily for additional bonus awards granted through the daily login event running through February 27 PT.

[h3]Valentine's Day Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] As a token of our appreciation, please enjoy some seasonal crafted recipes, daily login rewards, and event vendor rewards in honor of Valentine's Day through February 26!
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] After maintenance, the Violetta's Star Battle Pass will come to an end, and the new Ember's Star Battle Pass begins!
[*] Reminder! Season One of Arena and Dimensional Trials will come to an end at the start of maintenance on February 26.
[*] PvP: Assist points are now granted to healers when party members they have healed successfully defeat other players.
[*] Items: Many common items have had their stack sizes increased to a limit of 10,000.
[*] 1-Star Dungeons: Boss rewards for completing 1-Star dungeons can now be opened 3 times at the end of the run for increased rewards.
[*] Guilds: Expired Guild Alliance requests no longer block guilds from sending a new Alliance request in the future.
[*] Arena: Corrected the Imperator rank requirement to 2,200 points.
[*] Arena: Fixed an issue preventing players from starting 3v3 Friendly Arenas.
[*] Parties: Fixed an issue on consoles where parties may not form after accepting system-level party invites.
[*] Combat: Auto-Move within range to use beneficial skills setting should now work properly with the Bow's Healing Touch and Purifying Touch, as well as Greatsword's Blood Devotion.
[*] Players can now use Special Resistance Medals to craft Polished Crystals and Training Dew at the Sundries Crafter.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.14.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5c2GO9izgMuRphxxKILCFd/d94e1f257ea8935bd416b3afda98f9f4/TL_LNY_Screenshots_11_WEB_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.14.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (6:30AM UTC) on February 5 and last approximately 11.5 hours while we merge the auction house. Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/server-consolidation]server consolidation article[/url] for more details on the auction house merge. This update also marks the end of the Lunar Celebration festivities. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Season One for both Arena and Dimensional Trials will come to an end at the start of maintenance on February 26.
