notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY: Wilds of Talandre Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6XEGhbOcj2oBiHnPs6eHap/e5689b99869ee9cf2d03972230c6a115/TL_170729_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
We’re thrilled to share a first look at what to expect when our upcoming free expansion,[i] THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i]: Wilds of Talandre, arrives on March 6. This article will cover key content launching throughout March, plus highlights we know players are eagerly awaiting. From new dungeons to a weapon mastery revamp, new lifestyle content, and more, there is something for every adventurer. Please note, the following feature spotlights are not a comprehensive list of every update coming to THRONE AND LIBERTY in March and may change.

Look forward to additional details as we approach Wilds of Talandre. We’ll also share comprehensive lists of new content, balance changes, and more alongside every update.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4OAWYdjtsWJi2XTgBQki0l/4eacf22994d09a2bd73e7db868578de5/TL_Wilds-of-Talandre_Final_1920x1080_WEB_EN_CT-000015764.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Zone: Talandre[/h3]
The new zone Talandre is ready to be claimed. Discover the next chapter in the story of THRONE AND LIBERTY, level up your character to 55, increase your lifestyle content levels to 25, and more. Along the way, you’ll encounter new, diverse events, unexplored field dungeons such as the Temple of Truth, and ferocious new field bosses.

Following the launch of Talandre, frequent milestones will introduce new regional events, archbosses, field dungeons, and other surprises. Watch our latest episode of Eye on Solisium for a brief overview of the content releasing alongside Talandre.

[previewyoutube=uIXmI-iiyew;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Solo Dungeons[/h3]
Want to make an even bigger impact in your next group or guild activity? Triumph over new solo dungeons for an easier transition into more difficult content. You’ll also earn rewards for overcoming foes, obstacles, and unique mechanics. Stay tuned for an in-depth look at this new activity closer to release.

[h3]3-Star Dungeons[/h3]
For those that have mastered 2-Star Dungeons, we’re excited to see more experienced adventurers venture into our greatest challenge yet: 3-Star Dungeons. 3-Star Dungeons unlock when you hit level 55 and require a minimum combat power of 3,500.

Team up with your strongest allies to overcome the following 3-Star Dungeons:
[list]
[*] Rancorwood
[*] Mansion of Tragedy
[*] Chapel of Madness
[*] Cruel Witch’s Garden
[*] Assassin Laboratory
[/list]
Desirable drops, like powerful Epic II Gear Sets, Training Dew, Amitoi, Abyssal Contract Token Points, and crafting materials await. You'll also receive rewards that can be used to craft items that drop Dimensional Soul Shards in each 3-Star Dungeon.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/oqm6xr8o02XM6nQCWVfil/d542835241d0453eee8c2f23dd9080fc/TL_Temple-of-Truth_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]Weapon Mastery Revamp[/h3]
Our weapon mastery revamp will introduce another layer of personalization as you progress your favorite weapons. Select nodes, alter or empower skills through key nodes, and experiment with different weapons and builds to unlock special skills across your entire arsenal.

Your current weapon mastery level will be converted into experience points in the new system.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/bzNsevjUYue6QefaosgSS/a57a0ddf2a675063a1c728182528b530/TL_HerbaVillage_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]Nebula Island[/h3]
Nebula Island is a new interserver activity accessible to level 55 players through the Secret Dungeons' Lawless Zone tab. Players can spend up to 7 hours per week there, with additional time available through Nebula Charge Stones. The island consists of a central village (Resistance Surveillance Camp) and six distinct regions, including one peaceful zone (Fog Forest) and four war zones where PvP is always enabled. Players can access various hunting grounds through portals in the Resistance Surveillance Camp and collect Lesser and Greater Nebula Stones to exchange for items. The island features hourly events and periodic field boss battles with limited participation capacity. A new exclusive accessory system called Artifacts has also been introduced specifically for Nebula Island content.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/43A9Cm46LoUOJhzeSiR8HX/8507b2d8b80f2c3312f306ded90994ce/TL_Nebula-Island_1920x1080_Final.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Artifact System[/h3]
Redefine your playstyle through unique skills with Artifact item sets. Artifacts can be obtained from Nebula Island and Abyss Dungeons in the Talandre region. The system consists of six parts: four Talistones, a Solar Stone, and a Lunar Stone, each with unique stats and effects. There are 14 different Artifact sets across three grades (2 Common, 4 Uncommon, and 8 Rare), with some stats being randomly determined upon acquisition. Players can trigger set bonuses by equipping 2, 4, or 6 matching pieces from the same set. The Solar Stone provides an Active Skill while the Lunar Stone grants a Passive Skill when equipped.

[h3]New Lifestyle Content[/h3]
Enjoy the cozier aspects of Talandre with 24 new fish, 4 new fishing rods, and a variety of new collectibles, plus 10 new cooking recipes and forage items. Players will also have another reason to gather ingredients now that the 5 types of Elixir items (Excellent Attack/Defense Elixirs, Rare Attack/Defense/Purification Elixirs) can be cooked.

While you’re exploring the region for collectibles like the Cornelian Cherry Tree, your favorite Amitoi can set forth on Talandre Expeditions. They might even bring back new rewards.

We can’t wait for players to get even more out of their adventures in Solisium when [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i]: Wilds of Talandre releases on March 6. In the meantime, stay tuned to our website, social channels, and release notes for the full list of new content, store updates, events, bug fixes, and more over the coming months. Head over to the [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Discord server[/url] to let us know your thoughts on Wilds of Talandre.

Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Server Consolidation
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6pJmeCgZijBPW7MYgfp0la/68d2163683ac24cd9c98fd1ffdcd9c2b/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_FonosBasin_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
In order to normalize player distribution across our current servers and provide you with a stable and refreshed experience, we are making the following adjustments to our servers over 3 phases. The auction house will be consolidated on February 6 PT, followed by an open transfer period from February 13 PT until February 27 PT, and the server consolidation on February 27 PT. Look forward to additional buffs, daily login rewards, and more throughout the open transfer window.

Check out the new server list groupings by region below and then read on for an overview of what to expect throughout each phase of the consolidation. Please note there is no impact to PlayStation 5-only servers.

[h2]New Server List[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/pKRn3up98J7eR4z0sztB5/dac9511d482175cd1add5373c5a2f599/TL_Server_Consolidation_Table_Final_1920x1080_EN_CT-000016001.jpg[/img]

[h2]1) Auction House Consolidation[/h2]
Following maintenance on February 6 PT, regional auctions houses will be consolidated for early access and full launch servers. Players within each region will use a single combined auction house to list and purchase items. Please note this does not apply to PlayStation 5-only servers. Platform specific servers will continue to have a separate auction house. Please note maintenance downtime will be longer than usual.
[list]
[*] Item information registered in Favorites as well as Historical item prices on all servers will also be reset.
[/list]
[h2]2) Open Transfer Period[/h2]
Following maintenance on February 13 PT, all characters will be able to purchase one free server transfer per character from the in-game shop. Transfer cool-downs will be reset for all characters and temporarily reduced to 72 hours. Players may choose to transfer to any eligible server during this period. We’ll also remove early access tags from servers.

At the end of the free-transfer period on February 27 PT, all characters remaining on consolidation servers will be transferred automatically to the new server. No manual action is required. Character transfer cool-downs will also be reverted back to the standard 30 days.

[h3]All-day buff support[/h3]
All characters on all servers will receive the following buffs for the duration of the open transfer period from February 13 PT until February 27 PT.
[list]
[*] Sollant Buff: Gain 20% more Sollant from hunting monsters.
[*] Mastery Buff: Gain 50% more Mastery experience from defeating mobs in Abyss Dungeons when Abyssal Tokens are consumed.
[*] Training Dew: Receive 50% more Training Dew from sources that reward it.
Example: If a Contract normally awarded 4 Dew, you would receive 6 Dew during this Event.
[/list]
[h3]Daily login rewards[/h3]
Log in each day from February 13 PT until February 27 PT to get everything from consumables to Amitoi! Different Check-In rewards will be available daily, including the memorable Title: Star-traveler and Brawler Captain Dentwerp Amitoi.
[list]
[*] Note: Check-In will reset every day at 6:00AM local server time.
[/list]
[h3]Reward Details[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3VaGgitEhhGl8LiC8mrXjB/926fe86a52f1e90fd6bd9b1a8ab33853/TL_DailyRewards_EN_1920x1080_CT-000015703.jpg[/img]
[h2]3) Server Consolidation[/h2]
On February 27, 12PM PT, all characters remaining on any server marked for consolidation will be transferred to the new server. Maintenance will begin earlier than usual to allow for additional support and the new server's opening time is subject to change during stability testing.
[list]
[*] As a result of the server consolidation, rankings, including leaderboards and ownership of Boonstone/Riftstone/Castle-owning guilds, will be reset.
[*] Please note that chat history and blocks will also be reset.
[*] Residual taxes from the to-be consolidated servers will be combined and transferred to the unified server.
[/list]
[b]Siege Warfare Legion Selection and Schedule[/b]
[list]
[*] The date of the first post-consolidation siege and when the legion guild will be selected will be included in our follow-up article at the end of next week.
[*] The guild with the highest confirmed guild ranking prior to the Siege will become the Legion or defending guild.
[*] The selected guilds will be announced separately after confirmation and designation.
[/list]
[h3]Server Consolidation Breakdown[/h3]
Check out a breakdown of what will be retained and reset due to the server merger.

[b]Character Info[/b]
The following will be retained:
[list]
[*] Character name and growth information
[*] Current Battle/Growth Pass information
[*] Character possession information (Guardians, Morphs, Amitoi, Equipment Lithograph Books, etc.)
[*] Content progression information (Codices, Taedal's Tower, Gate of Infinity, Lawless Zone, etc.)
[*] Content access points (Abyssal Contract Tokens, Dimensional Contract I/II Tokens, Resistance Contract count, Lawless Zone time, etc.)
[*] Shop character purchase limit
[*] All currencies, including Lucent
[*] Personal Relationships (Friends, Feuds, Interests, Blocked)
[/list]
[b]Character-Owned Items[/b]
The following will be retained:
[list]
[*] Equipped items and inventory/Storage items
[*] Equipped/stored Runes
[*] Mail and unclaimed items in the mailbox
[*] Items in the Storage Chest
[*] Costumes, weapon appearances, and emotes in the Mirror Boutique
[/list]
[b]Guild Info[/b]
The following will be retained:
[list]
[*] Guild name, level, and members
[*] Guild EXP and Contract history
[*] Guild kill records and relationship/distribution/administration records
[*] The following will reset:
[*] Guild members' Reputation in the last 7 days
[/list]
[b]Ranking Info[/b]
The following will be reset:
[list]
[*] Activity/Kill ranking score
[*] Guild ranking score reset
[*] Guild level will be retained, but the ranking will be recalculated based on the newly accumulated Guild/Guild Member Activity Points.
[/list]
[b]Auction House[/b]
The following will be retained:
[list]
[*] Items registered in Auction House on the existing server will be moved to the new server.
[*] Sold items and unsold items
[/list]
The following will be reset:
[list]
[*] Market price
[*] Favorite item info
[/list]
[b]Server Environment[/b]
The following will be reset:
[list]
[*] Boonstone/Riftstone-owning guilds
[*] Castle Legion
[*] Lucent/Sollant taxes from the old servers will be totaled and credited to the new server castle.
[*] Growth rankings will be recalculated on the merged server with information from the target servers.
[/list]
[b]Chat History[/b]
The following will be reset:
[list]
[*] All chats, including characters on the merged servers
[*] Block history reset
[*] Character profile deselected
[*] After the consolidation, if you manually select a transferred character or log in to the game without one selected, your profile will be automatically selected.
[/list]
[b]In-game chat[/b]
The following will be reset:
[list]
[*] All chats that include characters on the merged servers will be reset.
[*] Block history reset
[/list]
[b]Other[/b]
The following will be retained:
[list]
[*] Personal pin info
[*] Crafting Favorites
[*] Quick slots and game settings
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Lunar Celebration Drop
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3j7DHSiLyxZPtYmqs1eMG9/b06b5ec783c6730b4b84007665ff5c82/TL_LNY_Screenshots_02_WEB_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Celebrate Lunar New Year with highly desirable in-game currency and Star Crystals, plus tips for making the most of your spoils. Whether you want to pick up desirable items in Violetta's Star Point Shop or capitalize on additional Ornate Coins for extra rewards, this loot will help you get even more out of your adventure in Solisium.

Whether you watch your favorite streamer or hang out with a few new Creators, simply tune in for 8 hours of cumulative watch time before February 13, 2025 to claim your Lunar Celebration Drop.
[list]
[*] 200 Ornate Coins (2 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Ornate Coins (5 total hours watched)
[*] 300 Battle Pass Star Crystals (8 total hours watched)
[/list]
If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform you play on). [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/twitch-drops]Twitch Drops[/url] can only be claimed once per account.

[h3]Battle Pass Star Crystals[/h3]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in Violetta’s Star Point Shop. As you progress your [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/battle-pass-violettas-star]Battle Pass[/url], you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season on February 13, 2 p.m. PT, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals.

Here are some of the featured items from Violetta’s Star Point Shop:
[list]
[*] Rare Rune Category Selection Chest
[*] Precious Processed Gem Selection Chest
[*] Trait Extraction and Conversion Stones
[*] Extra Resistance Contracts
[*] Dimensional Contract Tokens (Type I and II)
[*] Abyssal Contract Tokens
[*] Skill Conversion Books
[*] Trait Unlock Stones
[*] Precious Parchment
[*] and more!
[/list]
[h3]Ornate Coins[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3G2rgnK2Zs2u8ZiJY5UN1F/20dfea826022ad720c42c9efe0ffcd53/TL_Discord_Coin_Promo_WEB_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Looking for recommendations on how to spend your Ornate Coins? Here are some suggestions:
[list]
[*] Precious Blessing Pouch grants you 2 Resistance Contracts and 1 Rare or Epic piece of gear you may not have in your inventory. After purchasing the pouch, you can check out the list of possible items. Your most sought-after weapon or armor might be waiting for you.
[*] Precious Active Skill Growth Book can be purchased in case you’re having trouble crafting or finding more of them throughout your adventures. Skill Books are valuable resources to grow your abilities’ power.
[*] Looking to increase your gear’s potency? Precious Weapon Growthstone, Precious Armor Growthstone, and Precious Accessory Growthstone are all available in exchange for Ornate Coins.
[*] If your hero’s gear and skills are already at their highest potential, you can spend your Ornate Coins on unique Amitoi. These are especially helpful for Amitoi Expeditions or if you aim to collect them all.
[*] More interested in appearances? Look into the selection of extra titles like "Kind of a Big Deal" or "Trendsetter" to better match your character’s look and feel.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.13.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4leN8NkxS63XqmcqM7HhH4/6b133f784fde0ffd5f504b331a0bda13/TL_LNY_Screenshots_01_WEB_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.13.0 downtime will begin at 9:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on January 22 and last approximately 6.5 hours. With festive decorations like a giant cobra statue in every village, the year of the snake has come to Solisium. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.

[h2]Event: Lunar Celebration[/h2]
Join the Lunar Celebration event after maintenance completes on January 23 until the start of maintenance on February 5 for event-specific daily login rewards. Gather New Year Coins from various activities and then exchange your spoils at the event store for unique loot, including a Food Coma emote, Fortune’s Chosen title, and Wisdom Seeker Profile frame.

[h3]Daily Login Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Log in daily for rewards like event bait, Blue Snake Scales, New Year Coins, and New Year's Cards.
[*] Acquire Blue Snake Scales and then interact with the cobra statue in each village to receive a Lucky Red Envelope for Sollant.
[/list]
[h3]New Year Coins[/h3]
New Year Coins can be obtained from:
[list]
[*] Resistance Contracts (excluding Item Contracts)
[*] Dynamic Event performance rewards (Can only be received once during the same Dynamic Event period)
[*] Level 50+ Archbosses and Field Bosses
[*] 1-Star Co-op Dungeon Chests (Trials I)
[*] 2-Star Co-op Dungeon Chest (Trials II)
[*] Fishing with event bait
[*] New Year’s Cards can also be acquired with event bait.
[*] Amitoi Expeditions
[/list]
[h3]Event Store (NPC New Year Coin exchange)[/h3]
The event shop will remain open until February 12, 2025 at 10:30PM PT.
[list]
[*] Profile Frame: Wisdom Seeker
[*] Title: Fortune's Chosen
[*] Emote: Food Coma
[*] Precious Polished Crystal
[*] Training Dew: 10,000 Points
[*] Trait Unlockstone
[*] Trait Extraction Stone
[*] Rare Rune Category Selection Chest
[*] Rare Chaos Rune Selection Chest
[*] Precious Active Skill Growth Book Selection Chest
[*] Precious Passive Skill Growth Book
[*] Quality Stellarite x100
[/list]
[h3]Event Buffs[/h3]
Acquire New Year Coins and interact with the event NPC (Lunar-25) for temporary, event-specific buffs. Visit Lunar-25 before entering any abyssal or co-op dungeons to capitalize on the following bonuses:
[list]
[*] Happy Lunar Buff: increased Sollant, increased Abyssal Contract Token Efficiency, and additional Mastery Efficiency. This buff will not stack with Attack/Defense/Hybrid (Combat) buffs.
[*] Lucky Lunar Buff: Boss Heavy Attack and Boss Critical Hit Chance. This buff will not stack with currency or experience buffs.
[/list]
[h2]Notable Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Currency tab has been added to the Inventory UI. This tab holds currency-type items across multiple gameplay sources, reducing the amount of items that need to be held in your inventory or storage. Existing currency items in player inventory and storage chests have been converted automatically to the new currency tab format.
[*] Party Member List: Numbers assigned to party members now update when the party member list is reordered.
[*] Field Bosses: War mode Field Bosses now display a UI element showing each guild's contribution percentage.
[*] Shadowed Crypt: The same chests that spawn at night on Saurodoma Island now also spawn at various locations in Shadowed Crypt.
[*] Crafting NPCs in each town can now craft up to Epic tier items, making it so higher-tier crafting is available in all cities.
[*] Guild Buffs: Added three new types of Guild buffs, boosting Weapon Mastery, Cooking and Fishing experience, or offering guild member resurrection in a small radius outside of Dungeons or Arenas.
[*] Guild Buffs: Removed the standard experience buff from the list of available guild buffs.
[*] Guild Buffs: Adjusted the Sollant and Abyss Contract Token Efficiency buffs to provide greater benefit over a longer duration.
[*] Dimensional Trials: Killing bosses in Dimensional Trials now offers the same boss loot chest available from the Dungeon version.
[*] Siege: Future Castle Siege events will take place at 20:00 (8:00pm) server time in each region, instead of 16:00 (4:00pm).
[*] Rune System: Expanded the capacity of the Rune Bag to 300 slots.
[*] Weekly Reset: During this maintenance, the weekly content reset time will shift 2 hours, to take place during maintenance windows (08:00 UTC).
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character: You can now edit current stats instead of fully resetting them, allowing you to adjust the current values without having to re-spend all points.
[*] Items: Food: In some cases, multiple food buffs from the same category could be active at the same time unintentionally. Now only Miscellaneous (experience gain type) food buffs can have multiple active effects at the same time.
[*] Amitoi Expedition: Fixed an issue that occasionally prevented Amitoi expeditions from completing properly at the end of their timer.
[*] Map: Removed the ability to track players from your friends, target of interest, and hostile lists through minimap icons.
[*] Map: Added weather forecasts to zone information on the World Map.
[*] Arena: Purification Stones once again work in arenas.
[*] Events: Tax Delivery: Available times to schedule the Tax Delivery event have been adjusted to avoid overlap with certain Dynamic Events that could change the stats of the Tax Delivery Golem.
[*] Cooking: The cooking recipe system unintentionally reverted to the multi-quality output version in a prior update. This has been corrected, and cooking recipes once again produce increased quantities of meals instead of different qualities when crafting.
[*] Controller: Gate of Infinity: Fixed an issue preventing collection of ranking rewards from Gate of Inifinity when using a controller.
[*] Controller: Dimensional Trials: Fixed an issue preventing controllers from adjusting the tier of Dimensional Trial when creating a Party Board recruitment.
[*] Spear: Gale Rush: Fixed an issue where the CC removal specialization would sometimes not apply when targeting allies at a distance.
[*] Spear: Gale Rush: Fixed an issue that could prevent Gale Rush from being used on enemy targets at slightly higher elevations than the attacker.
[*] Field Boss: Ahzriel: Adjusted a location that incorrectly retained Peace status during War mode Ahzriel.
[*] Syleus' Abyss: Adjusted a barrier wall preventing two piton points from being accessible for traversal below the Eastern room.
[*] Torture Chamber of Screams: Fixed an issue that caused Shadow of Screams to not properly follow players if they had been pushed with collision skill effects.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inventory: Closing your inventory after opening a container with item rewards will now also close the acquired item popup.
[*] Items: Tooltips for gear with set bonuses now indicate which items in the set you have equipped.
[*] Guild Raids: Adjusted display of guild raids to clearly show participation rewards versus boss loot rewards.
[*] Items: Creating a Lithograph from an item in your inventory will no longer display an untradeable result in the pre-crafting window.
[*] Chat: Added additional Chat settings to the settings menu, including expanded chat color options.
[*] Mirror Boutique: Added more view angle range to the camera so you can now view your character from more different angles.
[*] Sprouts and Sages: Adjusted the display of qualifications for the Sprouts and Sages system.
[*] Adventure Codex: Unclaimed rewards from Adventure Codex completion should trigger UI notifications more reliably.
[*] Settings: Added the option to hide the item comparison keybind hints at the bottom of equipment tooltips.
[*] Fishing Codex: Minor adjustments to the display of caught fish stats and sizes.

Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Battle Pass: Violetta's Star
notes.content:
Start the new year in style. This new Battle Pass features the Violetta outfit, Jungle Buddy Talem Amitoi, Flos Ferthur Glide Morph, Sleepy Gesture, Lie on Side Pose and more.

Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

Learn more about the Battle Pass below, discover every featured reward in our video showcase, and then explore answers to your most common questions.

[h2]Showcase[/h2]
[previewyoutube=HdcErfxVypc;full][/previewyoutube]

The Violetta’s Star Battle Pass is available now through February 13, 2PM PT. There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot.
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track): Jungle Buddy Talem Amitoi
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track): Flos Ferthur Glide Morph
[*] Level 20 (Free Track): Gesture: Sleepy
[*] Level 31 (Premium Track): Pose: Lie on Side
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track): Violetta outfit
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in the Violetta’s Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals.

Here are some of the featured items from the Violetta’s Star Point Shop.
[list]
[*] Rare Rune Category Selection Chest
[*] Precious Processed Gem Selection Chest
[*] Trait Extraction & Conversion Stones
[*] Extra Resistance Contracts
[*] Dimensional Contract Tokens (Type I & II)
[*] Abyssal Contract Tokens
[*] Skill Conversion Books
[*] Trait Unlock Stones
[*] Precious Parchment
[*] and more!
[/list]
[h3]FAQ[/h3]
How do I buy the premium track?
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial, the premium track can be purchased with Lucent from the Battle Pass screen. Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY, and once in-game navigate to the Battle Pass section of the in-game menu to purchase the premium track from there. If you need Lucent, it can be purchased from the in-game store.
[/list]
How can I progress my Battle Pass?
[list]
[*] Players can complete daily, weekly, and ongoing seasonal challenges to progress their Battle Pass. Additionally, players can purchase up to 49 levels with Lucent. Levels purchased beyond the max are converted to Star Crystals.
[/list]
Do I miss out on daily quests if I don’t log in every day?
[list]
[*] No! Daily quests are granted each day throughout the season and “banked.” That means you can complete as many as you have available upon log in.
[/list]
How can I access the Battle Pass Point Shop?
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass Point Shop is accessible to all players as soon as you gain Battle Pass Shop Points. The shop contains various rewards and offers, including items to help with progression. Once a character achieves the maximum Battle Pass level, all subsequent Battle Pass experience will be converted into Battle Pass Shop Points.
[/list]
Do I need to purchase the Battle Pass to buy items from the Battle Pass Point Shop?
[list]
[*] Generally everything is purchasable for all players. There my be items, typically cosmetic, that are gated behind the premium purchase.
[/list]
Can I buy the Battle Pass late into the season?
[list]
[*] Yes! When you purchase the premium track you'll receive all of the rewards up to your current Battle Pass level retroactively.
[/list]
If I don’t buy the premium track can I still earn rewards?
[list]
[*] Yes! If you don’t purchase the premium track you’ll still earn a reward for every completed level on the free track.
[/list]
If I buy the premium track do I still get the rewards from the free track?
[list]
[*] Yes! Everyone that plays THRONE AND LIBERTY can make progress and earn rewards on the free track.
[/list]
Can I earn rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?
[list]
[*] After a Battle Pass ends, many of its rewards will become unobtainable. However, for a limited time you’ll have a grace period to claim some of the free and paid track rewards you might have missed.
[/list]
Can I claim my rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?
[list]
[*] Yes! After a Battle Pass ends you will still be able to claim any earned rewards from that Battle Pass. These items can be found in the Battle Pass menu. Select the tab of the previous season to claim your items. You will have until the end of the following Battle Pass to claim them.
[/list]
How will the Battle Pass work for multiple characters on the same account?
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass progression and non-cosmetic rewards are character specific.
[*] Battle Pass Rewards can be earned and claimed once per character.
[*] If you transfer your character to another server, battle pass progress will transfer with the character.
[*] Cosmetic rewards are account wide. Once they are claimed on any of your characters, they’ll be available to all of your characters.
[/list]
If I buy the premium track on one platform, can I access it on another platform?
[list]
[*] No, the Battle Pass is character specific and can only be accessed on your character’s platform.
[/list]
Can I replay or complete previous Battle Passes?
[list]
[*] Progress cannot be made on a Battle Pass once the season ends.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Tico Talks - Holiday Letter
notes.content:
Dear THRONE AND LIBERTY Community,

What’s up gamers? I’m Tico, the Globalization Design Manager for THRONE AND LIBERTY at Amazon Games. I wanted to do something different from our usual Tico Talks format as the year draws to a close. There's something special about sitting down and writing a letter, especially during the holiday season. So here I am, ready to share some thoughts as we wrap up an incredible 2024.

When I reflect back on this year, what stands out aren’t just the countless hours of development or the features we've launched, but also the moments we've shared together. Watching guilds coordinate massive battles, seeing players help newcomers learn the ropes, and reading your passionate discussions about the game — these are the things that make all the hard work worthwhile. Every time I log in and see players enjoying themselves in Solisium, it reminds me why we do what we do.

December has been absolutely packed with excitement, and I want to take a moment to celebrate some of these moments with you. On the 5th, we introduced the Spear, and you have astonished me with your creativity! I've seen several unique combinations and strategies that I didn't anticipate, and I have a feeling we're just beginning to see what's possible with this weapon. Along with that, we expanded our fishing content, and it's been nice to have some moments of relaxation in the world to complete my new Codex. We unveiled our challenging Dimensional Trial Dungeons — and wow — the ways you've been tackling these trials has been nothing short of amazing! Watching players push the boundaries of what's possible while mastering these challenges has been incredible. 

We introduced the new Rune progression system, opening up a whole new method of power progression that's leading to some interesting build combinations, especially with the Spear and new Fortitude stat. One of my personal favorites has been watching guilds utilize the new War Games feature. There's something special about seeing teams practice and perfect their strategies in preparation for those epic open-world battles. And yes, I have to mention it — Equipment and Skill presets are finally here! I know many of you have been waiting patiently for this one, and trust me, I'm just as excited as you are!

Finally, the Startree Solstice Event that launched on the 12th has brought such a wonderful festive atmosphere to our world. I've caught myself more than once standing in town watching players show off their holiday cosmetics and enjoying the Winter Amitoi Arena matches. The community's enthusiasm for these seasonal events always brings a smile to my face.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5JrENwQU9P1gjycKv88hzw/fd20f0ca8cbf74516a0825a6513cc54a/TL_Winter-Event_deco_03_1080.jpg[/img]

I also want to talk about listening to your feedback, beginning with addressing the changes made to Rune distribution on the 19th. Many of you shared concerns about feeling pressured to farm Dimensional Trials for Runes, and I also experienced this firsthand while playing. We've now increased Rune outputs across various content types because we believe you should be able to progress while playing the content you love most. We’ll keep evaluating how it feels after these changes, and we’re not afraid to keep tweaking until it feels right. And to my fellow PvP enthusiasts — don't worry, we haven't forgotten about you. We're working on expanding Rune acquisition through PvP beyond just arena coins, so keep an eye out for those changes in the new year. 

Looking ahead to 2025, we're tackling some important challenges head-on. First and foremost, we hear your feedback about daily activities feeling a bit overwhelming. While we believe it's important to have engaging content for you to log in and enjoy each day, we recognize that with new additions we've reached a point where the "daily checklist" feels more like a chore than an adventure. Finding the right balance here is a top priority for us, and we're exploring several solutions to help you feel less pressured while still maintaining meaningful progression.

Another major focus (which I touched on briefly in my last Tico Talks) is continuing our work to improve combat, movement, and targeting systems. Please bear with us, these are important systems that are complicated to iterate on. We're working diligently and can't wait to share more information once we feel we've made significant improvements in the new year. Our goal is to make improvements that ensure your character's interaction with the world feels intuitive and fluid. Whether you're weaving through a complex combat rotation, navigating treacherous terrain, or targeting a specific enemy in the heat of battle, we want it to feel natural. 

I can't help but feel incredibly grateful as I write this letter. This game has become so much more than just a game — it's a living, breathing world that we've built together through your feedback, passion, and support. Every suggestion you share, every bug you report, and every moment of excitement you express helps guide us toward making this game even better. I hope you can find the time to visit the main tree in Stonegard during the Startree Solstice event and read the letters some of my teammates have written to see what being a part of this team means to them. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being part of this journey. Here's to the magical moments we've shared in 2024, and to all the adventures that await us in the new year.

Wishing you and your loved ones the happiest of holidays,
- Tico

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.11.2

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.11.2 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on December 18 and last approximately 7 hours while some behind-the-scenes server work takes place. [list]

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.11.0
notes.content:
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.11.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on December 11 and last approximately 9 hours while some behind-the-scenes server work takes place. Holiday cheer spreads across Solisium as the Startree Solstice event begins. How will your guild celebrate the most wonderful time of the year? 

Check out the full release notes, including event details, new Cooking adjustments, additional Arch Boss spawn scheduling, and more, below. 

[h2]Startree Solstice Event[/h2]
The Startree Solstice event will spread holiday cheer across Solisium from December 12 through January 9, 2025. Join event-only Snowdrift Island arena matches for event-specific rewards, explore festive villages with holiday decorations (including Trees of Gratitude), gather themed cosmetics like the Jolly Arsenal weapons via the Event Pass, and more. Even Gigantrite and your Amitoi will participate.

Check out our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/news/articles/startree-solstice-event]official announcement[/url] for full details, including the rewards and activities you can experience in the Startree Solstice. 

[h2]Arch Bosses - Additional Spawns for Bellandir and Tevent[/h2]
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve the recent issues related to Arch Boss encounters. 

We understand the frustration this caused to many, and to ensure players are able to attempt those encounters again, we will be running a limited duration event from December 12, 2024 through January 9, 2025. 

During this event, Arch Bosses will spawn twice on their normally scheduled days, once in peace and once in conflict. The additional spawn will take place at 6:00 p.m./18:00 server time and the current 8:00 p.m./20:00 time will also spawn as normal. Good luck, adventurers!

[h2]Lifestyle Content - Cooking[/h2]
[list][*] New Cooking contracts can be obtained through Contract Managers. 
[*] The number of unique cooked food items has been reduced by the consolidation of food quality levels.
[*] General dishes are now crafted as Uncommon grade, Banquet and dungeon ingredient food as Rare grade, and elixirs come in Rare or Uncommon grade depending on the materials used.
[*] The quality of materials used when cooking now determines the quantity of meals received.
[*] Rare materials consume 1 ingredient and produce 3 completed meals.
[*] Uncommon materials consume 3 ingredients and produce 2 completed meals.
[*] Common materials consume 5 ingredients and produce 1 completed meal.
[*] Ingredients for Banquets have been adjusted to account for the new grade consolidation and numbers of meals produced through Cooking.
[*] Ingredient gathering and drop rates have been adjusted due to the change in quantities consumed and number of meals produced through Cooking.
[*] Previously obtained high-tier ingredients intended for use in Banquets can be exchanged for updated rare ingredients through the Dissolve system.
[*] All recipes may now be crafted at both Cooking Ovens and Campfires.[/list]
[h2]Dungeon Matchmaking Penalty[/h2]
[list][*] A cooldown time is now applied for characters who cancel dungeon matchmaking after a party is matched or after entering a dungeon through matchmaking. 
[*] This cooldown prevents you from queueing for another dungeon immediately. The timer starts at 10 minutes and will increase with subsequent additional cancellations.
[*] Re-entering an already completed dungeon using Party Matchmaking while the previous instance is still available results in a matchmaking penalty being applied upon leaving the instance. If re-entering the same dungeon using Party Matchmaking, make sure the previous instance has been cleared before doing so. [/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Field and Arch Bosses: Increased the drop rates of Rare and Epic gear from these encounters. 
[*] PvP: Reduced the duration of respawn protection granted after entering Conflict areas via resurrecting at a Guild Resurrection Stone or arriving through a Guild Summoning Circle. 
[*] Automatic logout time for AFK characters has been increased to 3 hours.
[*] Arena: Weekly reset for the Arena has been adjusted to match the weekly maintenance time, similar to other weekly reset content.
[*] Arena: Upgraded Purification Stones are now usable while in Arenas.
[*] Arena: Added runes to the Arena Vendor that can be purchased with Arena Coins. 
[*] Weekly Missions: Adjusted the amount of Dimensional Trials needed to complete the weekly mission.
[*] Gigantrite: Adjusted the route Gigantrite takes between Stonegard and Saurodoma Island.
[*] Fishing: New Fishing Hotspots may appear in bodies of water around the world, indicated by a circling fish effect. The wise fisher knows to cast their line into these areas whenever they’re spotted!
[*] Fishing: Expanded the Fishing Codex to include new fish and a new reward tier.
[*] War Games: Added team chat channel for use during matches.
[*] War Games: Player icons will now display on the minimap.
[*] War Games: Fixed an issue causing the team outfit to remain visible after exiting a match.
[*] War Games: Fixed an issue preventing the Stats button from bringing up game results after ending a match.
[*] Options: Added option to automatically reject party invitations that come from all players not on your Friends list.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Completing dungeons by queuing for random matchmaking now awards 4 Soul Shard Selection Boxes instead of Soul Shards specific to the matched dungeon.[/list]
[h2]Combat[/h2]
[list][*] Stats: Fortitude: Fixed an issue that could cause stat effects to not increase when improving your Fortitude stat value.
[*] Skill: Shadow Strike: The teleportation effect of Shadow Strike now works while the player is jumping.
[*] Skill: Mana Exchange: Remove CC Specialization: Fixed an issue causing this skill specialization to not take effect.
[*] Butcher's Canyon, Valley of Slaughter: The coordinated crowd control across multiple targets required to complete this dungeon has been adjusted. Now crowd control effects can be applied to the target enemies individually, and once it has been affected, the targeted enemy will not go back to an invulnerable state.[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list][*] Auction House: Removed the confirmation button when the total amount of Lucent earned from sales is below 10 Lucent.
[*] Ping Display: The option to display your current ping on the HUD should now actually be available in the Settings menu.
[*] Amitoi Expedition: Zone levels now display on unlocked expedition zones.
[*] Amitoi Expedition: Expedition menu now saves selected Amitoi lineup and expedition duration, even when cancelling or exiting the UI.
[*] Party Frames: Improved targeted player visuals on the party frame as well as providing an indicator on the frame when hovering over the target with your cursor.
[*] Skill Menu: Now shows left and right arrows to cycle through presets.
[*] Skill Menu: When filling out empty skill presets, double clicking skills from the top of the screen will fill in the empty loadout slots in order from left to right.
[*] Inventory: Fixed container items not showing their content preview when in the full screen Inventory menu.
[*] Schedule: Fixed an issue where the timetable could display different schedule results when switching between Daily and Weekly view repeatedly.
[*] Schedule: Corrected unlocalized strings appearing in the events schedule.
[*] Fixed several UI overlap and cutoff issues.
[*] Applied latest localization text updates.[/list]

Thanks for your support and happy holidays! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Battle Pass: Glacial's Star
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GQYr6s3vGAA;full][/previewyoutube]
Make an impact with more than just stylish attacks. This new Battle Pass features the Glacial Weapons cosmetics, Rebellious Teenager Gneiss Amitoi, Giant Oremong Polymorph, Seraph Cygnus Glide Morph, Musical Dance Gesture, and more. Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

Learn more about the Battle Pass below, and then explore answers to your most common questions.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
The Glacial’s Star Battle Pass is available now through January 9, 2 p.m. PT. There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot.
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track) - Glide Morph: Seraph Cygnus
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track) - Gesture: Musical Dance
[*] Level 20 (Free Track) - Polymorph: Giant Oremong
[*] Level 31 (Premium Track) - Amitoi: Rebellious Teenager Gneiss
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track) - Glacial Weapon Selection Chest (Select 2 of the 8 weapon cosmetics)
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in the Glacial’s Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals.

Here are some of the featured items from the Glacial’s Star Point Shop:
[list]
[*] (Premium Only) All 8 Glacial Weapon cosmetics
[*] (Premium Only) Zenus' Spear Weapon cosmetic
[*] Trait Extraction & Conversion Stones
[*] Extra Resistance Contracts
[*] Dimensional Contract Tokens (Type I & II)
[*] Abyssal Contract Tokens
[*] Skill Conversion Books
[*] Trait Unlock Stones
[*] Precious Parchment
[*] and more!
[/list]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]How do I buy the premium track?[/b]
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial, the premium track can be purchased with Lucent from the Battle Pass screen. Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY. Once in-game, navigate to the Battle Pass section of the in-game menu to purchase the premium track from there. If you need Lucent, it can be purchased from the in-game store.
[/list]
[b]How can I progress my Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can complete daily, weekly, and ongoing seasonal challenges to progress their Battle Pass. Additionally, players can purchase up to 49 levels with Lucent. Levels purchased beyond the max are converted to Star Crystals.
[/list]
[b]Do I miss out on daily quests if I don’t log in every day?[/b]
[list]
[*] No! Daily quests are granted each day throughout the season and “banked.” That means you can complete as many as you have available upon login.
[/list]
[b]How can I access the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass Point Shop is accessible to all players as soon as you gain Battle Pass Shop Points. The shop contains various rewards and offers, including items to help with progression. Once a character achieves the maximum Battle Pass level, all subsequent Battle Pass experience will be converted into Battle Pass Shop Points.
[/list]
[b]Do I need to purchase the Battle Pass to buy items from the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] Generally everything is purchasable for all players. There my be items, typically cosmetic, that are gated behind the premium purchase.
[/list]
[b]Can I buy the Battle Pass late into the season?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! When you purchase the premium track, you'll receive all of the rewards up to your current Battle Pass level retroactively.
[/list]
[b]If I don’t buy the premium track can I still earn rewards?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! If you don’t purchase the premium track you’ll still earn a reward for every completed level on the free track.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track do I still get the rewards from the free track?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! Everyone that plays THRONE AND LIBERTY can make progress and earn rewards on the free track.
[/list]
[b]Can I earn rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] After a Battle Pass ends, many of its rewards will become unobtainable. However, for a limited time you’ll have a grace period to claim some of the free and paid track rewards you might have missed.
[/list]
[b]Can I claim my rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! After a Battle Pass ends you will still be able to claim any earned rewards from that Battle Pass. These items can be found in the Battle Pass menu. Select the tab of the previous season to claim your items. You will have until the end of the following Battle Pass to claim them.
[/list]
[b]How will the Battle Pass work for multiple characters on the same account?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass progression and non-cosmetic rewards are character specific.
[*] Battle Pass Rewards can be earned and claimed once per character.
[*] If you transfer your character to another server, Battle Pass progress will transfer with the character.
[*] Cosmetic rewards are account wide. Once they are claimed on any of your characters, they’ll be available to all of your characters.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track on one platform, can I access it on another platform?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, the Battle Pass is character specific and can only be accessed on your character’s platform.
[/list]
[b]Can I replay or complete previous Battle Passes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress cannot be made on a Battle Pass once the season ends.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Spear Reveal
notes.content:
Strike fast and true! Charge into your enemies with deadly precision. How will you use the Spear to conquer Solisium when this versatile weapon releases on December 5?

The Spear specializes in exploiting enemy weaknesses for faster eliminations. Quickly crowd control and render those who stand in your way defenseless with the Spear’s unique abilities. Gale Rush will close the gap on any battlefield, while a well-timed Javelin will finish off any foe. The Spear is a powerful weapon that excels in almost every playstyle.

Join NCSOFT and our team for an overview of the Spear, plus additional features and then read on for everything you need to know before it launches alongside the next major update.

[previewyoutube=tFF6kgNugGM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Skills Preview[/h2]
Those looking to outplay enemies can take advantage of the Spear's distinct mechanics for a tactical advantage in any battle. Dismantle your foe's defensive skills, capitalize on increasingly powerful abilities that benefit from additional uses, and make this weapon your own. The Spear is a lethal addition to any guild's arsenal.

[h3]Whirling Ward[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dodge ranged and magic projectiles and then deal damage on targets within range.
[/list]
[h3]Javelin Surge[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Brand Javelin is a directional ability that can be charged to travel farther distances.
[*] Enemies hit will be Branded for 9 seconds, increasing the rate of critical hits and critical damage received.
[/list]
[h3]Culling Arc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stab foes and attack twice:
[*] Each attack inflicts Weaken and will deal additional damage on targets with 5 Weaken stacks. Each stack decreases the target's Magic, Melee, and Ranged Magic Defense.
[*] Ability to use Spiral Slash afterwards. Spin and attack the target, plus any additional targets within range 2 times. This attack also inflicts Weaken and will deal additional damage on targets with 5 Weaken stacks.
[/list]
[h3]Storm Blitz[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quickly dash to your target.
[*] If the target is an enemy, you will deal damage and gain increased attack speed. If they are stunned, sleeping, feared, or bleeding prior to the attack, this attack’s cooldown will reset.
[*] If the target is an ally, you will swing your Spear in a small circle around their position. Any enemies caught in the attack will be briefly stunned.
[/list]
[h3]Cataclysm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Render your enemy unable to use their Defensive Skill for a period of time.
[/list]
[h2]Passives Preview[/h2]
Many Spear passives are designed to bolster offensive strength. Successfully chain together aggressive attacks with swift eliminations and you’ll become even more difficult to strike down.

[h3]Imposing Form[/h3]
[list]
[*] Upon inflicting damage using a Spear, Greatsword, Staff, or Longbow skill, two-handed weapons have a chance to temporarily deal additional damage.
[/list]
[h3]Fatal Precision[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each time Weaken lands, temporarily increase Attack Speed.
[/list]
[h3]Mortal Wrath[/h3]
[list]
[*] Deal additional damage to enemies that have low health when landing critical hits.
[/list]
[h3]Death Knell[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you inflict a target inflict with Weaken and then they die within 10s, your attack speed may temporarily increase.
[/list]
[h3]Malice Surge[/h3]
[list]
[*] When taking Skill Damage, your Magic, Melee, and Ranged Heavy Attack Chance may temporarily increase.
[/list]
We look forward to seeing players enjoy the thrill of the Spear.

Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.7.0
notes.content:
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.7.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on November 13 and last approximately 4.5 hours. With the frightful conclusion of Haunted Harvest comes the start of Arena Season One. Reach higher ranks for unique rewards like a seasonal title, plus themed Dash, Glide, and Swim morphs.

Check out the full release notes, including changes to Peace-mode world boss access portals, UI, and more below.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guilds that have control of Stoneguard Castle can now schedule Tax Deliveries.
[*] Haunted Harvest is now over. Thanks to everyone that participated!
[*] Arena Season One is now live. Ready your weapons as the rankings reset for a fresh climb to the top of the ladder.
[*] Event Times: Regions with Daylight Savings Time changes (Europe and North America) have had their hourly event schedules adjusted to return events to the pre-time change hours.
[*] For Peace-mode world boss spawns, new access portals will now appear at the entrance of open world dungeons to transport players to the boss location and avoid Night and Eclipse effects.
[*]When using these access portals, players will be teleported near the boss portal selection area and placed under a 30-second protection effect.
[*]Known Issue: The new Sanctum of Desire access portal appears inside the PvP-enabled border and will be adjusted in a future update. We recommend dash morphing to access this portal while under the initial 5-second protection effect for the time being.
[*] Weekly Mission rewards adjusted to once again reset during the weekly maintenance window.
[*] Accounts with negative Lucent balances will no longer be able to receive Lucent distributions from their guild.
[*] Equipment: Extract items can now be compared with equipped gear to view the effective changes of applying the extract.
[*] Equipment: The default keybind for viewing a piece of equipment at max enhancement is now ALT+G.
[*] Skills - Dagger: Fixed an issue that caused the effect from the passive skill Assassin Step to carry over when changing weapons.
[*] Combat: Enhanced the visual effects for Heavy Attacks.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Exiting a popup with the ESC key while viewing your inventory no longer closes the Inventory screen.
[*] Fixed an issue when opening multiple selection chests that reset the quantity opened to 1 when clicking to confirm.

We look forward to watching server storylines develop in the first Castle Siege event on November 17. 

Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.6.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/nwRAdv2S3U0Azfl8RNPEd/eb4069dafd9378e7dc03f44ecf07c3b3/TL_Halloween_14_1920x740.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.6.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on November 6 and last approximately 2 hours. It includes stability and back-end service improvements. Check out our Haunted Harvest community showcase, plus a preview of what to expect in the first Tax Delivery and Castle Siege events. We’ve also compiled some of your most impressive achievements since launch.

[h2]Haunted Harvest Community Showcase[/h2]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7fVuQRswJ7uvNNqnd5zZnf/d2be7d3c1bc04ba595aa302aa39bc0aa/Haunted-Harvest-Community-Showcase-1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Thanks to everyone that participated in our Haunted Harvest Community Showcase. Look forward to future showcases and contests on the THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord.

The THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord server was built for Amazon Games staff members to host events, townhalls, AMAs, and talk to the community. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make Solisium better for every type of player. Guilds are another major aspect of Discord engagement.

To find the right group, first ask yourself what type of guild would you enjoy the most. Want to focus on specific game modes? There’s a guild for that. How about leaderboards? There’s a guild for that too. Now think about what you’re most excited about in THRONE AND LIBERTY. There’s a guild for that, if you want to create it. Gather players with shared interests, goals, or something else entirely for an even more satisfying experience.

[h3]First Month in Solisium[/h3]
We’re happy to share some notable stats since the start of your journey and can’t wait to see what you’ll accomplish next.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4XRcn23ssGQOCeCKMICpQg/b5ea2c5475a120c1ecc77ffebccafbe2/EN_-_TL-First-Month-Info-1920.jpg[/img]
[h3]Tax Delivery Event[/h3]
Now that all First Defenders have been selected, the reigning guild may schedule the Tax Delivery event for their server.
[list]
[*] Reigning guilds may schedule a Tax Delivery between 2PM and 1 AM local server time.
[*] To check when the Tax Delivery event is scheduled, open up your Map and then check the Timetable under Daily.
[/list]
Tax Delivery is a major guild event where the reigning guild must protect a caravan of taxes acquired from their territory. If the reigning guild successfully transport their spoils from Vienta Village to Stoneguard Castle, they’ll receive a generous bounty of Lucent and Sollant. However, if an attacking player thwarts the delivery, the rewards will instead be distributed to every participant outside of the First Defenders’ Alliance.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/xs9Pj5kkNpScuop1o5EcS/f4e7812c32c5bddac24a86a30bc938c4/TL_Closed_Beta_Screenshots_TaxDelivery_v01_1080.jpeg[/img]
Each Tax Delivery begins with the reigning guild selecting a member to become the Tax Delivery Golem. Capitalize on powerful abilities as the Titan Cargo to fend off the seemingly endless onslaught of players that will stop at nothing for a piece of the prize. Communication and coordination between the reigning guild can make or break a delivery.

Attacking guilds must destroy the Titan Cargo Sealing Stone. Fortunately, they have the ability to contend with the might of the Titan Cargo through barriers, bomb carriers, Archeum Knights, and the fearsome debuffs of the Chaos Golem.

How will you prepare to stop, or secure, the Tax Delivery?

[h3]Castle Siege Event[/h3]
The first Castle Siege event will commence on November 17.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4kBQ6VnPu8cJ6hosvSN9LU/41f461b7786ca6b690924b37b33b934b/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Combat_Siege_A_1920.jpg[/img]
As the siege begins, guilds have 45 minutes to achieve victory. Attackers must storm the castle, breach its fortified gates, and capture the throne room. Defenders, transported inside the castle at the start, must hold their ground, leveraging every resource at their disposal to repel the invaders. If the throne is contested when the timer runs out, the siege enters a tense 3-minute overtime, where the battle's outcome hangs in the balance.

Strategic locations like Siege Ruins play a crucial role. Capturing these ruins not only provides teleportation and resurrection points, but also allows attacking guilds to summon powerful Siege Golems. Each golem — whether it’s the Stone Crasher, Battle Carrier, Gate Hammer, or Jump Attacker — brings unique abilities to the battlefield, from devastating castle walls to transporting players over them.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1ox2hj8681BPtd5zF9emld/710ccf4536601d0501358b3c7f62a8da/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
Attackers must navigate the castle's intricate layout, using environmental elements like the sewage system for surprise ambushes or operating gate levers to control access points. The Pillage Stones and Resurrection Stones scattered throughout the battlefield add another layer of strategy, offering opportunities to steal resources or reinforce their position. While most guilds will focus on taking power in the throne room, these 5 Pillage Stones can be captured by any attackers to snatch Sollant and Lucent from the Castle Vault, even if the reigning guild maintains control.

No matter your strategy, all tactics will converge at the throne. There can only be one champion of Stoneguard Castle. Form alliances to rule together or betray your way to the top.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3rGJhYTb9YZvM5j3CdxnnL/dd44d824bc1b2f42dd86474d88c8ad7d/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
We look forward to watching server storylines develop across these events. Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Loot Distribution Rules
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3o6RVTzuClabURlhWkVkX/66948f96e8a19e5265dbb9c819e5e84e/Change_TL_Technical_Test_Screenshots_Morph_Orcs_v01-1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Conquer devious Field Bosses, courageously explore Abyss Dungeons, and more in pursuit of Solisium’s greatest treasures. Before we dive into loot rules, you’ll first need to understand contributions and event items.
[list]
[*] Contribution: Contribution is earned by doing damage against the enemy and healing friendly players in battle while said enemy is active. Contribution from healing is acquired for healing players both in and out of your party when participating in guild-level events (Field Bosses).
[*] Event Items: Loot dropped during Dynamic Events that is collected to turn in for event progress. For example, wolf tails in the wolf hunting event.
[/list]
Here’s an overview of loot distribution by activity.

[h2]General Activities[/h2]
[list]
[*] Open World Farming, Abyss Dungeon Farming, Quests, Contracts, Dynamic Events, Co-op Dungeons (excluding the final reward chest)
[*] Applicable Enemies: Normal, Elite, Party Elite
[/list]
[h3]Distribution Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] When an enemy dies, loot is assigned to the player who first earned contribution (dealt damage in this case) to said enemy.
[*] If the player is in a group, the loot is assigned to the player’s party instead.
[*] In this case, the drops from the enemy have equal chance of distribution across all party members.
[*] The only exception is party members that have no contribution and are out of range will be excluded from the drop pool.
[*] All items are evenly distributed when possible. This means if there are 10 items dropped for a party of 5, each player should receive 2 items. If even distribution is not possible, it will randomly select a player(s) to receive an extra drop(s).
[*] Sollant and experience are distributed evenly.
[/list]
[h2]Peace Mode Bosses and Guild Raids[/h2]
[list]
[*] Applicable enemies: Field Bosses and Arch Bosses
[/list]
[h3]Distribution Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] When a Peace Mode Field Boss dies, all players are sorted by individual player contribution.
[*] A guild’s overall contribution does not play a role for peace mode bosses and guild raids.
[*] Players must meet a minimum contribution to be eligible to receive loot from the boss.
[*] There are two drops types that come from Peace Mode Bosses:
[*] Contribution drops: Each item is distributed based on chance according to individual contribution.
[*] Random drops: Each Item is randomly provided only to remaining players who did not receive one of the contribution drops.
[*] Sollant and experience are distributed evenly.
[/list]
[b]Example:[/b]

Lets assume that a Field Boss drops the following loot when defeated:
[list]
[*] Contribution Drops: 1x Sword, 1x Mask, 1000 Sollant
[*] Random Drops: 1x Boots
[/list]
Assuming you’ve met the minimum contribution requirement described above, if your contribution was 3% of the total contribution, you would have a 3% chance of acquiring either the sword or the mask. All players that met the minimum contribution requirement would have an equal chance to acquire the Boots, regardless of total contribution. Any player who receives epic equipment is unable to attain a second piece of epic equipment from the same boss kill.

[h2]Conflict Mode Bosses[/h2]
[list]
[*] Applicable enemies: Field Bosses and Arch Bosses
[/list]
[h3]Distribution Rules:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loot is assigned in a two stage process. First, loot is assigned to a guild. Then, the loot is assigned to players within the guild.
[*] When a Field Boss dies during conflict mode, a Guild’s contribution is calculated as the sum of the individual contribution for each player in the guild who participated in the fight.
[*] The guilds are then sorted based on contribution.
[*] Guilds must meet a minimum contribution to be eligible to receive loot from the boss.
[*] Loot items are distributed based on chance according to Guild contribution.
[*] Note: Unlike peace mode bosses, dying to an enemy or another player during a conflict mode boss will result in the dying player losing 70% of their individual contribution — meaning it reduces the guild’s total contribution at the end of the match.
[*] Once a guild has been assigned an item, all participating players within the guild have equal chance to obtain the item.
[*] Sollant and experience are distributed evenly.
[/list]
[b]Example:[/b]

Lets assume that a Field Boss drops the following loot when defeated:
[list]
[*] Drops: 1x Sword, 1x Mask, 1000 Sollant
[/list]
If players A, B, and C had 10%, 15%, and 20% contribution respectively and all belonged to the same guild, then the guild’s total contribution would be 45%. That means this guild would have a 45% chance to acquire the Sword and Mask. If the guild successfully acquired the Mask, then players A, B, and C would each have an equal chance to receive the Mask.

Claim the throne in the next Castle Siege to ensure you almost never have to worry about valuable loot again. Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Battle Pass: Phantom Tracker's Star
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2usOEOps7V7h9DU23PjSdX/223a84b4067a0ecb8055f55377e2ba24/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_PureLightHillMountainStatue.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Take over Solisium in style with the Phantom Tracker outfit, Sap Almiraz Morph, Emote: Come on in, Demon King Joker, and more. The Battle Pass: Phantom Tracker's Star awaits.

Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

Learn more about the Battle Pass below, discover every featured reward in our video showcase, and then explore answers to your most common questions.

[h2]Showcase[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Gr4b0oLpmnU;full][/previewyoutube]
The Battle Pass: Phantom Tracker's Star is available now through December 4, 2 p.m. PT. There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot:
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track) - Morph: Sap Almiraz
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track) - Pose: Chair
[*] Level 20 (Free Track) - Emote: Come on in
[*] Level 30 (Premium Track) - Amitoi: Demon King Joker
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track) - Outfit: Phantom Tracker
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in the Phantom Tracker’s Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. Be advised, at the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals.

Here are some of the featured items from the Phantom Tracker’s Point Shop:
[list]
[*] Skill Conversion Book
[*] Resistance Contracts
[*] Trait Extraction Stone
[*] Trait Conversion Stone
[/list]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]How do I buy the premium track?[/b]
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial, the premium track can be purchased with Lucent from the Battle Pass screen. Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY. Once in-game, navigate to the Battle Pass section of the in-game menu to purchase the premium track from there. If you need Lucent, it can be purchased from the in-game store.
[/list]
[b]How can I progress my Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can complete daily, weekly, and ongoing seasonal challenges to progress their Battle Pass. Additionally, players can purchase up to 49 levels with Lucent. Levels purchased beyond the max are converted to Star Crystals.
[/list]
[b]Do I miss out on daily quests if I don’t log in every day?[/b]
[list]
[*] No! Daily quests are granted each day throughout the season and “banked.” That means you can complete as many as you have available upon login.
[/list]
[b]How can I access the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass Point Shop is accessible to all players as soon as you gain Battle Pass Shop Points. The shop contains various rewards and offers, including items to help with progression. Once a character achieves the maximum Battle Pass level, all subsequent Battle Pass experience will be converted into Battle Pass Shop Points.
[/list]
[b]Do I need to purchase the Battle Pass to buy items from the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] Generally everything is purchasable for all players. There may be items, typically cosmetic, that are gated behind the premium purchase.
[/list]
[b]Can I buy the Battle Pass late into the season?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! When you purchase the premium track you'll receive all of the rewards up to your current Battle Pass level retroactively.
[/list]
[b]If I don’t buy the premium track, can I still earn rewards?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! If you don’t purchase the premium track you’ll still earn a reward for every completed level on the free track.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track do I still get the rewards from the free track?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! Everyone that plays THRONE AND LIBERTY can make progress and earn rewards on the free track.
[/list]
[b]Can I earn rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] After a Battle Pass ends, many of its rewards will become unobtainable. However, for a limited time, you’ll have a grace period to claim some of the free and paid track rewards you might have missed.
[/list]
[b]Can I claim my rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! After a Battle Pass ends, you will still be able to claim any earned rewards from that Battle Pass. These items can be found in the Battle Pass menu. Select the tab of the previous season to claim your items. You will have until the end of the following Battle Pass to claim them.
[/list]
[b]How will the Battle Pass work for multiple characters on the same account?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass progression and non-cosmetic rewards are character specific.
[*] Battle Pass Rewards can be earned and claimed once per character.
[*] If you transfer your character to another server, battle pass progress will transfer with the character.
[*] Cosmetic rewards are account wide. Once they are claimed on any of your characters, they’ll be available to all of your characters.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track on one platform, can I access it on another platform?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, the Battle Pass is character specific and can only be accessed on your character’s platform.
[/list]
[b]Can I replay or complete previous Battle Passes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress cannot be made on a Battle Pass once the season ends.
[/list]
Thanks for your support. We’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/6gJvbSAT8UUIXu5wenDJbw/28e02497063121101db2b8e624b6783c/TL_Halloween_01_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.5.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 30 and last approximately 6 hours. It includes the Battle Pass: Phantom Tracker’s Star, new Epic reward selection chests for Field Bosses, and various bug fixes.

Check out the full release notes below.

[h2]Shop Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass: Phantom Tracker’s Star season will start on October 31, featuring new emotes, an Amitoi, and an outfit, among other useful items and materials for your journeys in Solisium!
[*] The Lucent shop has been updated with a new outfit, morph, and Amitoi to match your seasonally spooky vibe.
[/list]
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Field Boss: Increased the rate of boss portal scaling to the amount of players participating, providing more instances to spread players between fights and increase individual chances to earn contribution rewards.
[*] Field Boss: Added Epic reward selection chests that have a chance of being acquired when receiving participation rewards for Field Boss contribution. These boxes allow players to select from any of the Epic items that boss has a chance of dropping.
[*] Dungeon: Death's Abyss: Fixed an issue that allowed Karnix to be defeated by gravity.
[*] Combat: The crowd control immunity gauge will now fill more quickly when players are targeted with multiple crowd control effects at the same time.
[*] Adventure Codex: Increased the amount of experience awarded from completing Adventure Codex objectives.
[*] Event Dungeons: Active party recruitment posts or matchmaking queues for special event dungeons will now cancel automatically if the event dungeon ends before recruitment is fulfilled.
[*] Items: Equipment Tooltips: New option added to preview an item's stats at maximum enhancement.
[*] Guilds: The Guild window now displays a guild's overall Guild Points, as well as the amount of Guild Activity Points and individual Guild Member Activity Points that contribute to it.
[*] Quests: Chapter 6: Restoring the Heart: Golem's Heart inspection now properly displays the second label.
[*] Crafting: Added crafting recipes for Queen Bellandir and Tevent equipment items.
[*] Chat: Customized chat tabs now remain in place if you leave a group or guild.
[*] Guilds: Creating guilds with multiple characters on the same account no longer defaults those guilds to Friendly.
[*] Movement: Characters now have a tighter turning radius when changing direction using mouse/keyboard controls.
[*] Localization: Applied latest localization updates, including the correction of several untranslated strings.
[*] Controller: Multiple controller functionality improvements for navigating menus and gameplay interactions.
[*] Arch Bosses: Fixed a rare issue that caused a crash during the Queen Bellandir event.
[*] Dynamic Events: Requiem of Light, Festival of Fire: Completing the final tier of these events should now grant personal completion rewards.
[*] Items: The Grin Reaper outfit now properly changes the boot color when dyed for all body types.
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Chat: Added two more customizable tabs to the chat interface, increasing the total to three.
[*] Health Bars: Character health bars now display the amount of shielding granted by skills.
[*] Targeting: Slightly increased the size of the UI indicator for currently selected targets.
[*] Stellar Vision: Added number indicators to the target list in the Stellar Vision window.
[*] Party Matchmaking: Window now retains previous settings when re-opened.
[/list]
Thanks for your support. We’ll see you in Solisium!

New individual items:

Reset times have been changed to Thursday (6:00 UTC) for all regions. This will impact the following:
[list]
[*] Quests

[*] Weekly Rewards

[*] Terror Bird Meat to Bird Meat

[*] Forest Wolf Meat to Thick Meat

Completing a dungeon through the Random matchmaking option will now provide special rewards when claiming the final boss chest:
[list]

[h3]Chat[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a Chat Window icon where players can add another chat window.
[*] You can create more than one chat window at a time to view multiple tabs at once.
[*] You can resize each chat window by dragging the edges with your mouse.
[*] The extra windows can also be repositioned and locked in place.
[*] Added a chat lock button.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] The following now display acquisition information in their tooltips: Amitoi, Guardians, and Morphs.
[*] Selecting Usage on cooking ingredients will now display Cooking recipes that contain it.
[*] Added a visual indicator for skills that can be charged on your combat bar. When the shortcut key/button is held, the associated skill icon will fill up.
[*] Improved UI locations during character customization so that UI elements don't block the view of the character.
[*] Removed the unnecessary third reward line from the Cooperative Dynamic Event reward UI.
[/list]
[h3]Notable Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the onboarding control buttons were always visible.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Adventure Codex final rewards were not displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue on controllers where L-Stick would move the character while the focus was on the Content Notification.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Friends list would disappear temporarily.
[*] Fixed an issue where View Codex Knowledge could display incorrect information.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Kowazan and Ahzreil Riftstone encounters to reward more loot than intended.
[*] Fixed a rare issue that caused a crash when rendering certain particle effects.
[*] Fixed an issue where players in Japan could see an incorrect expiring Lucent amount and remaining expiration time.
[*] Fixed an issue where user privacy settings in game could be out of sync from AG ID website settings, causing user changes to fail or have the game not respect AG ID account settings.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused Parties to unexpectedly disband during content.
[/list]
Thanks for your support, and we’ll see you in Solisium!
