notes.title: The First Defender
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7gdoeF0Q2R4yMxwOMiAu3u/221990f7d2612c047211bdcffc502a10/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_Gigantrite_B.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Defenders of Stoneguard Castle, wielders of the Titan Cargo, and legends of Solisium. How will you be remembered? As the First Defender? Or the group that struck them down?

Those who conquer Stoneguard Castle control Solisium, but the First Defender is more than just a force to acquire. It manages the castle, tax rates, when certain items can be purchased, and the Tax Delivery. With absolute power comes absolute opposition. Thousands will rise in pursuit of their downfall. For only one champion can sit atop Solisium.

[h2]Selection Process[/h2]
Right now, the seemingly impenetrable throne room of Stoneguard Castle remains vacant. Beyond its tranquil walls, war rages on as the coveted position of First Defender beckons. Guild Rank, accumulated via activities like guild PvP modes and Contracts, grants successful groups rewards and powerful skills, such as the ability to control the weather.

Most importantly, the Guild Rank leader will earn the right of ascension at the following times:

[b]Early access servers:[/b]
[list]
[*] For all regions except Japan, the guild that’s in first will become the First Defender when the current ranking updates at 00:00 local server time on October 25.
[*] For Japan, the First Defender will be decided at 00:00 local server time on October 26.
[*] Note: The First Defender will be determined based on the current rank section of the leaderboard, not the real-time ranking.
[/list]
[b]Launch servers:[/b]
[list]
[*] All regions outside of Japan will select their First Defenders on October 30.
[*] Japan will determine their First Defender on October 31.
[/list]
Once the guild rankings lock at 00:00 local server time, the First Defender will receive ownership when the Brilliant Growth milestone ends.

As the First Defender, they’ll execute the first Tax Delivery and defend Stoneguard Castle during the first Castle Siege. All future defenders will be crowned upon claiming the throne.

Thanks for your support! We can’t wait to announce the First Defenders and look forward to watching the first Castle Siege unfold.

notes.title: Haunted Harvest
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/46fwWigebEoYoRxecbrg3v/3e29bfc69ac60477445711b3a503e3f4/TL_Halloween_19_1920x420.gif?fm=webp[/img]
[i]Unfortunately during testing we discovered a critical stability issue in the 1.4.0 Update. Our team has worked with NCSOFT to resolve the issue and will release Haunted Harvest following the downtime on October 24 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC). We always regret when delays happen but it's important for us to ensure we deliver the best possible experience. As a result of our delay, all players will be granted an additional 500 Ornate Coins. Thank you for your patience and understanding. Please stay tuned to our social channels for more updates.[/i]

[i]In celebration of Haunted Harvest and the first appearance of the Arch Bosses Tevent and Queen Bellandir, we have increased the drop rates of Soul Fragments when the bosses periodically appear in the world. Tevent's Soul Fragments will drop at an increased rate from 10/25/2024 until 10/30/2024 and Queen Bellandir's Soul Fragment drop rate increase will occur from 10/31/2024 to 11/6/2024. The drop rates of Soul Fragments from killing the Arch Bosses at their normally scheduled times remains the same. Thanks for playing and enjoy Haunted Harvest! *Dates for the AP-NE Region are +1
[/i]
The Haunted Harvest will descend upon Solisium on October 25 through November 13. Explore an event-only dungeon for sweet rewards, visit villages filled with spooky decorations, don themed cosmetics like the Wicked Enchanter or Grin Reaper outfits, grab Haunted Harvester's weapon cosmetics, and more. What tricks will your guild carry out alongside these treats?

From finding familiar faces in costumes to fishing for gummies, Solisium takes Haunted Harvest very seriously. Candy Corn is even used as event currency. Exchange your delectable treasure for unique rewards, including special consumables, and have a spooktacular time. Exclusive Haunted Harvest cosmetics will also be available for a limited time through the in-game Shop.

[h2]Event-Only Dungeon[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2MLD9AFyqUU9UGj1KEXPHm/7b7dcac26802bea04656aec2a54a2790/TL_Halloween_06_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
In pursuit of a giant jack-o’-lantern, you’ve unknowingly entered a perilous trap with seasonal surprises lurking around every corner. Navigate thrilling obstacles, defeat fiendish pumpkins, and devour a Candy Corn for the chance to receives rewards like cosmetics, food buffs, ornate coins, and more.
You will also receive Dimension Pumpkins, which can be exchanged for spoils like the Pumpkin Lord Headpiece, Jack-o’-Lantern Izzy Amitoi, and the Hallow-Knight shapeshift at event merchants in each village.

[h2]Event Villages[/h2]
Trick-or-treat at any village to get the most out of your Haunted Harvest experience. Beyond collecting Candy Corn from various activities, you’ll also receive them as a daily login bonus. Don’t eat, or spend, all of your candy at once.

Greet familiar friends in unique costumes around each village to receive Candy Corn.
[list]
[*] Search for characters with hidden Haunted Harvest forms at night or morph into a playful ghost to identify them during the day for additional Candy Corn.
[*] Locate all 3 costumed characters to receive the Phantom’s Prank buff (Increased Sollant gain and increased experience gain).
[/list]
[h2]Haunted Festivities[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4LzsDuGYww8QfMoXbsHuw1/6a10e24312b1d45924b6784b84d6f284/TL_Halloween_02_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Haunted Harvest influences Solisium in fresh and unexpected ways. Scrumptious culinary creations are waiting to be crafted, while large bags of Candy Corn were accidentally lost amidst a few Conquest Battles. Rumor has it the candy ended up in the water and mutated some fish. Your favorite Amitoi can also enjoy the event through a limited-time Expedition bonus. Here’s an overview of the festivities.
Catch event-only fish throughout Solisium for various 15 minute buffs:

Red Gummy Fish, Yellow Gummy Fish, Blue Gummy Fish
[list]
[*] Increased movement speed
[*] Increased attack speed
[/list]
Pumpkin Taffy
[list]
[*] Increased boss hit rate
[*] Damage boost against undead and demon enemies
[*] Damage resistance against undead and demon enemies
[/list]
Join your fellow adventurers and search for wandering Haunted Harvest Peddlers to purchase Dimension Pumpkins and other event-specific rewards.

Once you have the proper ingredients, you can cook these Haunted Harvest specialties for 15 minute buffs:
[list]
[*] Spooky Pumpkin Pie (Increased mastery gain and increased abyss consumption efficiency)
[*] Choco-Spider Cookie (Increased critical hit chance and increased critical damage)
[/list]
Send your favorite Amitoi on Expeditions for a chance at additional event rewards.
[list]
[*] Amitoi have an icon on their head to indicate where they’ll receive a boost. This boost increases a chance to obtain special rewards from Amitoi Expedition.
[*] Halloween-themed Amitoi (Jack-o'-Lantern Izzy and Hexbound Figment) will receive an increased chance of obtaining special rewards enabled regardless of their Expedition.
[/list]
Take down your favorite dungeon bosses during the event for a chance to receive additional cosmetics.

[h2]Shop Showcase[/h2]

The gargantuan worm Queen Bellandir has plagued the deserts of Stonegard for the last time! Feared by many, this mana hungry monster will soon meet her end at the hands of heroes of the Resistance. Conquer this level 50 Archboss and her larvae brood at the Queen’s Trap in the northwestern portion of the Sandworm Lair, while avoiding the destructive might of her vicious sandstorms.

[*] Ascended Guardian Hood

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5uKROyQo2ozZEam78NRckg/6f9bd31d0058083fd62bbf6427bd6e5c/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_Kaselton_A.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.3.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 16 and last approximately 6 hours. Team up with other players to conquer random dungeons through a new matchmaking option. This update also includes bug fixes for localization, UI, and more to help make your next adventure in Solisium an even smoother experience. Check out the full release notes broken down by platform below.

[i]This article has been updated to remove a loot change that will be present in the next weekly update.
[/i]
[h2]All Platforms[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Character deletion wait time is now set to 24 hours after initiating deletion of a character.
[*] Server transfer cooldowns are now displayed on the Server Transfer window.
[*] Server Transfer cooldown time has been increased to 30 days between transfers, and the Server Transfer free ticket promotion has ended.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dynamic Events: Improved rewards for all Dynamic Event modes to better match the effort made by players during the event.
[*] Guilds: Hunt-type Guild Contracts ("Defeat Various Monsters") can now only be initiated once per day. If completion carries over into a new day, a new contract will become immediately available.
[*] Guilds: When Leaders leave a guild, leadership reassignment now checks in order of: highest available guild rank, highest available guild contribution, longest guild membership time.
[*] Quests: The Terrific Trio of Carmine Forest: Corrected the map indicators for the quest area.
[*] Arena: Players can no longer re-join completed Arena matches.
[*] Crafting: Adjusted the crafting materials for Rare Blank Lithograph recipes. These no longer differentiate between Epic and Precious Enchanted Ink, and simply use 'Enchanted Ink' as a material (renamed Precious Enchanted Ink).
[*] Fishing: Improved the 'hook' animation while fishing.
[*] Customization: Adjusted some character customization options to keep eyes safely behind eyelids.
[*] Tutorial: Fixed an issue where players could become blocked by logging out during the morph portion of the tutorial.
[/list]
[h3]Dungeons[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new matchmaking option will allow players to join a randomized dungeon from all available options and more easily fill groups. Players could previously only queue for specific dungeons.
[*] Increased the bonus HP and Damage buff applied when matchmaking dungeon groups from 5% to 10%.
[*] Adjusted matchmaking logic to attempt to form groups of similar power progression more consistently.
[*] Party members can no longer be kicked from the party during active boss encounters.
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected a tooltip text error for the Crossbow's Quick Fire: 'Damage Increase' skill specialization.
[*] Corrected a tooltip error for the Staff passive ability 'Mana Amp' that incorrectly switched the HP and Mana values.
[*] 'Precious Skill Growth' books now properly indicate whether they upgrade Active or Passive skills.
[*] Corrected a tooltip error for the Wand's Corrupted Magic Circle: 'Decaying Touch' skill specialization that claimed the skill applied to multiple targets when it does not.
[*] Applied latest localization updates, including the correction of several untranslated strings.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guild Contracts: Time to Next Contract now displays more reliably after completing guild contracts.
[*] Amitoi, Morph Menus: Selecting the 'Only View Favorites' option no longer cuts off the bottom of the UI in some instances.
[*] Party Board: Various bug fixes related to awkward or incorrect behavior of the Party Board display.
[*] Party Board: Join requests now show the character's weapon types and guild information.
[*] Manage Party Display: Various bug fixes related to the behavior of the Manage Party / Group Member UI.
[*] Arena: Completing weekly missions now displays a notification, and the Arena UI will display the time until the next weekly mission refresh.
[*] Relocated the Help button to the top right corner across multiple UI windows.
[*] Moderation warnings no longer appear on each login once acknowledged.
[*] Added details to some connectivity-related error messages.
[*] Added a button to check name availability when creating or changing character names.
[/list]
[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some areas of the Amitoi and Morph menus that could not be navigated with the D-pad.
[*] Fishing will no longer be cancelled by pressing the B key while in fishing mode.
[*] Fixed a case where charged abilities could still fire after cancelling a long button press.
[/list]
[h2]PC[/h2]
[list]
[*] Temporarily disabled the ability to attach file uploads in character customization or support requests while we improve the file attachment functionality.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: First Battle Pass: Zenus’ Star
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/sHtR4zYCfiRloINKv9S3i/56d50313834987e947a0ec4ac6002428/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_DaybreakShoreStatues_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Conquer Solisium in style with the Zenus Weapons Cosmetics, Proud Taion Morph, Tin Knight Polymorph, Red Knight Ossic Amitoi, and more. Zenus’ Star, the first THRONE AND LIBERTY Battle Pass, awaits. Want even more unique rewards for completing seasonal challenges? The Battle Pass is an optional seasonal purchase that can turn your accomplishments into new cosmetics, crafting materials, items, and various in-game currency. Each Battle Pass features a free track and a premium track that can be unlocked with Lucent. Look forward to new spoils every season.

Learn more about the Battle Pass below, discover every featured reward in our video showcase, and then explore answers to your most common questions.

[h2]Zenus’ Star Showcase[/h2]
[previewyoutube=jypBvF81z7o;full][/previewyoutube]
The Zenus’ Star Battle Pass is available now through October 30, 2PM PT. There are desirable rewards at every level, but the most ambitious adventurers will strive to achieve max level (level 50) for the following loot.
[list]
[*] Level 1 (Premium Track): Dash Morph - Proud Taion
[*] Level 10 (Premium Track): Pose - Pray
[*] Level 20 (Free Track): Polymorph - Tin Knight
[*] Level 30 (Premium Track): Amitoi - Red Knight Ossic
[*] Level 50 (Premium Track): Zenus Weapon Selection Chest (Select 2 of the 7 weapon cosmetics)
[/list]
Don’t forget to use your Star Crystals for valuable items in the Zenus’ Star Point Shop. As you progress your Battle Pass, you’ll earn Star Crystals as free rewards at levels 5, 10, 15, 25, 30, 35, and 45. Additional Battle Pass experience upon reaching level 50 will be converted into Star Crystals. At the end of the Battle Pass season, your Star Crystals will turn into Quality Recovery Crystals. Here are some of the featured items from the Zenus’ Star Point Shop.
[list]
[*] (Premium Only) All 7 Zenus Weapon Cosmetics
[*] Skill Conversion Book
[*] Resistance Contracts
[*] Trait Extraction Stone
[*] Trait Conversion Stone
[/list]
[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[b]How do I buy the premium track?[/b]
[list]
[*] After completing the tutorial, the premium track can be purchased with Lucent from the Battle Pass screen. Launch THRONE AND LIBERTY, and once in-game navigate to the Battle Pass section of the in-game menu to purchase the premium track from there. If you need Lucent, it can be purchased from the in-game store.
[/list]
[b]How can I progress my Battle Pass?[/b]
[list]
[*] Players can complete daily, weekly, and seasonal challenges to progress their Battle Pass. Additionally, players can purchase up to 49 levels with Lucent. Levels purchased beyond the max are converted to Star Crystals.
[/list]
[b]Do I miss out on daily quests if I don’t log in every day?[/b]
[list]
[*] No! Daily quests are granted each day throughout the season and “banked.” That means you can complete as many as you have available upon log in.
[/list]
[b]How can I access the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass Point Shop is accessible to all players as soon as you gain Battle Pass Shop Points. The shop contains rotating rewards and offers, including other cosmetics and items to help with progression. Once a character achieves the maximum Battle Pass level, all Battle Pass experience will convert into Battle Pass Shop Points.
[/list]
[b]Do I need to purchase the Battle Pass to buy items from the Battle Pass Point Shop?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass is only required to buy seasonal weapon cosmetics. Everything else is purchasable for all players.
[/list]
[b]Can I buy the Battle Pass late into the season?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! When you purchase the premium track you'll receive all of the rewards up to your current Battle Pass level retroactively.
[/list]
[b]If I don’t buy the premium track can I still earn rewards?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! If you don’t purchase the premium track you’ll still earn a reward for every completed level on the free track.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track do I still get the rewards from the free track?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! Everyone that plays THRONE AND LIBERTY can make progress and earn rewards on the free track.
[/list]
[b]Can I earn rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] After a Battle Pass ends, many of its rewards will become unobtainable. However, for a limit time you’ll have a grace period to claim some of the free and paid track rewards you might have missed.
[/list]
[b]Can I claim my rewards after the Battle Pass has ended?[/b]
[list]
[*] Yes! After a Battle Pass ends you will still be able to claim any earned rewards from that Battle Pass. These items can be found in the Battle Pass menu. Select the tab of the previous season to claim your items. You will have until the end of the following Battle Pass to claim them.
[/list]
[b]How will the Battle Pass work for multiple characters on the same account?[/b]
[list]
[*] The Battle Pass progression and non-cosmetic rewards are character specific.
[*] Battle Pass Rewards can be earned and claimed once per character.
[*] If you transfer your character to another server, battle pass progress will transfer with the character.
[*] Cosmetic rewards are account wide. Once they are claimed on any of your characters, they’ll be available to all of your characters.
[/list]
[b]If I buy the premium track on one platform, can I access it on another platform?[/b]
[list]
[*] No, the Battle Pass is character specific and can only be accessed on your character’s platform.
[/list]
[b]Can I replay or complete previous Battle Passes?[/b]
[list]
[*] Progress cannot be made on a Battle Pass once the season ends.
[/list]
Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Letter to the Community
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2M9QknYbDwZpAA88LavQPh/e362a862a987c286775ff106d305a708/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_NestingGrounds_1920_720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Watching players work together to unlock milestones, engage in massive battles, and strive to become the best guild motivates us to deliver even more memorable moments. Right now, we are focused on addressing the biggest player reported issues. Below you’ll find a list of notable issues followed by actions we’ve taken to resolve them. As we forge ahead, we'll continue to listen, adapt, and pour our passion into making this a special experience for you, the players who make it all possible.

[h3]Population Drops, Service Instability/Inaccessibility[/h3]
After we opened commercial launch servers, we immediately noticed that some players were being disconnected, encountering stalled black screens when loading the game, gate server issues, and login loops. All of these issues are related to the same cause which we're working to address. Over the last day, we've reduced the number of occurrences significantly but it's not fully resolved yet. This is a primary focus of our technical teams at this time. We understand how it impacts your play session and are working to get it resolved as quickly as possible.

As many players noticed, especially in our European community, a number of connection issues, including the infamous “Gate Server Disconnect,” have occurred. Our team has been working around the clock with NCSoft to isolate and resolve these issues. The Gate Servers were getting hammered by the number of logins which put them in a state that wouldn’t allow players to connect or stay connected to the World Servers. We’ve tripled the number of Gate servers almost everywhere, and haven’t seen them dropping connections in the last few days. After that we noticed the World Servers and the World DB’s both hit limits on their resource utilization. While we had scaled these up from the hosts in the Korean service, we didn’t realize just how far we needed to go. We’ve since scaled the services up (more memory, IOPS, etc.) to allow the processes more resources while you’re smashing the servers with your guild.

[h3]Cannot Create Character Error 10[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3kZ5fTrHL21s1Un8Yg6mPr/7275dc8c783fcb3e3ecdf581b0230a8f/TL_Summer_Game_Fest_Press_Screenshots_Combat_v01_B_1920.jpg[/img]
We've received player reports about encountering an "Unable to create character on the server (10)" error message. While this error message is true, it was slightly misleading as the issue is caused by a world not allowing new characters to be created or existing characters to transfer to the server in question. When a world was at its character creation cap, the server selection screen did not update with that information quickly enough. We apologize for the confusion.

World servers that are locked from the creation of new characters will periodically have their caps increased as players progress. We understand that it's inconvenient to wait if you're trying to play on the same servers as your friends and we are committed to raising the cap appropriately. This is a balancing act to ensure that queue wait times also remain acceptable.

[h3]Friends List Disappeared[/h3]
We’ve received reports from some players that their friends list has disappeared, while other players have experienced issues with their friend requests remaining on screen even after accepting or declining. We’re looking into this to determine the cause and appreciate your patience.

[h3]Auction House Bugs in Europe[/h3]
Some Early Access servers on the Europe region had an issue where their Auction Houses were isolated. Efforts to consolidate them introduced new problems like the inability to post items, items appearing to be sold when they weren’t, failure to list new items, and delayed Lucent delivery. After determining the root cause, we’ve worked to correct the issues above. It’s taken us longer than than expected and we appreciate your patience while we worked to fix it.

[h3]Realm Switching, Finding Characters, Key Binds, etc[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3h8hYE8PrdCkFoYum9YTlM/fcc0aaef3c8f59f46d422558f4f2a962/T_L_Screenshots_For_Blog_Headers_Gigantrite_A_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Players discovered that their custom game settings were reset when logging in. This issue was linked to key bindings lost, realm selection preferences changed, characters appearing to be gone, and store inaccessibility. A few key servers on the back end that store your settings were congested due to network traffic. Working with NCSoft we rolled out more of these servers to handle the additional load from all the new players joining since commercial launch which fixed the issue for some but not all so we’re still working on it. Rest assured that no data has been lost and your character is still there, you just can’t see it due to being defaulted to the wrong region. Waiting for a bit and trying again helps - fixing this is a top priority.

[h3]AG iD linking rewards[/h3]
After we launched, we began receiving reports from some players were not receiving their rewards for linking their game accounts to AG iD. We've made some progress in our investigation, but are still working on resolving the core issue. In the meanwhile, we have begun manually granting missing rewards to players in batches and will continue to do so.

The issues we’re currently tracking can be found on our [url=https://www.amazongames.com/en-us/support/throne-and-liberty/articles/known-issues]Known Issues[/url] page. If you’re experiencing account, purchase, or billing related issues, please [url=https://www.amazongames.com/en-us/support/throne-and-liberty]contact Customer Support[/url]. For all other problems, please be patient as our team works to investigate and resolve things as they’re discovered. Your detailed reports are incredibly valuable. We will continue to monitor feedback and sentiment as we work together toward making THRONE AND LIBERTY the best experience possible possible. Thank you for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

notes.title: Milestone Highlights 10/1
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4kBQ6VnPu8cJ6hosvSN9LU/41f461b7786ca6b690924b37b33b934b/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Combat_Siege_A_1920.jpg[/img]
Milestones are time sensitive events that reward you and your guild with unique incentives. The first set of players who complete these challenge goals will receive unique spoils as well as unlock their server’s next set of content for everyone to enjoy. However, if time runs out and no one completes the Milestone goal, no rewards will be given and the next set of content will unlock at a later time based on the Milestone schedule. 
[list]
[*] Early Access: September 26  
[*] Full Launch: October 1
[/list]
[h2]The Beginning of History[/h2]

There are numerous dangers in Solisium. As you achieve your objectives one by one with the power of Star Fragments, you may be able to drive away the darkness that shadows over Solisium.

The first 100 Players that reach level 10 will grant their server to have the title: Historian. If 100 Players do not reach level 10 by the end of the event, no one will receive this title. Let’s get to level 10 as fast as we can!

[h2]Defeat the Wolf King’s Remaining Forces[/h2]

Lord Hobs of Laslan has requested the help of the Resistance to protect Kastleton from the threat of the wolves. Lead the hunters and defeat the vicious wolves. 

Players must kill 5,000 wolves in Black Howl Plans to grant everyone in their server the reward of 20 Recovery Crystals. Recovery Crystals are consumables that can instantly restore health when used. These crystals are very useful for leveling as monsters become more dangerous as you progress.

To complete this Milestone quickly, we recommend players to participate in the Dynamic Event: Wolf Hunting Contest!

[h2]Operation: Blood Spider Extermination [/h2]

Kalturan orc Morokai has abandoned the pride of Flamakan, the God of Fire, and betrayed his clan. To summon the traitor Morokai, exploit his obsession with the Blood Spider.

Guilds will need to kill 50 Spiders in the Carmine Forest to receive 1,000 Stellarite, a consumable that boosts your attack and deals bonus damage. Completing this goal will also unlock Field Boss: Morokai, Dynamic Event: Lantern Seed Festival, and unlock the Temple of Sylaveth 1F and 2F.

[h2]Master of Carmine Forest - Field Boss: Morokai[/h2]

The Carmine Forest is under constant threat from Morokai the Turcoat and his spiders. Defeat Morokai, who has cast darkness over the forest, and drive out his unruly spiders.

Morokai is the very first Field Boss that players can fight to obtain early Epic gear! Players can receive 5 Rare Weapon Growthstones by defeating Morokai before the Milestone timer ends. Rare Weapon Growthstones are expensive to craft and are rare to come by from loot so having them early on helps!

Greatsword users will want to get to this boss first as he drops a very powerful weapon called Morokai’s Greatblade of Corruption, which is a great early game to mid game weapon!

[h2]The Best of the Best[/h2]

For the first and third Milestone Chapters, you can compete for the Top 100 Growth Rankings to get extra rewards. At the end of Chapter 3, an exclusive title will be granted to the Top 100 players for completing each Milestone with the highest score you can possibly achieve.

The other chapters will have guilds compete for the Top 20 in Guild Rankings towards the end the chapter as well for rewards and at chapter 6, a unique title given to all members within the Top 20. Do your best to complete all the Milestones and become the best of the best!

This isn't the only way we're supporting the Discord community, you can also join our official server for news, guild recruitment and more! [img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3G2rgnK2Zs2u8ZiJY5UN1F/20dfea826022ad720c42c9efe0ffcd53/TL_Discord_Coin_Promo_WEB_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early Access is Now Live
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=9JoiLoYibdU;full][/previewyoutube]
Early access is now live and the servers are open. Be the first to enter the fray with Early Access Packs and play [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY [/i]now.

Battle thousands in pursuit of the throne, dash across or above a beautiful world as customizable morphs, and wield powerful weapon combinations now during early access. We are thrilled to finally welcome players into Solisium! Get even more out of your early access experience through community spaces, the Conquest of the Guilds event, and more. From exploring dungeons alongside your guild for highly coveted loot, to joining an Alliance vying for control of Solisium in Castle Siege, [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] values, emphasizes, and celebrates player interaction.

You can text and voice chat with other players in-game, but we want to make sure you have the tools to connect with other players, and our team, outside of the game. Below you will find ways to connect with the [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] community, plus how to get involved if you’re interested in joining our Creator program.

[h2]Community Platforms[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4kBQ6VnPu8cJ6hosvSN9LU/41f461b7786ca6b690924b37b33b934b/TL_Announce_Screenshots_Combat_Siege_A_1920.jpg[/img]
The [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord server[/url] was built for Amazon Games staff members to host events, townhalls, AMAs, and talk to the community. Say hello, meet other players, and provide feedback on how to make Solisium better for every type of player. Guilds are another major aspect of the game, especially Discord engagement.

To find the right group, first ask yourself what type of guild would you enjoy the most. Want to focus on specific game modes? There’s a guild for that. How about leaderboards? There’s a guild for that too. Now think about what you’re most excited about in [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i]. There’s a guild for that, if you want to create it. Gather players with shared interests, goals, or something else entirely for an even more satisfying experience.

Follow our social accounts and [url=playthroneandliberty.com]playthroneandliberty.com[/url] for exclusive content, community highlights, and the latest information on all things [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i].

[h2]Early Access Pack Showcase[/h2]
[previewyoutube=g_LnKJeRaqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Interested in starting your journey right now? Visit our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/shop]Shop Page[/url] for details and pricing.
Early Access Packs are brimming with a variety of cosmetic and currency rewards to help you begin your adventure in style. Any of the packs secure early access into [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] 5 days before launch. Please note that early access to [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] on Xbox Series X|S requires Xbox Game Pass Ultimate or Xbox Game Pass Core (sold separately).
[list]
[*] Early Access Packs will be removed from the store on October 1.
[*] All Early Access cosmetics are exclusive and will not be sold again.
[*] By using the Mirror Boutique you can dye your costume and customize your appearance in a multitude of ways. The helmet and accessories can also be removed.
[/list]
Join us in Solisium to celebrate the launch of early access alongside new friends, rivals, and frenemies during the Conquest of Guilds event.

[h3]Creator Program[/h3]
The [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] Creator Program empowers you to collaborate with the [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] team and other creative members of the community. Whether you’re a streamer, YouTuber, wiki author, cosplayer, artist, musician, or anyone else who makes something to contribute to the love of [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i], we want to find ways to support you.

There are no requirements to apply other than a desire to create great [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] content. Learn more and sign up on our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/community/creator-program]Creator Program page[/url].

[h2]Conquest of Guilds[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2Es1gPWoQBHSudkb5SPaLY/d723042e95589d9c788e87618bae7cd4/TL_Closed_Beta_Screenshots_ChernobogRiftstone_v01_1080__1_.jpeg[/img]
Want to start your adventure with even greater rewards and recognition? Conquest of Guilds is live now for early access servers.

Gather your guild, complete challenges, and stake your claim as one of the best guilds for more than just bragging rights. Conquest of Guilds is a two-week long event for guilds to slash their way into [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] history. An exclusive in-game title, plus Ornate Coins, a highly desirable in-game currency, await those willing to conquer Solisium across almost every guild activity. How will your guild be remembered?

With a variety of featured PvP and PvE challenges, this is the best time to make a name for your guild. Both early access and launch servers will crown their own top guilds after the event ends on October 13 at 10AM PT. Check out your potential spoils, preview the guild challenges, and learn why [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] is better together in our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/conquest-of-guilds]Conquest of Guilds announcement article[/url].

Thanks for being part of the [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] community! We cannot wait to welcome even more players, guilds, and alliances to Solisium during the full launch on October 1. Look forward to additional content, updates, and ways to enjoy [i]THRONE AND LIBERTY[/i] in the future. This is only the beginning of our journey together. We’ll see you in Solisium.

notes.title: Launch Prep: Activity Times
notes.content:
To help players pick a server or region to play in, we’re releasing the server times that various activities will take place in Solisium once they unlock. Haven’t seen the server list yet? Check out our Launch Prep: THRONE AND LIBERTY Servers article. Below you’ll find the server time zones and the start times for key server activities. While not all of these activities will be live at launch, we want to ensure you have the information you need to make a decision on which server or region is best suited to your needs. We will be releasing our upcoming content roadmap on September 25, so make sure to read when some of these major activities will unlock after launch. 

[h3]Server Time Zones[/h3]
Server times are tied to the region they are located in. These are the time zones used by each server location:
[list][*] North America (NA) East - EDT (UTC -4)
[*] North America (NA) West - PDT (UTC -7)
[*] South America (SA) East - BRT (UTC -3)
[*] Europe (EU) Central - CET (UTC +2)
[*] Asia Pacific (AP) Northeast (Tokyo) - JST (UTC +9)[/list]

[h3]Activity Start Times[/h3]
All event times are displayed in a 24h time formatting, each taking place at the local server time, corresponding to the server time zones list above.

notes.title: Conquest of Guilds
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4Mo088MqnMLU4l9b43e79Z/cde87d3c7838f7684c3a24d49d1bacd9/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_ConquestBattles_v01_A_1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
Gather your guild, complete challenges, and stake your claim as one of the best guilds for more than just bragging rights. Conquest of Guilds is a two-week long event for guilds to slash their way into THRONE AND LIBERTY history. An exclusive in-game title, plus Ornate Coins, a highly desirable in-game currency, await those willing to conquer Solisium across almost every guild activity. How will your guild be remembered?

Join players with shared interests, goals, or something else entirely for an even more enjoyable experience when Conquest of Guilds begins on September 26 for Early Access servers and October 1 for Launch servers. With a variety of featured PvP and PvE challenges, this is the best time to make a name for your guild. Both Early Access and Launch servers will crown their own top guilds after the event ends on October 13 at 10 a.m. PT.

Check out your potential spoils, preview the guild challenges, and learn why THRONE AND LIBERTY is better together.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2AX7uOA3QNkt2rqsxecXc7/6f39e229b3d25fc4e58979769f39fdbe/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_Arenas_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
Outwit, outperform, and outplay other guilds for an exclusive title and Ornate Coins. Both Early Access and Launch servers will have their own set of winning guilds per server. If two guilds finish with the same total points, then whichever guild had the overall higher Guild Score based on the in-game Guild Ranking Leaderboard will win.
[list]
[*] First place per server: 500 Ornate Coins per player
[*] Second place per server: 400 Ornate Coins per player
[*] Third place per server: 300 Ornate Coins per player
[*] Each player from the top 5 guilds on both Early Access and Launch servers will also receive an exclusive in-game Title. Only 10 guilds will receive this prize globally.
[/list]
All players that are in a guild for the following amount of time and their guild reaches Guild Level 7 will receive Ornate Coins.
[list]
[*] Be in a guild for 168 total hours: 150 Ornate Coins
[*] Be in a guild for 72 total hours: 100 Ornate Coins
[*] Be in a guild for 24 total hours: 50 Ornate Coins
[/list]
Players in the top placing guilds must have been a part of their guild for at least 96 hours to qualify for rewards. If a player is in more than one guild that finishes in a top placement, they will not receive additional prizes.

[h2]Guild Challenges[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1sNfoCnBquok8bJN4VTm8H/45f16ea95cad1905887b0e83683c742d/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_ConquestBattles_v01_B_1080.jpeg[/img]
Conquest of Guilds requires effective coordination across guild activities to help players get the most out of their time in Solisium. Here’s an overview of each activity followed by their point breakdowns.

[h3]Arena[/h3]
Eliminations score points, but so does survival. Take advantage of temporary buffs, steal points from opposing players, and gather special orbs for a surprise victory. The top 10 guilds per server based on the in-game Arena Ranking Leaderboard will receive points. Only the top ranked player from each guild will be considered.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 40 points
[*] Second: 35 points
[*] Third: 32 points
[*] Fourth: 29 points
[*] Fifth: 26 points
[*] Sixth: 23 points
[*] Seventh: 20 points
[*] Eighth: 19 points
[*] Ninth: 18 points
[*] Tenth: 17 points
[/list]
[h3]Conquest Battles[/h3]
Capture either the Boonstone or Riftstone during Conquest Battles to earn points for your guild. Each time a guild captures a new stone, they will receive 8 points. You only get points for a new stone, so guilds who want to maximize their rank should fight for a new stone at each opportunity.

[h3]Co-op Dungeons (Level 50)[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1H7UyKCrz5QIxkSPJCKpoL/2745cd6aad02dd19037d183685676036/tl_announce_screenshots_dungeons_darkcrypt_b_1920.jpg[/img]
Take on increasingly difficult instanced dungeons through the Dimensional Circle as you level up and master your abilities. The top guilds with the fastest completion time per Level 50 dungeon on each server will receive points. There are 6 dungeons to conquer for this event. Only the fastest run for each guild will be considered, and all 6 members of the party must be in the same guild to qualify.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 10 points
[*] Second: 8 points
[*] Third: 6 points
[*] Fourth: 5 points
[*] Fifth: 4 points
[/list]
[h3]Collection Codex[/h3]
Collect all of the Collection Codex Journal pages on a single character faster than other guilds to receive points. Collection times will automatically be tracked internally for each server, although they won’t be visible to players. Only the fastest character per guild will be considered. If no one collects all journal pages, then the results will be based on whoever collects the most pages. If two people collect the same number of pages, then time will be used as a tie breaker.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 30 points
[*] Second: 25 points
[*] Third: 22 points
[*] Fourth: 18 points
[*] Fifth: 16 points
[*] Sixth: 14 points
[*] Seventh: 12 points
[*] Eighth: 11 points
[*] Ninth: 10 points
[*] Tenth: 8 points
[/list]
[h3]Dynamic Events: Guild[/h3]
The guilds with the most top 3 finishes during these guild-only, open-world events will receive points. Dynamic Events: Guild results will automatically be tracked internally for each server, although they won’t be visible to players. Other Dynamic Event modes will not be considered. If two or more guilds finish with the same number of top 3 results, the tie will be broken based on the number of first place wins, followed by second place wins, and if necessary, third place wins. If multiple guilds have identical placements, then points will be awarded evenly to each guild.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 40 points
[*] Second: 35 points
[*] Third: 30 points
[*] Fourth: 25 points
[*] Fifth: 20 points
[/list]
[h3]Gate of Infinity[/h3]
Hone your skills against challenging bosses in this solo mode. The fastest guilds in each server based on the in-game Gate of Infinity Leaderboard will score points. Weapon combination is not considered. Only the quickest run for each guild, per boss, will count.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 10 points
[*] Second: 8 points
[*] Third: 6 points
[*] Fourth: 5 points
[*] Fifth: 4 points
[/list]
[h3]Guild Rank[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3rGJhYTb9YZvM5j3CdxnnL/dd44d824bc1b2f42dd86474d88c8ad7d/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_D_1080.jpeg[/img]
Guild Rank, accumulated via activities like guild PvP modes and Contracts, grants successful groups rewards and powerful skills, such as the ability to control the weather. The top scoring guilds per server will receive points based on the in-game Guild Rank Leaderboard.

Point breakdown per server:
[list]
[*] First: 100 points
[*] Second: 95 points
[*] Third: 90 points
[*] Fourth: 85 points
[*] Fifth: 80 points
[*] Sixth: 75 points
[*] Seventh: 70 points
[*] Eighth: 65 points
[*] Ninth: 60 points
[*] Tenth: 55 points
[/list]
[h2]How to Join a Guild[/h2]
[url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/forward-link?id=discord]Join the official THRONE AND LIBERTY Discord[/url] to gather your guild across PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S before early access on September 26. Your early coordination might even give you a better chance of conquering Solisium at launch on October 1. Upon joining the Discord Server and agreeing to the server rules, you will choose your platform, region, and notification settings. Different channels will appear based on your preferences.

Guild recruitment in-game is a few search filters away. Browse various types, view requirements, and reach out to potential guilds. Your top choice might not be the one you expect, so don’t be afraid to try different groups. Between all of their quirks, your favorite activity is a great place to start.

Some simply offer comradery — hang out, match outfits, casually run dungeons, or explore Solisium. For others, it’s all about those moment to moment triumphs while working toward high guild ranks from humble beginnings.

[previewyoutube=uT_6gFKqa_w;full][/previewyoutube]
To find the right group, first ask yourself what type of guild would you enjoy the most. Want to focus on specific game modes? There’s a guild for that. How about leaderboards? There’s a guild for that too. Now think about what you’re most excited about in THRONE AND LIBERTY. There’s a guild for that, if you want to create it.

Membership grants you access to a long list of guild-exclusive benefits, including special shops and supplies, additional resources, Guild Raids, Guild Contracts, Dynamic Guild Events, Guild Emblems, Conquest Battles, a Guild Base, and Guild Rank.

Looking for more practical advantages? The extra support in open-world activities will help bolster progression. More easily explore dangerous regions crawling with vicious monsters, thwart aggressive players, and acquire better gear. Find a guild early in your adventure to take advantage of each perk.
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1ox2hj8681BPtd5zF9emld/710ccf4536601d0501358b3c7f62a8da/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
We cannot wait to welcome players into Solisium on September 26 for Early Access and October 1 for the full release. Stay tuned to our website and social channels for more information as we head toward launch. We’ll see you in Solisium soon!

notes.title: Team Update: Launch Release Notes
notes.content:
A wealth of stories, experiences, and adventures are quickly approaching. The gates of Solisium opening for early access on September 26 and full launch on October 1. With release on the horizon, we wanted to take a moment and share some important information regarding THRONE AND LIBERTY. Below, you’ll find a link to a letter from our team discussing our vision of the future and learn about launch build updates (the differences between Open Beta and the launch version of THRONE AND LIBERTY). 

Dive in on the [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/news/articles/launch-release-notes]Team Update: Launch Release Notes[/url] on our official website.

notes.title: Launch Prep: THRONE AND LIBERTY Servers
notes.content:
With early access and launch rapidly approaching, we know many guilds and player communities are eager to coordinate, pick a world, and prepare for arrival in Solisium. In this article we’ll discuss server structure, provide a list of worlds, detail the specific launch timings, and clarify some questions we’ve seen from the THRONE AND LIBERTY community.

[h1]Early Access & Full Launch Servers[/h1]

We saw some questions from the community regarding how Early Access Servers and Full Launch Servers are planned to work and interact with each other. Our goal is to design a system that provides non-early access users the same fresh server opportunity as early access players. Please refer to the early access section in the TL Business Model - What to Expect article for more information.
Early Access Servers are the set of servers that open on September 26 at 10AM PST (5PM UTC) before launch on October 1 at 10AM PST (5PM UTC). After the full launch on October 1, all new servers opening will be part of the Full Launch Server group.

We want to provide some additional clarity on how these servers will work. Here’s a quick summary, with more specifics below the following items.

Once both groups of servers are live, players can create new characters on Early Access or Full Launch Servers at any time, subject to population caps. If you begin playing at full launch and want to join your friends on an Early Access Server, you may create a character there on October 1 regardless of whether or not you purchased an Early Access Pack.

Players can transfer from Full Launch Servers to open Early Access Servers at any time.
We will offer limited-time free transfers to all players from September 26 through October 17.
Early Access Servers will eventually have their transfer restriction lifted.

[h2]Early Access and Launch Server Transfer Details[/h2]
At the full launch on October 1 we will temporarily restrict characters from transferring off of Early Access Servers to Launch Servers. Players on Full Launch Servers can transfer (subject to space availability) to either Early Access or other Full Launch Servers without restrictions. We plan to remove the ‘early access’ tags and let players apply to transfer from Early Access to Full Launch Servers when the time is right. Our team will work to determine the optimal time based on player feedback and data. We know players are interested in this date and as we get a feel for how population has been distributed following launch, we will update you with a planned timeline.


[h2]Limited Free Server Transfers[/h2]
We know that launches can be a hectic time for MMO communities. Between queues, coordinating with guilds or friends, or finding new communities after launch, it can be hard to find the right server to call home. To help you find the optimal server to call home we are providing players the ability to claim up to two free server transfer tickets per day, beginning with early access and running through October 17. Please note that free transfer tickets will expire 24 hours after claiming to avoid players stockpiling.
During the free transfer period, you can transfer to eligible realms as frequently as you’d like (subject to the number of tickets claimed). Please be mindful when transferring. If you transfer off a server there is no guarantee you will be able to transfer back to that server if it reaches its population cap. During the free-transfer period there is no transfer cool-down. After October 17 server transfers tickets will need to be acquired with Lucent, and server transfers will be set to a 30-day cooldown.


[h2]Population Caps[/h2]
THRONE AND LIBERTY Early Access and Full Launch Servers will have a maximum capacity of characters who can enter the server at any given time to help ensure stability. As a result, servers with a high population will likely have queues at launch. To mitigate queues, we will lock high population servers from allowing new characters to be created. All existing characters can continue to log-in. We will announce when character creation locks are being implemented on high population servers, and when they will be unlocked. If a server that has been unlocked reaches the population cap again, it will be re-locked. We hope that you are able to use the free server transfers to find the optimal server to call home for you and your community.

[h1]Server List[/h1]
We are releasing server names ahead of time to ensure that you’ll have time to coordinate with your friends and guild members. It is important for our team to establish servers with healthy populations, and each region will launch with a minimum of two servers to choose from. We plan to open new servers as the existing servers reach their population caps. We have prepared many servers ready to be opened instantly should demand require, and share the names for the first ones we’ll open below. For PlayStation players, each region will feature one PlayStation-only server, which PlayStation players will be able to view at early access and launch.

At early access and Full Launch we’ll have servers in five regions:
[list][*] North America (NA) East
[*] North America (NA) West
[*] South America (SA) East
[*] Europe (EU) Central
[*] Asia Pacific (AP) Northeast (Tokyo)[/list]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3J1GlAl1HdlionLWDMtMSL/23ede9b592c43467e3a0e24a6f955006/TL_NA_EAST_1920x1080_EN.jpg[/img]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/79GC7xyy4ePJdZmAkxAqCe/5fdf5074b913a6ef40a989dcbc1042a6/TL_NA_WEST_1920x1080_EN.jpg[/img]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/zOJSBwThZ7QAgmSpAUstE/8d4086b5f2835168de25c7abb9763417/TL_SA_EAST_1920x1080_EN.jpg[/img]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/18zKhlSsPxqas5Wf1Ct19e/3298ba4ac1065462f373c005a8b099aa/TL_EU_CENTRAL_1920x1080_EN.jpg[/img]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2DZw5K6GNRQs2SZVpVkJoJ/ee3b2328e9db5370f71a93db6c67102b/TL_AP_NORTHEAST_1920x1080_EN.jpg[/img]



[h2]Auction House Clusters[/h2]
Auction Houses will be clustered to combine a region’s auction houses together. Let’s use the NA East region as an example. Auction houses on the Early Access Servers in NA East region will be clustered together. At launch, Full Launch Servers will be separately clustered from early access to ensure fairness. In the future, we will consolidate auction houses— resulting in early access and Full Launch clusters joining together while still contained within the same region.


[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
We’re excited for you to set foot in Solisium and begin your adventure on September 26 for early access and October 1 for the Full Launch. Interested in early access on September 26? [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/news/articles/early-access-packs-available-now]Checkout the Early Access Packs[/url].

Our next server related article will include details around the pre-load experience for THRONE AND LIBERTY. Stay tuned to our website and social channels for more information as we head toward launch. We’ll see you in Solisium soon!

notes.title: Business Model Epilogue
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3DQJPW2y6DCcvpnDUnQida/9953e925d5256308199e02c98f54a8d8/TL_AGiD_Amitoi_01_1920x1080_CT-000008713.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
As THRONE AND LIBERTY prepares for early access and full release, we'd like to provide some additional information and clarity to a few areas from our original [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/tl-business-model]Business Model article[/url]. If you haven't had a chance to read through that article, we recommend familiarizing yourself with the content, as this article is a follow-up to many of the concepts and ideas discussed throughout that piece. To quickly recap the core of the previous article, we identified three tenets that embody our values, guide our decision-making, and serve as the business model’s foundation:
[list]
[*] Player self-expression is paramount
[*] Combat and power upgrades must be accessible to all players
[*] Purchasing items from our in-game shop must feel rewarding, but never necessary
[/list]
So, with those in-mind, let’s cover some answers to top questions we’ve seen arise from the THRONE AND LIBERTY community.

[h3]Auction House[/h3]
We believe the auction house is fundamentally important to allow free-to-play players a method to earn premium currency in game. The Auction House is the hub for the player-driven economy within THRONE AND LIBERTY, where players can trade items and gear with each other. Since premium currency is not required to list items, all players can sell items on the Auction House to acquire premium currency without spending real world money.

As we were designing the auction house we wanted to place limits on the types of items directly purchasable. Only base level gear can be listed on the Auction House. Any gear that has been advanced or upgraded in any way— if traits are unlocked or upgraded— it is not eligible to be listed for sale. Gear obtained from instanced content such as Co-op Dungeons and Guild Raids are also not eligible to be listed in the Auction House.

One of the main goals is to provide a consistent system for free-to-play players to earn currency in-game and use the Lucent earned to acquire content normally locked exclusively behind paywalls. If you choose not to spend a dime, you can earn premium currency in-game through various activities, from collecting rare drops to sell to other players on the auction house, and PvP rewards. With this earned currency, you'll have the freedom to unlock cosmetics, leveling passes, battle passes, and more—a ton of items that would typically be locked behind a paywall in other games. Our goal is to make THRONE AND LIBERTY accessible to all, across PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

[h3]Lucent[/h3]
We’ve seen some some player questions about how Lucent will function. Lucent will be shared across all characters on your account. Players may earn or purchase Lucent on any server. Players may also spend Lucent on any server they choose. For example, players with a character on an server ‘A’ may sell items on the auction house to earn Lucent, then, on another character, may choose to spend that Lucent on server ‘B’.

[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]
[h3]Account-Wide Cosmetics[/h3]
Items of the following type will be shared with all characters. Those items include:
[list]
[*] Any cosmetics acquired through packs purchased with real-world money or Lucent.
[*] Any cosmetics acquired through Early Access Packs. The outfit is account wide but style, dye, and patterns are character specific. Customization options are not account wide.
[*] Any cosmetics acquired through Twitch Drops.
[/list]
Please note, cosmetic items that are earned through game-play or events will be character specific. Battle passes and leveling passes are also character specific. The rewards in each can be useful and we want to allow you to purchase up to one per character. The purchase and rewards of the Battle Pass and Leveling Pass are applied and earned on a per-character basis, but the cosmetics obtained from them are account-wide. The first time you receive the cosmetics, they will be saved to your account, and if you receive them multiple times, they will remain in your inventory as an item and can be sold to a vendor. Cosmetics purchased from the in-game store will also be account-wide, meaning they can only be purchased once per account instead of per character.

[h3]Early Access Packs Clarifications[/h3]
Early Access Packs, including the Lucent they contain, are granted to your account upon first login.

We’ve also seen a common question from the community asking if the colors of the costumes showcased in the Early Access Packs were the only option. Absolutely not! By using the Mirror Boutique you can dye your costume and customize your appearance in a multitude of ways. Helmet and accessories are optional. A few configuration options are shown below. Please note that to change colors and patterns, Dyes and Sewing Threads are required.

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1UmQ7aJZNE7ahlpWJ4Qyv1/1754ef1331ec4e812bfc264a17d72f7e/TL_EAPACK_SHADOWKNIGHT_1920x1080.jpg[/img]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/7uW88X1RkvjnqYaBk65kw5/c280f935a2c563128ba8bc4164e131c3/TL_EAPACK_RADIANTSOUL_1920x1080.jpg[/img]
Find the full cosmetics available in the Early Access Packs in our [url=https://www.playthroneandliberty.com/en-us/news/articles/early-access-packs-available-now]showcase article[/url].

We’re excited for you to set foot in Solisium and begin your adventure on September 26 for early access and October 1 for the full release. Stay tuned to our website and social channels for more information as we head toward launch. We’ll see you in Solisium soon!

notes.title: Siege the Day
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VaA_zbFBt9Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Witness the rise of champions during the Siege the Day event. They will grow. They will fight. For Throne... and Liberty. In an exciting two-day broadcast, some of your favorite content creators from North America and Europe will clash over regional crowns across 3v3 Arenas, Conquest Battles, and Castle Siege. These creators will be backed by some of the best guilds THRONE AND LIBERTY has to offer. With unique spoils and Twitch Drops for all, tune into the spectacle beginning on September 24.

Whether you want to learn more about the game through exclusive developer interviews, gain insight into guild strategies, or just root for your favorite streamer, there’s something for everyone to discover. Look forward to guild captain reveals closer to the event.

[h2]Schedule[/h2]
Check out the full schedule, including descriptions of each activity, below. The official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/amazongames]Amazon Games Twitch channel[/url] will feature gameplay, highlights, and other insights. You can also watch your favorite participant’s stream to get even more out of Siege the Day. Fortunately, there’s (sometimes) honor among guilds, so you can receive special Twitch Drops like the exclusive Siege the Day Title, the Great-Fanged Figmen Amitoi, and the Caerulean Cygnus Morph, even if your favorite guild doesn’t win their regional event.

[b]September 24: 2 p.m. PT (9 p.m. UTC) - North American creator competition[/b]
[list]
[*] 3v3 Arenas, Battle for the Boonstone, and Castle Siege
[/list]
[b]September 25: 10 a.m. PT (5:00 p.m. UTC) - European creator competition[/b]
[list]
[*] 3v3 Arenas, Battle for the Riftstone, and Castle Siege
[/list]
[h3]Castle Siege[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1ox2hj8681BPtd5zF9emld/710ccf4536601d0501358b3c7f62a8da/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_CastleSiege_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
Compete to claim Stoneguard Castle. The current reigning guild will close gates, bolster defenses, and relentlessly fight to stop those brave, or foolish enough, to attempt to seize control. You’ll also need to contend with several other guilds vying for the throne. Dodge raining arrows, cascading spells, and more while laying siege in numerous ways based on your playstyle:
[list]
[*] Brute force: Breach the castle walls with massive golem transformations.
[*] Stealth: Sneak through the sewers to attract less attention. Just make sure it isn’t raining...
[*] Opportunistic: Hitch a ride on a giant flying whale to bypass the castle’s defenses, or take advantage of the chaos amidst another guild’s push to make your own advancement elsewhere.
[/list]
No matter your strategy, all tactics will converge at the throne. There can only be one champion of Stoneguard Castle at the end of the 45 minute match.

[h3]Conquest Battles[/h3]
Each day of the event will feature a different Conquest Battle.

[b]Day 1: Battle for the Boonstone[/b]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/zUnx1LoYf0Cnb53BnYeoo/e7e45e6865a14920579d71a7f02d23f6/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_ConquestBattles_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
Once you interact with the Boonstone in the hunting grounds, the capture begins. The guild that successfully captures and holds it at the end of the 30-minute timer will get additional experience points and item drops.

[b]Day 2: Battle to the Riftstone[/b]

[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1sNfoCnBquok8bJN4VTm8H/45f16ea95cad1905887b0e83683c742d/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_ConquestBattles_v01_B_1080.jpeg[/img]
Gather your guild members within a defined area to obtain points and capture the Riftstone. The guild that fills their entire capture gauge or has the most members inside of the capture zone at the end of the 30-minute timer will earn additional chances to defeat bosses and get stat buffs.

[h3]3v3 Arena[/h3]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3LTobMZK7HWFKLvrXQakVS/3a0ae998f35d52560b09754d3cebdaf7/T_L_Standard_Web_Images_Arenas_v01_C-1080.jpeg[/img]
Eliminations score points, but so does survival. Take advantage of temporary buffs, steal points from opposing players, and gather special orbs for a surprise victory. The team that scores 200 points or has the most points at the end of the 5-minute timer will reign supreme.

[h2]Twitch Drops[/h2]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5YP2l2HDjZyXZYpgXmeWyH/d33a865d3d642e2a8bb091ba2bb0af15/TL_TwitchDrop_SiegeTheDay_withLogo_1920x1080_CT-000011233.jpg[/img]
Watch the official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/amazongames]Amazon Games Twitch channel[/url] or participating creator channels for 90 minutes of accumulative watch time each day to receive the exclusive Siege the Day Title, the Great-Fanged Figmen Amitoi, and the Caerulean Cygnus Morph. If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox or PSN account (depending on which platform) you plan to play on. Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.
[h3]Day 1 Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Title: Siege the Day (30 minutes total)
[*] Amitoi: Great-Fanged Figmen (90 minutes total)
[/list]
[h3]Day 2 Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Title: Siege the Day (30 minutes total) - Note - If you earn this Title on day 1, you will not be able to earn it again on day 2.
[*] Morph: Caerulean Cygnus (90 minutes total)
[/list]
We’ll reveal the Siege the Day participants soon. Stay up-to-date on our road to launch (October 1) through this site, along with our social channels: [url=https://x.com/playtlgame]X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/playthroneandliberty]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/playthroneandliberty/]Instagram[/url], and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playthroneandliberty]TikTok[/url]. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Team Update: Launch Timing
notes.content:
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/74sWYqJEsrBLK1TRpiKLTA/94d0047f105a2baaa4a4e3ce7386d478/TL_Technical_Test_Screenshots_World_Vinyard_v01-1920x720.jpg?fm=webp[/img]
We want to thank all the players who began their journey in Solisium during our Open Beta test. Your participation and feedback have been invaluable as we closely collaborate with NCSOFT to drive changes that reimagine THRONE AND LIBERTY from its original launch in Korea to our launch in Amazon Games' supported regions. Additionally, we’ve seen a surge of excitement from players surrounding the latest major patch in Korea, which introduced a variety of updates and systems. We are committed to delivering the best possible player experience at launch, and as a direct result of player feedback, testing efforts, and the reception to new features, we will be making key changes to the game.

Our team began work after the Open Beta, but fully implementing community feedback and integrating new systems will take additional time. To give our team the time needed to incorporate the most critical pieces of feedback and systems, we have decided to move the THRONE AND LIBERTY launch to October 1, 2024, with Early Access starting on September 26, 2024. Below you dive into the specifics of the updates we’re implementing to ensure THRONE AND LIBERTY provides the best player experience possible at launch.

[h2]Launch Game Updates[/h2]
[h3]Updates Based on Player Feedback[/h3]

[b]Combat[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/5ot5nmtFkVMaE0HqeH2VSD/20b39418f50d59e2300a2e9f1f6395c2/tl_announce_screenshots_combat_siege_f_1920.jpg[/img]
We will be working on combat updates that improve the early game combat experience for players, bringing it more in-line with the strong positive sentiment we received around the late to endgame combat. The improvements include:
[list]
[*] Improved camera controls to remove smoothing (an optional setting) and increase camera movement speed.
[*] Adjusting the skill acquisition timing to give players access to varied abilities and builds earlier in the leveling journey.
[*] Improving the intuitiveness of tab-targeting.
[/list]

[b]Leveling / Progression[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/iLsoqyMbWNzzgvRl3fCyE/6f51d66a61264832a6c2f05d2d168e90/TL_Closed_Beta_Screenshots_Combat_v01_C_1080.jpeg[/img]
We heard feedback from Open Beta participants that they felt overwhelmed by the amount of systems that they were quickly introduced to in the early stages of their journey when leveling and progressing. We’re adjusting the progression journey to better spread out the introduction of systems, allowing players to focus on their early questing experience and learning the ins-and-outs of their character and combat before diving into too many additional systems.


[b]Guilds[/b]
[img]https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/3kZ5fTrHL21s1Un8Yg6mPr/7275dc8c783fcb3e3ecdf581b0230a8f/TL_Summer_Game_Fest_Press_Screenshots_Combat_v01_B_1920.jpg[/img]
THRONE AND LIBERTY is better together. As a guild you can get more out of unique modes like Castle Siege, more confidently traverse the open world thanks to meaningful guild rewards, and better contend with hostile players. We’re expanding the tagging available to guilds so that players can more easily find guilds that align with their playstyles.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
We’re excited to announce that we will bring forward some key changes from the existing Korean version of THRONE AND LIBERTY. The three systems listed below aren’t a comprehensive look at every change we’re including, but these updates are a few we know engaged fans are eagerly anticipating. There will be additional Quality of Life (QoL) and other changes included alongside these new systems, and even more will be added post-launch.


[b]Skill Specializations[/b]

New skill specialization system will be implemented for launch in the regions supported by Amazon Games, allowing you to further customize your combat experience. Find a showcase of the new skill specializations below.

[previewyoutube=-syPRMktNcA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Lifeskills[/b]

Fishing and Cooking will be included for you to experience new lifeskill systems in THRONE AND LIBERTY. Cooking will include new recipes divided into attack, defense, life, and utility effects, while Fishing will introduce a new minigame allowing you to catch a variety of fish in the waters of Solisium.

[b]Cooking Showcase[/b]
[previewyoutube=gLumFsLDI5Q;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Fishing Showcase[/b]
[previewyoutube=VsT_zoAPcac;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Amitoi Expeditions[/b]

Amitoi Expeditions will be added, a new system allowing you to send your Amitois on adventures to collect rewards for you when they’re not accompanying you on your adventures in Solisium. It also includes the Amitoi House, your base of operations for Amitoi Expeditions.
[previewyoutube=K6lj3zojIYE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Looking Forward[/h2]
There are even more changes and updates that will arrive in THRONE AND LIBERTY in the future, and closer to launch we’ll have a team update that discusses the first two months of our roadmap and when you can expect certain content to release.

Once again, our team would like to thank you for your passion, participation, and support as we head toward releasing THRONE AND LIBERTY on October 1, 2024. We can’t wait to welcome you into Solisium.
